articleTitle: Study on a W-Band U-shaped Microstrip Meander-line Slow-wave Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A W-band U-shaped microstrip meander-line (MML) slow-wave structure (SWS) for traveling-wave tube (TWT) was designed and simulated in this work. The selection of materials used for the dielectric substrate in the SWS was discussed. Meanwhile, to improve the interaction impedance of the SWS, a new structure named conformal dielectric substrate was proposed. According to particle-in-cell (PIC) simulation results, the proposed structure was able to reach an output power of 28.86 W at 96 GHz, with the corresponding maximum gain of 23.8 dB. The 3 dB bandwidth was 7 GHz from 92 GHz to 99 GHz.

articleTitle: Design and Test of a Slanting Multiplex Synthesis TE02 Mode Input Coupler for Gyro-TWT
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a slanting multiplex synthesis TE02 mode input coupler for Gyro-TWT is presented. The simulation results show that from 89 GHz to 106 GHz the transmission coefficient of the input coupler is above -0.23 dB and the reflection coefficient is about -15 dB. The cold test results show from 89 GHz to 106 GHz the transmission coefficient of the input coupler is average -1.25 dB and the reflection coefficient is about -10 dB.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation on a Continuously Frequency-Tunable Terahertz Gyrotron
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A continuously frequency-tunable terahertz gyrotron has been investigated experimentally. It is found that the gyrotron can operated at three different frequency bands with different operating magnetic field and beam energy stably.

articleTitle: Design of Lens Based Focal Plane Arrays for Wide Field-of-View Imagers at Sub-millimeter Wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Large format focal plane arrays (FPAs) of lenses are promising candidates for wide field of view sub-millimeter imagers. Recently, a spectral technique based on coherent Fourier Optics has been proposed for analyzing such lens based FPAs in reception to facilitate the optimization via a field matching with the lens feed pattern. Based on this technique, three practical lens antenna geometries based on silicon, quartz and plastic lenses combined with leaky-wave antenna feeds are proposed and compared here. The synthesized lens based FPAs achieved scan loss lower than standard horn based FPAs, leading to wider field of views.

articleTitle: Terahertz Absorption Characteristics of Amino Acid Solution Based on Microfluidic Chip
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz microfluidic chips can reduce water absorption to terahertz by reducing the interaction distance between terahertz wave and liquid in microfluidic channel. In this paper, terahertz microfluidic chip was first prepared and used to study terahertz transmission characteristics of arginine (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>), histidine (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) , which opened a new way to combine terahertz technology and microfluidic technology to study different kinds of liquid amino acids.

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared Bloch Surface Waves for biosensing applications
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report on the design, fabrication, and spectroscopic characterization of a 1D Photonic Cristal (1DPC) sustaining Bloch Surface Waves (BSWs) in the mid-infrared. The reported all-dielectric 1DPC structure shows potential for label-free biosensing applications to medical diagnostics.

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis of a Ka-band Helix TWT with Semi-metallic Rod
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper explores the thermal characteristics of a helix traveling wave tube (TWT) in the Ka-band (26.5-40 GHz) based on rectangular semi-metallic rods formed by welding boron nitride and copper. The results reveal that the maximum temperature of the helix during TWT operation for this supporting rod structure is 339.2°C. A comparison of the thermal characteristics about this structure with those of a conventional dielectric rod shows that the helix temperature of the former is about 40°C lower than that of the latter during operating conditions.

articleTitle: Design and sensitivity analysis of a single sided pumped THz booster
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present the design of a THz driven booster which is capable of accelerating electrons from 55 keV up to above 430 keV kinetic energy. This device is a 3-layer segmented structure and requires a 400-µJ single-cycle THz pulse with center frequency at 300 GHz. Sensitivity of the output beam dynamics to the input parameters and manufacturing tolerances of the booster is also investigated in this paper.

articleTitle: Boson Peak and Fracton of Polymethyl Methacrylate Detected by Terahertz-band Infrared and Raman Spectroscopies
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We performed terahertz time-domain spectroscopy and low-frequency Raman scattering on polymethyl methacrylate to investigate the boson peak (BP) which is a universal excitation in glass, and the fracton which is expected to be expressed in polymer glass. In the infrared spectrum, the BP was observed in the plot of α(ν)/ν<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, where α(ν) is the absorption coefficient. In addition, the infrared light-vibration coupling constant C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">IR</inf>(ν) and the Raman coupling constant C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Raman</inf>(ν) were determined, and the fracton was observed as a linear region in the log-log plots of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">IR</inf>(ν) and C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Raman</inf>(ν).

articleTitle: Application of Terahertz Spectroscopy in Defect Detection of Power Cable Terminal Insulation Material
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, Terahertz time domain spectroscopy system (THz-TDS) is introduced into the nondestructive testing of the defects of power cable insulation materials. Typical defects including air gap, conductive impurities and discharge channel. Samples of cable terminal insulation material with typical defects are tested using THz-TDS. Time-domain and frequency-domain spectrums of different defects are obtain and analysis. Finally, terahertz two-dimensional imaging test is carried out on cable terminal insulation materials with typical defects and defects are clearly visible in the imaging. Experimental results show that terahertz technology can be applied to the field of nondestructive testing of cable terminal insulation.

articleTitle: Visualizing liquid transport through coated pharmaceutical tablets using terahertz pulsed imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz pulsed imaging (TPI) was used to visualize the live liquid penetration process of coated pharmaceutical tablets. Multiple features are observed including diffusion through both coating and core layer, with a discontinuity at the core-coating interface as well as the dissolution of the interface. They can all be conveniently quantified, compared and related back to processing parameters such as porosity of the core and other results from the terahertz scan. This study has the potential to facilitate a more in-depth understanding of the impact of coating on drug release and dissolution.

articleTitle: Investigation of spatial coherence of hybrid surface plasmon-phonon-polaritons in n-GaN gratings
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Record high spatial coherence values up to 87λ (130λ) in experiment (theory) were reported for polarized emission of surface plasmon-phonon polaritons excited in shallow surface relief n-GaN grating. Unusual independence of quality factor and dependence of spatial coherence length on the grating wavevector were observed in the course of a thorough investigation of dispersion characteristics of these quasiparticles.

articleTitle: Study on dual-band plasmon-induced transparent graphene Metasurface in Terahertz band
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A graphene metamaterials based on plasmon-induced transparent has been proposed, which is composed of graphene split rings and graphene nanostrip. Split ring and nanostrip can generate resonance points at different frequencies under the excitation of terahertz waves. When these two structures are combined, two transparent windows are generated due to the destructive interference. Via tuning the Fermi energy of graphene of MaSRR, the amplitude of the first transmission peak increased from 0.64 to 0.86, and the amplitude of the second transmission peak decreased from 0.97 to 0.85. Via tuning the Fermi energy of graphene of MiSRR, the amplitude of the first transmission peak remains unchanged, and the amplitude of the second transmission peak ranges from 0 to 0.85. This study provides a good theoretical basis for the diversity of terahertz wave modulation.

articleTitle: Terahertz Frequency Doubler Based on Multi-anodes Monolithic Integrated GaAs Diode
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper proposes two terahertz monolithic integrated doublers in the terahertz band (170 GHz, 340GHz), have been designed and fabricated on a 15μm thick GaAs film substrate. The front stage frequency multiplier adopts eight anodes and the rear stage adopts six anodes. Measurement has shown that the efficiency is greater than 20% in the frequency range of 157-177GHz (First stage) with the input power of 300mW, and the peak efficiency at 170GHz is 26.25%. The simulation showed efficiency is greater than 40% in the frequency range of 330-350GHz(Second stage) with the input power of 60mW, and the peak efficiency at 341GHz is 46%.

articleTitle: Hydration-dependent infrared study of eumelanin
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Here we report our study of the mid-infrared absorption spectra of a melanin thin film performed with hydration level variation. We demonstrate the direct signatures of the proposed earlier comproportionation reaction induced by continuous hydration along with the fingerprints of three water sub-phases in hydrated melanin.

articleTitle: Terahertz spectroscopy by only detecting visible light
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: New concepts of sensing inspired by quantum optics provide a highly attractive alternative for accessing spectral regions in which photon detection is technically challenging. By using nonlinear interferometers, it is possible to transfer the properties of photons after interaction with a sample to visible photons. Then detection can be realized by widely available and highly developed imaging sensors without the need of cooling or expensive pulsed lasers. We report on the demonstration of spectroscopy in the terahertz frequency range using this new concept measuring absorption features of chemicals in the sub-terahertz frequency range by only detecting visible photons [1].

articleTitle: Design of quantum dot infrared photodetector with high absorptivity by metal grating
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In order to make the absorptivity of the quantum dot infrared detector better meet the application requirements, the metal grating with the cross strip and the holes is introduced in the conventional quantum dot infrared photodetector to construct the enhanced photodetector. The enhanced photodetector shows the high absorptivity due to the local coupling enhanced effect and this absorptivity can reach 99.38%, which is 2.74 times of that of conventional photodetector.

articleTitle: Milliwatt-average power broadband THz source at 13.3 MHz repetition rate using diamond-cooled organic crystal BNA
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate optical rectification in BNA organic crystals using bursts of pulses from a high-power thin-disk oscillator at 13.3 MHz repetition rate. We measure an average power of 0.95 mW at 10% duty cycle with a conversion efficiency of 4×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>. To the best of our knowledge, this is the highest average power reported with commercially available BNA so far. The detected THz spectrum bandwidth spans up to 6 THz.

articleTitle: SOI-based opto-mechanical Terahertz bolometer operating at room temperature with microsecond response time
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report the operation of a Terahertz (THz) detector exploiting the bi-material effect to resonantly excite a cantilever (CL) of micrometric size. The detector is fabricated on a SOI substrate and coupling to the incident THz radiation is obtained using two coupled aluminum half-dipole antennas. The induced CL deflection is readout optically with a 1.5<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">µ</inf>m laser. At 300K and 2.5THz, we obtain a peak responsivity of ~2 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>pm/W for the fundamental bending mode. This yields a NEP of ~20nW/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> at 2.5THz, i.e. of ~2nW/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> at 3.8THz, corresponding to the antenna peak absorption. Finally, the low mechanical quality factor of the mode grants a broad frequency response of approximately 100kHz, i.e. a response time of ~10 μs.

articleTitle: Terahertz Two-dimensional Beam Scanning Antenna Based on Improved Planar Phase Shifting Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A novel horn fed terahertz transmitarrays(TAs) antenna, which is based on improved planar phase shifting surfaces, is presented in this paper. Based on the principle of scattering-pattern shift theory on metasurfaces [2], the improved planar phase shifting surfaces (PPSSs) are designed. The improved PPSSs have low insertion loss and the phase shift range from 0° to 360°. The antenna has the advantages of higher frequency band, low profile structure, higher gain, and wider beam scanning angle. The full-wave simulation results demonstrate that the designed antenna enables beam steering in H-plane at the 99GHz-101GHz working frequency, with a peak gain of 23.6dBi at 100GHz. And the beam scanning range of the antenna reaches±35°.

articleTitle: Modulations of THz Wave from Vortex Beam Induced Air Plasmas
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate a method to modulate the intensity and central frequency of THz generation from two-color laser-induced air plasmas, via transforming the pump Gaussian beams into vortex beams. Under the same input laser energy, the outputs of THz emission generated by the vortex beam can be enhanced, showing the potential of producing stronger THz radiation. Meanwhile, the vortex pump-beams also provide an unique possibility to modulate the central frequency of THz outputs, implying an all-optical method of THz modulation based on the shaped plasmas.

articleTitle: Non-destructive evaluation of ceramic porosity using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We measured the dielectric constants of alumina ceramic samples with non-destructive THz time-domain spectroscopy. Using an effective medium approximation, we demonstrated that the relative permittivity can be used to evaluate the porous alumina samples, with porosity fractions ranging from 0% to 20% per volume. This result can be used to control sample porosity, a key material parameter related to mechanical strength under compression load, hardness and wear resistance, or thermal stability.

articleTitle: Electron interception investigation for 0.14THz Symmetric Double V-Shaped Microstrip Meander-Line TWT
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A 0.14THz symmetric double V-shaped microstrip meander-line sheet beam TWT is designed. By setting up the particle monitors, the beam interception is observed when the steady beam-wave interaction processes occur. As the uniform focusing magnetic field is reduced from operation value to a half, the rising beam interception ratios from 0% to 3% are obtained. According to the simulation results, the interceptions are always concentrated on the last several periods of the SWS. The thermal analysis for this TWT will be carried out according these results.

articleTitle: Ka-Band Ultra-Short Pulse Oscillator with Helical-Waveguide Gyro-TWT and Cyclotron Resonance Absorber in the Feedback Loop
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present the results of first experiments on generation of trains of sub-nanosecond Ka-band pulses in the electron oscillator consisting of a helical-waveguide gyro-TWT and a saturable absorber based on cyclotron resonance interaction of radiation with initially rectilinear electron beam. The process of pulse formation is associated with the effect of passive mode locking which is well known in laser physics but has not yet been employed in high-power microwave electronics. In good agreement with the theoretical predictions, periodical trains of coherent (in-phase) 0.5 ns pulses with peak power of 100 kW and repetition period of 2.5 ns were measured.

articleTitle: Study on the Multi-Modes, Multi-Harmonics Behavior of a THz Large-Orbit Gyrotron
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A large orbit gyrotron capable of operating from the 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> to the 9<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> harmonic is investigated. With the assistance of the 3-D particle-in-cell simulation, the beam-wave interaction dynamics and high harmonics operation regimes are studied. It is shown that by tuning the external magnetic field intensity, successive excitation of the oscillation at a number of neighboring harmonics can be achieved, corresponding to radiation frequencies between 240 GHz to 460 GHz. Then, a study of the competition among the 7th, 8th and 9th harmonics are conducted, providing an insight into the multi-modes, multi-harmonics behavior of the high-harmonic LOG.

articleTitle: G-band Radiation source based on metamaterial structure and double sheet
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a terahertz radiation source in G-band based on metamaterial (MTM) structure and double sheet beams. The slow wave structure (SWS) is designed and analyzed in the HFSS, and the S-parameter retrieval approach is used to retrieve the effective permittivity and permeability. Also, the electromagnetic properties of the MTM structure are analyzed. Furthermore, the beam-wave interaction process of a BWO with MTM structure and double sheet beams is simulated by a PIC code. The results show that the radiation source can generate 84.5W output power with the interaction efficiency of 7.7% at the frequency of 213GHz on the condition of the beam voltage of 73kV and total current of 15mA.

articleTitle: Terahertz Polarization-Maintaining Filter for Dispersion Compensation
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report a compact terahertz polarization-maintaining subwavelength filter featuring large negative group velocity dispersions (over -200 ps/mm/THz) at around 0.15 THz. Such waveguide grating has recently been fabricated exploiting micro-machining technique. Simulation results indicate that the filter can be applied for dispersion compensation in terahertz communication links.

articleTitle: Millimeter-long travelling wave photoconductors for THz generation by photomixing
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this communication we present the development of a travelling wave photoconductor for THz generation by photomixing. It is based on a silicon nitride optical waveguide coupled to a membrane-supported low-temperature-grown GaAs photoconductor embedded in a coplanar waveguide. The frequency response of a 1-mm-long structure, measured up to 100 GHz by using the beatnote produced by two 780-nm-DFB lasers, shows the expected travelling wave signature consisting in a 6-dB-decrease ending at ~50 GHz when the contribution of the backward travelling wave is fully cancelled, following by a constant level up to ~100 GHz.

articleTitle: Terahertz spectra of 3D printed photonic structures
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: THz photonic structures composed of dielectric rods were realized by low-cost, rapid, and versatile 3D-printing technology. THz time-domain spectroscopy was employed for the experimental study of the structures' optical response. Results were interpreted by using simulations performed by an analytical exact solution of the Maxwell equations for a general incidence geometry. The structures show specific spectral forbidden bands of the incident THz radiation, depending on their optical and geometrical parameters. The effect of the position disorder was also quantified.

articleTitle: A Simple Approach to Analysis Temperature-dependent Terahertz Spectra Based on Zernike Moments
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The spectral fingerprint in terahertz frequency region shows a remarkable shift with temperature. That means if a qualitative and quantitative model has been trained for samples at constant temperature, it may not always work for an arbitrary temperature. To solve this problem we introduce Zernike image moment theory and show how it may be used for classifying and quantifying the terahertz spectra, isolating the influence of temperature variation.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Network Classification of In Vivo Burn injuries with Different Etiologies Using THz Time-Domain Spectral Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Patients arrive in burn centers with many etiologies of burn incidence (such as scald, contact, flame, steam, etc.). Treatment of these injuries depends on the burn depth and surface area of these burns. Moreover, earlier diagnosis and treatment of these burns lead to better patient outcomes. In this study, we show that THz-TDS imaging with a neural network classification algorithm can reproducibly classify burns, independent of their etiology, with an ROC-AUC of 88% in a porcine model.

articleTitle: Analysis of Eavesdropping Attacks on Terahertz Links propagating through Atmospheric Turbulence
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Despite the high directivity of THz beams, THz wireless links may still suffer compromising emissions when propagate through atmospheric turbulence and suffers scattering. In this work, we investigate the eavesdropping risks of a line-of-sight (LOS) THz link `in atmospheric turbulence with an eavesdropper located close to but outside of the beam path. A theoretical model considering the turbulence induced losses, gaseous absorption and beam divergence is conducted. Theoretical estimations agree well with our measured data. The secrecy capacity and outage probability dependent on the carrier frequency, turbulence strength, eavesdropper’s position and receiver sensitivity are analyzed.

articleTitle: Frequency Multiplication in a Powerful Terahertz Free-Electron Maser
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A free-electron maser based on a new generation of induction linacs capable of forming 5 - 20 MeV / 2 kA / 200 ns electron beams is currently under development. In this work, we study possibilities for realization of powerful THz two-wave oscillators based on the use of the regime of frequency multiplication.

articleTitle: Enhancement of THz Radiation Intensity in Fe/Heavy-Metal Spintronic Emitters Epitaxially Grown on GaAs(001)
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We explored THz emission from laser illuminated Fe/heavy-metal bilayer spintronic emitters grown epitaxially on top of GaAs(001) substrates. The fabricated emitters show an overall enhancement of the transient THz radiation compared to structures fabricated on insulating substrates. In addition, the THz amplitude shows strongly vertically off-set hysteretic behavior in varying magnetic field. We ascribe these observations to the interplay of several mechanisms including inverse spin Hall effect, optical rectification, Lorentz force and chemical bonding at the epitaxial Fe/GaAs(001) interface.

articleTitle: Conformational changes of an oriented film of photosensitive proteins observed by polarized ATR infrared spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We apply polarized Attenuated Total Reflection Fourier Transform Infrared spectroscopy (ATR-FTIR) to study conformational changes of the prototype photosensitive protein bacteriorhodopsin (BR). The experiments are performed on hundreds-nanometer-thick films of stacked membrane patches embedding BR molecules. Moreover, we report our results on functionalization of silicon surfaces that are preliminary to further experiments involving faced-down silicon substrates on ATR crystal in order to increase the sensitivity down to very thin protein films.

articleTitle: Terahertz wave modulation utilizing superconductor-metal metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We designed and fabricated a kind of NbN-gold hybrid metamaterial-based modulator. They had tunable spectra response under thermal stimuli. This terahertz (THz) wave active modulator possesses good prospect for the application of THz imaging and communication.

articleTitle: Low Frequency Noise of Carbon Nanotubes THz detectors
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report studies of noise properties of carbon nanotube (CNT) networks-based devices used for the terahertz detectors. Low-frequency noise characteristics of CNTs as a function of temperature, UV illumination, and back-gate voltages were examined. Our results demonstrated the existence of at least two important resistance components of nanotubes rather than generally accepted dominant tube-to-tube junction resistance. We showed that noise spectroscopy can be employed to probe the structural quality of nanotube networks. Measurements as a function of back gate voltages revealed the existence of generation-recombination noise, related to deep tarps, which play a significant role in the performances of CNT networks-based terahertz detectors.

articleTitle: Fabrication, Measurement and Imaging Demonstration of Si-based BIB Terahertz array detector
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Si-based blocked-impurity-band (BIB) terahertz array detector with response frequency 6THz has been realized. Measurement system and imaging system are built to characterize the comprehensive performance and imaging capabilities of the BIB detector. Noise equivalent power (NEP) of Si-based BIB array detector is measured to characterize its detection capability of weak signal. Imaging system based on Si-based BIB array detector is built and high-resolution imaging is realized.

articleTitle: Spectrally-Encoded THz Reflection Imaging Through Turbid Media Using Wavelet Multiresolution Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate spectroscopic THz reflection imaging through turbid media. We show that the detection of resonant features in the extinction spectrum can be made possible using multiresolution analysis based on wavelet transforms. We determine that the spatial resolution of this imaging technique is only diffraction limited.

articleTitle: Crystallising Magnesium Sulfate Solutions: Observing Structure with Terahertz Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The crystallisation process of MgSO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> in a crystallisation cell is investigated at different temperatures and concentrations by combining terahertz time-domain spectroscopy with optical analysis. The emergence and change of a spectral feature at 1.6 THz clearly reflect the progress of the crystallisation. Careful spectral investigation allows to extract information about the amorphous phase before and during the crystallisation. The versatile experimental set up is designed to be easily adjusted to the required conditions and can be utilised to investigate other systems. In addition, the set up can be applied to both static and continuous flow.

articleTitle: Study of the spatio-temporal profile diagnostics for relativistic picosecond electron bunches by electro-optic sampling
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Electric field profiles around a relativistic electron bunch along the propagation and in the radial direction are measured by the electro-optic (EO) sampling. The longitudinal (temporal) profile is obtained by changing the arrival time on the EO crystal between the electron bunch and the pulsed probe laser, while the transverse (radial) profile is investigated by lateral shift of the electron beam path. The validity of the experimental results is confirmed by the three-dimensional particle-in-cell calculations. It is demonstrated that the longitudinal and transverse beam sizes can be obtained by the measured spatio-temporal electric field distribution around the electron bunch.

articleTitle: Deformation-Induced Structural Changes of Carbon Black Fillers in Rubbers Investigated by Terahertz Polarization Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We investigated the polarization-dependent terahertz optical conductivity of rubber compounds with carbon black (CB) fillers under cyclic deformation to detect deformation-induced changes of the internal CB structure in a contactless manner. It is clearly observed that the conductivity during the unloading is reduced from that during the loading at the same draw ratios. To interpret this hysteresis of the conductivity, we perform theoretical calculation based on the effective medium theory. Comparing with the calculation, we attribute the hysteresis of the conductivity to the reduction of the anisotropy of the CB aggregates, which might result from the deformation-induced rupture of them.

articleTitle: Monolithic integrated terahertz vector vortex quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Lasers with orbital angular momentum (OAM) holds promise for compact, at-source solutions for applications in imaging and communications. In this work, we demonstrate an electrically pumped terahertz vector vortex quantum cascade laser, (THz-VV-QCL) which is fabricated by monolithically integrating a ring resonator with periodic double slits scattering elements, bus waveguide, and a distributed feedback QCL. To compensate for radiation and material losses, the ring resonator is pumped by the metallic air bridge. The mode purities of left/right-circularly polarized light are 87.7%/91%, respectively. The integrated THz-VV-QCL shows the great potential for application in THz communication and image.

articleTitle: Development of Advanced Terahertz Optics Using Liquid Crystals
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Liquid crystal devices manufactured with a commercially available material (E7) have been characterized with THz time-domain spectroscopy up to 4.5 THz. These LCDs were used to modulate the power output of a 3.4-THz quantum-cascade laser, attenuating the THz power through the device by up to 40% dependent both on the liquid crystal layer thickness and bias voltage applied.

articleTitle: Double-Heterojunction Bipolar Transistor as THz Detector for Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We investigate the use of an InP-based double-heterojunction bipolar transistor as a detector for wireless communications around 300~GHz. The sensitivity of the detector, along with its complex output impedance are characterized for a transistor (un)coupled to a log-spiral antenna, at different biases. A real-time uncompressed high-definition video signal is successfully transmitted at 1.5 Gbps in a heterodyne configuration.

articleTitle: Terahertz magnetospectroscopy of pseudo-relativistic fermions in HgCdTe alloys under hydrostatic pressure
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report on terahertz (THz) magnetospectroscopy of Hg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>Cd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Te (MCT) epitaxial alloys with various cadmium content (from x = 0.15 to x = 0.17). Additionally some magnetospectroscopy investigations were performed as a function of hydrostatic pressure. We show that all experimental data can be perfectly interpreted within the pseudo-relativistic description assuming E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf> = 2mc<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> where E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf> is the band gap, m is the fermion rest mass and c is the constant. Remarkably, the experimental results for all the samples are consistently described by using constant velocity c = 1.0•10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> m/s (close to Fermi velocity in graphene) independent of hydrostatic pressure and Cd content.

articleTitle: Continuously tunable terahertz parametric generation in KTP crystal with pulse-seed injection
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A continuously tunable injection pulse-seeded terahertz parametric generator based on KTP crystal has been demonstrated in this work. The terahertz tuning range was from 2.80 THz to 6.24 THz and the maximum terahertz output was 4.59 μJ at 4.42 THz. Compared with the traditional KTP terahertz parametric oscillator with discontinuous frequency tuning, the KTP ips-TPG has significance improvement in the tuning range and THz output energy.

articleTitle: Reflective single-pixel terahertz pulsed imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The investigation of single-pixel terahertz (THz) imaging opens up a new research direction for the development of THz imaging technology. In this work, we achieve a reflective single-pixel THz imaging system. By combining the compressed sensing (CS) and inverse Fresnel diffraction (IFD) algorithms, a reflective THz spectral image is accurately reconstructed and the morphology of a sample is clearly observed.

articleTitle: Bound States in the Continuum Excited and Detected in the Near-Field
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Bound states in the Continuum (BICs) represent a new paradigm for resonant photonics due to their infinite lifetimes associated with the full suppression of radiation losses. This property makes it impossible to directly investigate BICs with standard far-field spectroscopy. In this contribution, we demonstrate the local excitation and the direct measurement of the near-field of BICs in arrays of dimer resonators and report their extremely long lifetimes due to the out-of-phase field oscillations in the resonators.

articleTitle: Integrated Terahertz Band-Stop Filter Based on Effective Medium
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We propose a terahertz band-stop filter based on substrateless effective-medium-clad dielectric waveguides. The Bragg grating filter is built into a single high-resistivity silicon wafer and operates at the WR-3 band (220-330 GHz) with the inplane polarization. Due to the controllable air-silicon effective-medium permittivity, an additional degree of freedom can be accessed in the design of Bragg grating structure, which allows to modulate the modal indices for broadband operation. Hybrid effective medium claddings are introduced to further reduce the insertion loss with a small footprint. The results are experimentally validated. The techniques to improve the filter characteristics by controlling the effective medium are adaptable to the microwave and optical regimes.

articleTitle: THz Nonlinearity Enhancement by Phonon Polaritons in Ionic Crystals
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Optical nonlinearity at the THz frequency has drawn extensive attention for its fascinating prospects. Here we show that THz nonlinearity in ionic crystals can be enhanced by orders of magnitude through phonon polaritons, which is also theoretically demonstrated by nonlinear modified Huang equations. This result shows great potential for the technologies based on THz nonlinearities, and provide a novel material modulation technique to the ionic crystals.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade laser frequency comb at 5 THz
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: As a compact light source with high output power, quantum cascade laser has excellent performance in the range of 1-5THz. By using THz QCL optical comb spectrum in this frequency range, drugs and industrial waste gas can be quickly and effectively detected and identified. In this paper, we report a semi-insulating surface-plasmon waveguide THz QCL emitting at 5 THz operating in continuous-wave mode at 4K. For the device with 3-mm-long cavity and 150-µm-wide ridge, the continuous peak power is up to 13mW and the total spectral range is about 5cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. Furthermore, the stable optical comb is achieved in the range of 0.93-1.11A.

articleTitle: Electrically Tunable Quasioptical Notch Filter Based on a Liquid-Crystal-Metastructure for the Short Millimetre-Wave Range
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The experimental results on the development of a LC-based quasioptical notch filter with an electrically controlled rejection frequency operating in the range of 109−120 GHz are presented. At the optimal frequency of 113.14 GHz, the rejection depth as low as −37.4 dB at the bandwidth of 6.7 % and 0−3 V controlling voltage range are demonstrated. Applications of the developed device in single-pixel sub-THz imagers are discussed.

articleTitle: 235GHz Low insertion loss Modulator in InP HEMT technology
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper describes the design of a wideband modulator using 90nm InP HEMT technology. The on-off effect of the modulator is controlled by the two-dimensional electron gas concentration in the HEMT. It is demonstrated that the insertion loss is less than 5 dB, minimum isolation on the off state is 24dB over 227~241GHz.

articleTitle: A Continuous-wave Terahertz Self-heterodyne Spectroscopy System without Using Short-carrier-lifetime Photoconductors
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a continuous-wave terahertz self-heterodyne spectroscopy system, which is realized using plasmonics-enhanced sources and detectors with ultrafast carrier transport. With a 67 dB signal-to-noise ratio and a detection bandwidth more than 1.5 THz, this is the very first terahertz self-heterodyne spectroscopy system without utilizing short-carrier-lifetime photoconductors.

articleTitle: Compact 12×12-Pixel THz Camera using AlGaN/GaN HEMT Technology Operating at Room Temperature
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report on a THz detector camera with a monolithically integrated 12×12 detector array of AlGaN/GaN TeraFETs. The camera operates in the range 100 GHz – 2 THz and is the first of its kind with a multidimensional array of 144 pixel based on III-V semiconductor technology. The sensitivity efficiency of the camera is evaluated between 100 GHz and 1 THz using InGaAs-based photoconductive signal sources. Its analog frontend electronics allows a frame rate of around 100 fps while maintaining a 0.5 nA (RMS) input referred noise current. Additionally, the spectral frequency response is measured in order to evaluate the potential of these detectors for industrial applications.

articleTitle: Terahertz Absorption Characteristics of Soluble Starch Based on Microfluidic Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The combination of microfluidic technology and terahertz technology can shorten the distance between samples and terahertz wave, reduce the absorption of terahertz wave, and more effectively study the dynamic characteristics of biological samples in aqueous solution. In this paper, the high sealing performance microfluidic chip was used to study the different mass fraction of soluble starch, and the terahertz spectral characteristics of soluble starch under the action of electric field were obtained, which provided technical support for the detection of starch using terahertz technology.

articleTitle: Accurate Classification of Burn Injuries Using Support Vector Machines and the Wavelet Shannon Entropy of the THz-TDS Waveforms
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The accuracy of clinical assessment of partial-thickness burn injuries has remained as low as 60% in the first few days post burn induction. Here, we present the implementation of a wavelet Shannon entropy technique for noninvasive characterization of burn injuries in an in vivo porcine burn study. Supervised machine learning using the support vector machines (SVM) based on the energy to Shannon entropy ratio (ESER) in the wavelet packet transform of the THz-TDS waveform yielded accuracy rates above 91% in differentiation between superficial, intermediate, and full-thickness burn categories.

articleTitle: Design of a Ultrathin Broadband and Large Incident Angle Metamaterial Absorber
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a ultrathin broadband and large incident angle metamaterial absorber by introducing a near-field coupling of split-ring resonators and the non-uniform periodic arrangement is proposed, which demonstrates intentional performance in terms of bandwidth and large-angle absorption. The results show that a bandwidth of absorption at 70% from 13 GHz to 34 GHz. Absorber has good stability for TE and TM modes at large incident angles and exhibits more than 80% absorptivity up to 60° incident angles for TM mode. This finding provide a novel technique for broadband device design, which could bring about a wide range of applications in microwave technology.

articleTitle: Diffraction Properties of Electromagnetic Waves on Periodic and Aperiodic Gratings in Hollow Dielectric Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The paper presents the results of theoretical modeling of axisymmetric gradient gratings of a periodic and aperiodic amplitude profile (Fresnel, Fibonacci) positioned within a circular hollow dielectric waveguide. Such gratings can be placed in waveguide dielectric resonators and used as output mirrors of terahertz lasers. Using the Finite-Difference in Time Domain method for Bodies of Revolution (BOR FDTD) the dependences of the reflection and transmission coefficients of the basic modes of waveguide resonators for these gradient structures are found. The narrow-band application of the studied aperiodic structures in comparison with the known periodic structures is shown.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis for THz Ladder-Type Extended Interaction Cavity
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Sensitivity analysis for 0.34 THz ladder-type extended interaction cavity is studied using the ladder cavity models with manufacturing tolerance assuming normal distributions for the critical dimensions. The corresponding simulation results demonstrate manufacturing tolerances affect the key performance of the extended interaction cavity, including the field distortion, 2π-frequency shift, and the effective characteristic impedance.

articleTitle: Quantitative Detection of Formaldehyde Solution Based on Terahertz Attenuated Total Reflection Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, terahertz attenuated total reflection (THz-ATR) technology is used to measure formaldehyde solutions with a concentration of 0% to 10%, and the refractive index and absorption coefficient of the formaldehyde solution in the range of 0.2~1.2THz are selected to establish partial least squares (PLS) quantitative detection model and back propagation neural network (BPNN) quantitative detection model. Among them, the correlation coefficient (R) and root mean square error (RMSE) of the PLS model based on the refractive index are 98.99% and 0.4602, respectively; the R and RMSE of the PLS model based on the absorption coefficient are 99.05% and 0.4464, respectively; the R of the BPNN model based on the refractive index is 99.80%, and the RMSE is 0.2407; the R of the BPNN model based on the absorption coefficient is 99.93%, and the RMSE is 0.1182.

articleTitle: Spectroscopic imaging with a compact terahertz difference frequency generation source
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate spectroscopic imaging using a compact ultra-broadband terahertz source with a high-power, mid-infrared quantum cascade laser. The electrically pumped monolithic semiconductor source is based on intra-cavity difference-frequency generation and can be designed to achieve an ultra-broadband multi-mode terahertz emission spectrum extending from 1 to 4 THz without any external optical setup. We acquired false-color R, G, and B image, and as a result, this imaging technique clearly identified three different tablet components (polyethylene, D-histidine and DL-histidine). This method may be highly suitable for quality monitoring of pharmaceutical materials.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experiment of THz Wave Generation in LT-GaAs Excited by 1550 nm Laser
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, the transmission theory of photoconductive antenna is briefly explained, and the photoconductive antenna is simulated by HFSS software. LT- GaAs thin film is prepared by etching the sacrificial layer (AlAs) in the four layer epitaxial structure of LT-GaAs, GaAs, AlAs and semi insulating gallium arsenide (SI-GaAs), and then transferred to clean silicon to prepare LT-GaAs thin film antenna. In the last, the terahertz signal is successfully detected. In addition, the experimental results and simulation results are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: S-band Two-gap Metamaterial Extended Interaction Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, an S-band two-gap metamaterial extended interaction oscillator (MEIO) is proposed. The simulation results of electromagnetic properties indicate the effective characteristic impedance of the metamaterial extended interaction resonant cavity (MEIRC) is higher than that of conventional counterparts. Further, the beam-wave interaction results of the MEIO with the MEIRC show the output power is 2.5 MW and the electronic efficiency is 21.4% at 2.76 GHz for a beam voltage of 130 kV and a beam current of 90 A. The transverse and longitudinal dimensions of the interaction structure of the MEIO are 0.3λ and 0.6λ (λ is the wavelength in free space), respectively. As a miniaturized microwave source, the MEIO can provide for applications of high power relativistic klystron amplifier.

articleTitle: Theoretical Study on Terahertz Oscillation of Protons in Zundel Cations
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The Zundel cation configuration (H5O2)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> is the basic unit to understand the physical and chemical properties of water. Through the calculation of the density functional theory (DFT) and the finite difference time domain (FDTD) algorithm of the Schrödinger equation, we investigate the terahertz oscillation behavior of proton wavefunction in Zundel cation. For the preliminary static symmetric double-minimum potential model, the frequency of periodically proton tunneling covers the terahertz range and varies with the transfer coordinates.

articleTitle: High Sensitivity Detection of Liquids in Gasoline Admixtures with THz Time-Domain Spectrometers
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper presents low detection limit (ppm level) measurements of admixtures dissolved in gasoline liquid samples using Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy (THz-TDS). Contrary to the methods which are based on spectroscopic measurements we found that the pulse delay is an adequate parameter to detect water or alcohol admixtures in gasoline. The method is validated for water and isopropanol admixtures in gasoline with a precision of down to 250 ppm in case of water.

articleTitle: THz Vortex Light and Landau Level Transitions in Topological Semimetals
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A THz vortex beam describes light with a larger than ordinary total angular momentum. Increased total angular momentum modifies the optical selection rules, opening a new territory of material research. We discuss the basic concept of vortex beams and a possible approach for future THz studies. The experiments on Landau level transitions will be given as an example.

articleTitle: THz photocurrent magneto-oscillations in GaN-based asymmetric grating gate structures
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report THz induced ratchet photocurrent in AlGaN/GaN heterostructures superimposed with asymmetric dual-grating gate structure. The photocurrent shows giant magneto-oscillations in the regime of high magnetic fields. Peculiarly, the envelope of these oscillations exhibits large beatings as a function of the magnetic field. We demonstrate experimentally and theoretically that the beatings are caused by the spin-orbit interaction in GaN conduction band. Our results show how THz photoconductivity can be used for studies of spin dependent effects in GaN-based materials.

articleTitle: Design of a 280-340GHz Double E-Plane Orthomode Polarization Full Duplexer with High Isolation
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The duplexer is a key device for simultaneous signal transmission and reception, and a lot of duplexers based on frequency division principle have been proposed. However, there are some defects of duplexers based on frequency division such as interference between the transmitting and the receiving signals. Development of dual-polarization transmit and receive module offers a significant way to solve the above problems. However, limited by the processing accuracy and other issues, there are very few orthomode polarization duplexers designed for the terahertz frequency band. In this article, a novel duplexer in THz band is proposed. The structure of the duplexer proposed in this paper is very simple, easy to process in the terahertz frequency band, and has very good realizability. The simulation results of the duplexer show that the insertion loss of both two modes is less than 0.2 dBm, the return loss is better than 20 dBm, and the isolation of two orthomodes is better than 68 dBm.

articleTitle: How 50 Years of Technology Development Has Transformed Millimeter-THz Astronomical Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Millimeter wavelength astronomical spectroscopy started about 50 years ago, with the detection of carbon monoxide in interstellar space. The detection of massive clouds of molecular material in the Milky Way answered a long-standing question of from what stars form, but understanding the formation, structure, and evolution of these clouds demanded ever more sensitive receivers operating throughout the millimeter/submillimeter//THz range. Fractional frequency resolution R>3x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> is required to measure the motions in star-forming regions, with the result that heterodyne systems have become the dominant technology for detailed kinematic studies. To unravel the complexity of chemistry in molecular clouds, higher sensitivity was required. To achieve this, the Schottky diodes initially used as nonlinear elements were first cooled to reduce noise, but then replaced by superconductor insulator superconductor (SIS) and hot electron bolometer (HEB) mixers. Noise temperatures dropped from many thousands of K to < 100 K. Local oscillators (LOs) evolved from vacuum tubes to solid state devices. Large efforts were devoted to the development of frequency multipliers which allow mixers up to several THz to operate, starting with spectrally pure, tunable sources below 100 GHz. These allowed unbiased "spectral scans" and better use of observing time. The quantum cascade laser LO has allowed exploiting frequencies to 5 THz and beyond. Single antennas grew by more than an order of magnitude in collecting area. Interferometric arrays providing unprecedented angular resolution have allowed detailed observations of sources ranging from planet-forming disks to star-forming regions in distant galaxies. The interplay between technology and astronomical spectroscopy has been hugely productive, and continues, with new types of mixers for individual pixels and sophisticated focal plane arrays being developed for ground and space-based applications.

articleTitle: Pulsed Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy of Paraffin-Embedded Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Paraffin-embedded murine pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and healthy pancreas tissues were investigated using pulsed terahertz time-domain spectroscopy in transmission geometry. A deconvolution procedure was employed to obtain the tissue impulse response from the raw Terahertz signals. We report a well-resolved differences between the tumor and healthy pancreas along with an enhanced absorbance in tumor tissue compared to its healthy counterpart.

articleTitle: Single Patch Fractal-Shaped Antenna with Small footprint Area and High Radiation Properties for Wide Operation Over 5G Region
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, we have presented a wideband and high gain fractal antenna operating at 39 GHz for 5G communication systems. The antenna is designed on a Rogers RT/duroid 5880 with compact size of 15 mm × 15 mm × 0.79 mm. The results of the proposed antenna with advantages of low profile, broad bandwidth, high radiation gain and efficiency, simple design and easy of manufacture, and cost effective make it a latent candidate for 5G millimeter-waves applications.

articleTitle: Simple Geometry Multi-Bands Antenna For Millimeter-Wave Applications At 28 GHz, 38 GHz, And 55 GHz Allocated To 5G Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, an umbrella-shaped patch antenna for future millimeter-wave applications is presented. The proposed antenna resonates at multiple frequency bands at 28 GHz, 38 GHz, and 55 GHz (V-band) that have been globally allocated for 5G communications systems. The proposed antenna is designed using Rogers RT/duroid 5870, with a thickness of 0.79 mm. The antenna has an overall size of 8 mm × 8 mm with simple geometrical structure, compact size, multiband operation, high gain, and efficiency.

articleTitle: Integrated Resonant Tunneling Diode with Rectangular Waveguide I/O using Photonic Crystal Interface
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Hollow-waveguide-packaging technologies for terahertz (THz) electronic devices and integrated circuits are crucial for practical applications. In this study, a new method of packaging an active device using the dielectric waveguide interface is proposed, which offers an easy fabrication and lower insertion loss at THz frequencies, compared with the conventional metallic waveguide approach. We employ a photonic crystal waveguide as a dielectric transmission line, and apply the proposed packaging technique to a resonant tunneling diode (RTD). Using packaged RTD module, we demonstrate 17-Gbit/s error-free wireless communication in the 300-GHz-band.

articleTitle: Beyond the "Dynamic range" approach In noise evaluation for Terahertz Time domain spectrometers
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: THz–TDS is used for a myriad of purposes. Still, today, the usual way to compare different systems in terms of signal to noise ratio is to look at the dynamic range. We propose here a more reliable method based on statistics and will show results on two systems (Toptica and Menlo).

articleTitle: 600-GHz-band Silicon Dielectric Waveguide Module
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We propose a novel 600-GHz-band silicon dielectric waveguide module for terahertz-band applications. The I/O interface of the proposed module is compatible with a standard waveguide flange, WR-1.5, which is intended for use with other conventional hollow-waveguide-packaged components. The design and fabrication of the module is evaluated based on both simulation and experimental results. Using this module, an insertion loss as low as 0.2 dB was achieved, thereby indicating its superiority over the conventional metallic hollow waveguide in the 600 GHz band.

articleTitle: Real-time near-field terahertz spectroscopy imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this work, we applied terahertz near-field microscope based electro-optic sampling to animal tissue imaging. As a label-free diagnostic technique, fast THz near-field imaging system with a micrometer-scale spatial resolution can be constructed as an intraoperative diagnostic device for cancer clinical detection.

articleTitle: A 5G/terahertz Integrated Wireless Network Based on Wavelength-Division Multiplexing and Terahertz Photomixing
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, we have demonstrated a 5G/terahertz integrated wireless network, significantly shrinking down the construction and maintenance cost; this integrated system prototype has shown several desirable advantages - low cost, easy to operate, and ultra-broadband frequency tunability.

articleTitle: 94-GHz CMOS on-Chip Antenna Based on Stacked Dielectric Resonators and Substrate Integrated Waveguide Multi-Feed Network
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper presents a 94-GHz 3-D on-chip antenna (OCA) based on stacked dielectric resonator and substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) multi-feed network. To isolate the losses from the lossy silicon substrate, Artificial Magnetic Conductor (AMC) is firstly utilized. Subsequently, to further enhance gain and radiation efficiency, high-permittivity dielectric resonator, off-chip ground and slot feeding are employed. To improve equivalent isotropically radiated power (EIRP), on-chip power combining is proposed by using SIW multi-feed network, which is consisted of an array of microstrip line and SIW in standard 65nm CMOS technology. On-chip multi-feed antenna can almost maintain the same bandwidth and radiation pattern with the increase of numbers of input feeding, which improves the total radiated power. The results show that proposed approach is an attractive candidate for 94-GHz radar image application.

articleTitle: Moving Target Shadow Detection and Tracking based on THz Video-SAR
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz video SAR can perform high-resolution imaging of targets in a short period of time, which is conducive to detection and tracking of ground moving targets. A new method is proposed in this paper for moving target shadow detection and tracking, which is verified on terahertz band data for the first time. According to the specific characteristics of terahertz video SAR images, this method is realized by change detection through background modeling and image difference. In the experiment, the effectiveness of proposed method is verified by the terahertz video-SAR images.

articleTitle: Metasurfaces for phase/polarization manipulation and imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Metasurfaces, the two-dimensional counterpart of metamaterials, enable an unprecedented capability in manipulating the phase, polarization and amplitude of electromagnetic waves. Here, we have proposed and experimentally demonstrated an approach to realize terahertz multi-foci metalens with polarization-rotated focal points. The THz polarization-dependent imaging is demonstrated based on the multi-foci metalens. In addition, the THz metalens with asymmetric focusing that can unidirectionally focus the incident THz waves into focal point was also designed and experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Development of a waveguide-type hot electron bolometer mixer at 2 THz
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We are developing a waveguide-type hot electron bolometer mixer (HEBM) at 2 THz. A membrane-type Ni-NbN HEBM device on a Si3N4 substrate was fabricated in a clean room facility of our laboratory. The membrane bridge with a size of W55 μm x L820 μm x t1 μm was supported by a Si frame with a size of 3 mm by 3 mm and a thickness of 200 μm. The device was installed in a waveguide-type mixer mount with a WR-0.51 waveguide and a diagonal horn. The measured receiver noise temperature and IF gain bandwidth are ~1,690 K in DSB and ~4 GHz which must be improved by getting the HEBM device closer to the design. We are also trying to fabricate a mixer block with a corrugated horn at 2 THz.

articleTitle: Development of Supra-THz Schottky Diode Harmonic Mixers
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, we report the development of single-ended, Schottky diode-based harmonic mixers operating at 3.5 THz and 4.7 THz, respectively. Both mixers utilize a sub-micron size Schottky diode fabricated with circuit elements on a suspended 2 µm-thick GaAs stripline circuit, and then assembled in a waveguide split-block. The diode is closely integrated with the RF-waveguide, resulting in an electrically small and compact circuit. For the 3.5-THz, ×6-harmonic mixer, a conversion loss of about 60 dB was measured at an intermediate frequency (IF) of 200 MHz. The predicted mixer performance versus dc bias agrees well with the measurements. Based on these results, the preliminary design and simulation results of a 4.7-THz, ×8-harmonic mixer, are presented.

articleTitle: An FDD-based Full-Duplex Sub-THz Interconnect with Data-rate of 22.6 Gb/s and Energy-Efficiency of 1.58pJ/bit
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A full-duplex sub-THz interconnect based on Frequency Division Duplex (FDD) scheme is proposed for high data-rate and bandwidth-density chip-to-chip communications. The system consists of a dual-band transmitter (TX), receiver (RX), and Si dielectric waveguide (DWG) channel that provides low in-band insertion loss (IL) and high isolation in the two adjacent frequency bands. A full-duplex measurement was set up with Pseudo Random Binary Sequence (PRBS) length of 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">31</sup>-1. With the Bit Error Rates (BER) < 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−12</sup>, Channel 1 at 140 GHz and Channel 2 at 180 GHz achieve simultaneous On-Off Keying (OOK) modulated data rates of 12.3 Gb/s and 10.3 Gb/s, respectively. This full duplex interconnect system achieves the energy efficiency of 1.58 pJ/b and the record bandwidth density of 150.7 Gb/s/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: High-resolution Terahertz near-field reflection measurements for complementary non-destructive inspection of integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present here Terahertz (THz) near-field imaging results providing important supplementary information for the detection of counterfeit electronic hardware. By using near-field transceiver microprobes we are able to perform depth-resolved measurements at packaged integrated circuits below the diffraction limits of conventional THz far-field tools and without the draw-backs of ionizing x-ray imaging. The applied reflection-mode can be used e.g. for the inspection of multi-layer structures, the localization of deviations from standard structures and the investigation of samples on THz opaque substrates. In this work we show as an example the detection of hidden discrepancies between externally identical ICs.

articleTitle: Microwave Notch Filters for Plasma Diagnostics, Numerical Simulation by Method of Moments with Mode Matching
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A method of moments (MoM) with mode matching is proposed for numerical simulation of waveguide components including cavity resonators. Waveguide Ka-band notch filters with cavity resonators were simulated by the proposed method and manufactured; their simulated and measured characteristics were in a good agreement. Using proposed method the notch filter with pyramidal shape resonator was simulated and designed. Attenuation of 52 dB was achieved at notch frequency of 240 GHz, which makes the filter to be promising in plasma diagnostics systems in a prototype of an industrial fusion reactor of the next generation (DEMO).

articleTitle: Figure-of-Merits Mismatch in Liquid Crystals mmWave Phase Shifters
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This work conducts computational analysis into a liquid crystal (LC) based enclosed coplanar waveguide (ECPW) phase shifter, comparing among 16 types of LC respectively at 60 GHz. Results reveal a mismatch between the patterns of the device’s figure-of-merit (FoM, the ratio of maximum differential phase shift to maximum insertion loss) and those of the LC materials’ intrinsic FoM (the ratio of tunability to dissipation factor). Noteworthy, phase shifters with GT7-29001 and MDA-03-2838 obtain the highest FoM for devices, outperforming those filled with GT5-28004 and TUD-566 claimed with the highest FoM for materials.

articleTitle: Channel Measurements of 0.9-1.1 THz Wireless Links using VNA Extenders
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The paper preliminarily examines the influence of ultra-broadband terahertz (THz) communication channels across 900 GHz (0.9 THz) to 1100 GHz (1.1 THz) frequency spectrum in manifold scenarios. The channel measurements employing identical diagonal horns (WM-250) at both ends are firstly accomplished for 1000λ, 1500λ and 2000λ separation distances - λ specified for center frequency. Proceeding further, 5mm-, 10mm-and 20mm-acrylic plates are introduced midway to achieve a distant look through in this THz-VNA bistatic setup. Next, the ground reflections are investigated by interchanging aluminum plate and wood. Lastly, ray-tracing misalignment simulations are conducted with the same CST MWS designed horns to elaborate these measurement investigations.

articleTitle: Oscillations at 300-400 GHz in Structure-Simplified Resonant-Tunneling-Diode Oscillators with Rectangular-Cavity Resonators
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrated oscillations of resonant-tunneling-diode (RTD) terahertz oscillators with rectangular-cavity resonators operating at 300-400 GHz range. We proposed a simplified oscillator structure to reduce fabrication process and a multi-layer resist process to form the cavity resonator. The oscillation with large RTD mesa areas was obtained, which indicates the possibility of high output power, although the structure has not yet been optimized in terms of the antenna length and RTD current density. The experimental results agreed with theoretical calculations, and high output power is expected by the structure optimization.

articleTitle: Tensor-Based Terahertz Compressive Sensing Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper presents a novel tensor-based compressive sensing model for terahertz single-pixel imaging system, which features extremely low computational complexity for the image reconstruction and facilitates the realization of highresolution terahertz imaging systems.

articleTitle: Broadband Power Distribution using Multi-Mode Leaky-Wave Lens Antennas at Submillimeter Wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, we will present a novel quasi-optical power distribution technique that will allow achieving an efficient multi-pixel LO power distribution for submillimeter-wave instruments. This method can distribute the power from one antenna to a multi-pixel lens array in a hexagonal configuration with a power coupling efficiency of nearly 60%. We will present a prototype based on a transmit array of 7 pixels at WR1.5.

articleTitle: Terahertz Radar with High Resolution Range Profile
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, the performance of terahertz (THz) radar based on high resolution range profile (HRRP) is described. This terahertz radar, developed for the high resolution imaging under the complex environment such as sand-dust weather and so on, operates at 230GHz over multiple GHz of bandwidth. First, we used a small corner reflector as the calibration object to build a nonlinear error correction model. Then, a large corner reflector was placed ~1 kilometer (km) away as the target to acquire the range profile, which was used to check if the calibrator plays the roles. Finally, the HRRP of car was acquired and analyzed. Such high resolution radar can be used in some carborne, airborne or other high-speed platforms for the synthetic aperture radar (SAR) applications.

articleTitle: 3D printing of a metallic helix for traveling wave tube amplifiers operating in millimeter wave range
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Traveling wave tube (TWT) amplifiers reach the highest output powers at mm-wave and THz frequencies. However, at these frequencies the slow-wave structures (SWS) reach a limit of manufacturing. In this paper, a 3D additive micromanufacturing technique (µAM) was used to fabricate a metallic helix. The helix has a pentagonal shape where the sides have a length of about 100 µm. The fabricated helix can be used as SWS in a TWT amplifier operating in a frequency range between 50 and 80 GHz. Simulations showed that the TWT can reach a gain higher than 30 dB at 77GHz and a 3 dB bandwidth of about 2 GHz.

articleTitle: Association of the terahertz refractive index and morphological dilation operations for breast carcinoma detection
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Breast conservative surgeries are performed to remove the cancer and the surrounding tissue while preserving the breast itself. The precise definition of breast tumor margins is essential to reduce the re-excision rate. In that context, the potential of morphological dilations applied to terahertz refractive index maps of breast tissues was investigated. Several morphological dilation geometries were studied. The method has shown a sensitivity of around 80% and a sensitivity of 82% for the best case. These results indicate that the combination of fundamental optical properties of tissues, denoted by the refractive index, and morphological dilation may open avenues for defining accompanying procedures in breast-conserving surgery.

articleTitle: Spatially-Extended Sub-GW Surface-Wave Oscillators Operating from Ка- to W-Band for Powering Systems of Compton FELs
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Spatially-extended high-power Cherenkov masers intended to be used in powering systems of Compton-type FELs are under development in IAP RAS (Nizhny Novgorod) at the "Sinus-6" accelerator 0.5 MeV / 5 kA / 20 ns.
