articleTitle: Numerical Computation of Hydrodynamic Equations Based on Dyakonov-Shur Instability
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The numerical solutions for the hydrodynamic equations based on Dyakonov-Shur (DS) instability theory are obtained by means of Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) method and COMSOL Multiphysics software, respectively. The amplitudes and oscillation frequencies of the source current density and drain electron number areal density are achieved, and the plasma wave along the channel at different moments are analyzed. The influence of gate length and gate voltage on the frequency and strength of plasma oscillation are studied as well. The results computed through these two methods are well consistent with each other, which verified the accuracy of the simulation results.

articleTitle: THz TDS of SmartFilms® Loaded with Indomethacin
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: SmartFilms<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> loaded with different amounts of indomethacin (IM) were prepared, compressed into tablets and investigated using THz TDS in transmission geometry. Corresponding physical mixtures were also prepared, transferred into tablets and investigated. Furthermore, complementary x-ray diffraction (XRD) measurements were performed. The results suggest that IM loaded in smartFilms was kept in its amorphous state for the lowest loading and recrystallized for higher loadings.

articleTitle: Logic Operations Based on Terahertz Surface Polaritons
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A series of surface plasmonic logic devices in the terahertz band have been designed, including OR, XOR, NOT, XNOR gates. The basic principle of the logic operation is based on the linear interference caused by the phase difference between the waveguides. The numerical simulations based on the finite-difference time-domain are carried out and the results demonstrate the validity of the proposed method. This approach provides an effective approach for the construction of next generation of integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Frequency Increase in Resonant-Tunneling Diode Cavity-type Terahertz Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We achieved increase in oscillation frequency of about 250 GHz for resonant-tunneling diode (RTD) THz oscillator with cylindrical cavity resonator. The improvement of oscillation characteristics was achieved at RTD mesa areas of around 0.6 –0.7 μm2 by elimination of parasitic capacitance and optimization of resonator dimensions. Measured frequency characteristics were in good agreement with calculation results.

articleTitle: Physical model for evaluating propagation loss of metal-coated dielectric terahertz waveguides
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Propagation loss of Au-coated parallel-plate waveguides was studied. A physical model to evaluate propagation loss was derived and experimentally validated. It revealed that the electrical conductivity of the coating metal, which differs from the bulk conductivity and depends on film thickness due to the thin- film effect, is the dominant factor determining the loss in addition to film thickness. Our model enables us to anticipate the propagation loss in the metal-coated dielectric waveguides with various film thickness, frequency, coating metal, and waveguide geometry using experimentally obtained film thickness and its thickness-dependent conductivity.

articleTitle: Staggered Double-vane Slow-wave Structure with Attenuators for a 220 GHz Sheet Beam Traveling-wave Tube
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a staggered double-vane slow-wave structure (SWS) with attenuators for a 220 GHz sheet beam traveling-wave tube (TWT) is studied. The TWT consists of a staggered double-vane SWS with 75 periods, two identical L- shaped couplers, and a pair of transition sections with 5 periods. The simulation results show that S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf> is below –39.9 dB in the frequency range of 201–252 GHz, and the voltage standing wave ratio is less than 1.42. Besides, the simulation results of beam-wave interaction show that this staggered double-vane SWS with attenuators is suitable for employment in the 220 GHz sheet beam TWT.

articleTitle: THz-TDS and TRTS of Metal Organic Frameworks and 2D Materials
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Commercial success of solar cells clearly demonstrates that an environmental-friendly future is achievable. The next generation of solar cells will depend on novel materials, including 2D materials and metal-organic frameworks (MOF). We will present THz-TDS measurements of MOFs and TRTS measurements of 2D materials, showcasing THz spectroscopy as an outstanding technique to characterize emerging materials and providing insight into their photophysics and, in turn, their potential for future solar applications.

articleTitle: Transient and Steady-State Response of AlGaN/GaN Terahertz Detectors under Sinusoidal Excitation of Different Intensities
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz field effect transistors (TeraFETs) based on AlGaN/GaN materials have high responsivity and sensitivity at room temperature. Based on the hydrodynamic equations, the nonlinear voltage response (transient and steady-state) of this type of THz detector was numerically calculated by finite difference method under THz excitation with different frequencies and intensities. Comparisons with the existing analytical formula and the analysis of the influence of viscosity coefficient on the response were also presented.

articleTitle: Vibrational Nonlinear Response of Liquids Far from Resonance in THz Frequency Range
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this work the dispersion of nonlinear refractive index n2 (vibrational third-order nonlinear response) is estimated for various liquids used in THz photonics – water, ethanol, and isopropanol. To calculate n2 we use the theoretical model that considers known physical, linear and nonlinear optical parameters of liquids. The variation in n2 dispersion in the frequency range with nonresonant electronic contribution for water and ethanol is obtained to be around 15%, which seems to be very important to be considered for THz photonic devices’ design.

articleTitle: Investigation into two cocrystals of gliclazide using experimental vibrational spectroscopy combined with DFT theoretical simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The cocrystals of gliclazide-succinic acid and gliclazide-trometamol under grinding condition have been characterized by terahertz spectroscopical and Raman technique. Spectral results show that both cocrystals have been successfully obtained. The structure of pharmaceutical cocrystal formation has also been characterized with THz spectra.

articleTitle: Long-Infrared Passive Near-field Spectroscopic Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Local phenomena of materials generate strongly localized electromagnetic wave, called thermally excited evanescent waves, in the long-wavelength infrared spectra range. In order to directly detect the spectroscopic information of the thermally excited evanescent wave, we have developed passive near-field optical spectroscopy (SNOS) based on grating-based spectroscopy. Using the passive SNOS, we achieved detecting the thermally excited evanescent waves on an Au/SiC micropattern sample at different wavelengths. The detected near-field signals were well consistent with the electromagnetic local density of states of SiC and Au. Passive SNOS will be a powerful tool for numerous spectroscopic applications including a surface chemical analysis.

articleTitle: Upconversion detection of picosecond terahertz pulses
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present our work on terahertz detection using an upconversion approach operating in the near infrared regime, as published in [1]. Using periodically poled lithium niobate, terahertz radiation is upconverted to the optical spectrum, which enables the use of sCMOS technology to detect the signal. Both terahertz and optical sources emit pulses in the picosecond regime, offering precise timing information suitable for time-of-flight measurements.

articleTitle: Development of a MW-level Dual-frequency Gyrotron for Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A 105GHz/140GHz MW-level gyrotron has been developed aiming for fusion application at Institute of Applied Electronics. The gyrotron employed a triode magnetron injection gun, a cylindrical cavity working under a TE18,7 mode for 105GHz and a TE24,9 mode for 140GHz. A built-in quasi-optical mode converter, a single-stage depressed collector and a boron nitride single-disk window were adopted in the tube. In the short-pulse (1ms) proof-test, due to limitation of the high-voltage power source, the dual-frequency gyrotron achieved output powers of 300kW at 105 GHz and 540kW at 140 GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: The Influence of Crude Oil Carbon Content, Sulfur Content and Density on Absorption Coefficient and Refractive Index in the 0.2-2.5THz Band
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to classify the sources and types of crude oils from different oil fields in different countries and regions with terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS). We measured and calculated the refractive index and absorption coefficient of 173 samples of crude oil taken from different countries and regions based THz-TDS. The unary linear regression models is applied to analyze the relationship between crude oil density, carbon content, sulfur content with average refractive index and absorption coefficient respectively. However, the result shows that the correlation coefficients are low and the refractive index and absorption coefficient of crude oil is not determined by single factor such as density, carbon content and sulfur content, but is affected by comprehensive factors.

articleTitle: Dielectric Properties of 3D Printed Alumina in the THz Range
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The dielectric terahertz (THz) properties of two 3D printed alumina (Al2O3) samples were determined using THz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS). The samples showed a low absorption coefficient (α < 2 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> below 1 THz) and a high refractive index (n > 3). Furthermore, the two samples show birefringence (Δn ≈ 0.05), which we attribute to the formation of crystalline solids during the additive manufacturing process. The two samples operate as λ/2 wave plates at approximately 1 THz.

articleTitle: Enhanced terahertz Smith-Purcell radiation using an inclined flat electron-beam to drive Fabry-Pérot resonator arrays
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Besides transition radiation (TR) and synchrotron radiation (SR), Smith-Purcell radiation (SPR) is a simple method to generate powerful terahertz emission. Yet, as the distance from grating surface to electron trajectory increases, the SPR intensity decays exponentially due to the effective interaction range[1] ${h_{\operatorname{int} }} = \frac{\lambda }{{4\pi }}\beta \gamma $. The radiation efficiency is greatly reduced beyond the effective interaction range especially for large diameter beams. To increase the coupling efficiency, an inclined flat electron beam is used in this paper. Meanwhile, the Fabry-Pérot resonator arrays take place of the ordinary grating to achieve higher radiation power. This new method of SPR reduces the requirement of electron beam and enhances the radiation intensity. To verify the theory, an electron gun from SJTU is used in experiment, the results of which agree with theoretical analyses and simulations..

articleTitle: Discovery of Superluminal Two-Dimensional Plasma Waves
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report the discovery of "superluminal" electromagnetic 2D plasma waves in the electromagnetic response of a high-quality GaAs/AlGaAs two-dimensional electron system on a dielectric substrate. We measure the plasma wave spectrum on samples with different electron density. It is established that at large two-dimensional densities, there is a strong hybridization between the plasma and the Fabry-Perot light modes. In the presence of a perpendicular magnetic field, the plasma resonance is shown to split into two modes, each corresponding to a particular sense of circular polarization.

articleTitle: Ultrafast plasmon thermalization in epitaxial graphene probed by time-resolved THz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We use optical pump—terahertz (THz) probe spectroscopy to investigate ultrafast sheet conductivity dynamics in various epitaxial graphene layers grown on SiC. Inhomogeneities in graphene layers developed during the growth are at the origin of confinement potentials for the charge carriers. The transient response is governed by the heating and cooling of localized plasmonic excitations induced by the confinement. We show that the spectra are entirely controlled by the temperature (and chemical potential) of carriers undergoing a supercollision cooling process in all studied epigraphene layers representing a large variety of carbon allotropes.

articleTitle: Investigation and optimized design of 0.14THz double-grating extended interaction oscillator
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a double-grating sheet beam extended interaction oscillator (SB-EIO) based on 0.14THz is designed and optimized. The resonant cavity is operated in TM110-2π mode. By comparing the beam-wave interaction characteristics of single output and double output structures, it is found that the double output structure can increase the peak power to 4.111kW and the beam-wave interaction efficiency is 1.3%. At the same time, the electron flow rate has also been increased by about 8%.

articleTitle: Nelly: An Open-Source Package for Complex Refractive Index Extraction for Terahertz Spectroscopy on Layered Samples
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: As researchers have begun to apply THz spectroscopy to increasingly novel materials and THz spectrometers have become more widely available, the need has arisen for data workup techniques that both avoid approximations and are accessible to a wide range of researchers. Here, we present Nelly, a software package that uses a tree-based algorithm to perform complex refractive index extraction for any layered sample geometry without invoking approximations. It is provided as a MATLAB library and graphical user interface (GUI) for ease of use. We have tested it using CST simulations to verify that it gives accurate results for various sample geometries.

articleTitle: Assessing Changes in Human Skin Using in vivo Terahertz Measurements
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz (THz) frequencies have a strong sensitivity to water, a property which has led to research into ways to utilize this property for non-invasive in vivo diagnostics. This research investigates the ability of measurements using THz light to identify changes induced in the skin by various skin products. These studies enhance the understanding of how THz light could be used for in vivo measurements in the future.

articleTitle: Broadband Waveguid-to-CPWG Transition With Butterfly-shaped Dipole
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A broadband rectangular waveguide-to-coplanar waveguide with ground transition for large-chip-width substrate operating within terahertz frequencies (230-320GHz) is demonstrated in this work. This transition adopts a dipole antenna with butterfly-shaped coupling branches. This compact transition reduces parasitic effects by wire bonding and is suitable for direct integration with terahertz monolithic integrated circuits. The transition was designed based on a 50 μm thick InP technology and designed for standard waveguide (432×864 μm). The simulated results show that the bandwidth is as wide as 90 GHz, and the in-band return loss is better than 14 dB.

articleTitle: Molecular alignment stimulated by the coupled pulses of the ultrashort laser pulse and the terahertz pulse
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Field-free molecular alignment can be induced by the strong ultrashort laser pulses. Here, the improvement of the alignment is completed by the coupled pulses of the ultrashort laser pulse and the strong broadband terahertz pulse. The gaseous CO molecules are aligned by such coupled pulses, and the evolution of its states are studied based on the rigid rotor approximation theory with the simulation method. The influences of the pulses parameters on the alignment are also discussed.

articleTitle: Quantum ratchet broadband THz detector
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present world’s first ultra-wide spectral range quantum ratchet THz detector. It can detect the spectral range from 4 THz to 200 THz. The detector also shows evident photocurrent even at zero bias and presents a bias-tunable photoresponse characteristic. Additionally, the quantum ratchet detector exhibits pronounced rectification behavior at the temperature below 77 K owing to the ratchet effect, which makes it promising to improve the operation temperature.

articleTitle: THz conversion efficiency in DSTMS limited by high-order nonlinearities
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We have studied the THz generation in DSTMS using a quasi-3D model that takes into account high-order nonlinear effects beyond the χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> nonlinearity. The nonlinear refractive index (Kerr effect) and three-photon absorption (3PA) coefficients for the wavelength of 1.4 μm utilized in the model were determined by the Z-scan method. The simulation results are in good agreement with the experimentally measured THz and near-infrared spectra, confirming the validity of the proposed model. Our analysis shows that the 3PA process mainly limits THz generation in DSTMS at high pump fluences. The cascaded optical rectification further decreases THz conversion efficiency due to the spectral broadening of the excitation pulse.

articleTitle: A 340G sub-harmonic mixer based on Schottky diode
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, we design a 340GHz sub-harmonic mixer base on a planar Schottky diode. Two low pass filters with compact microstrip resonance cell(CMRC) configurations are used to realize wide RF and IF bands. The measured results show that, in RF frequency range 316-340GHz, a Single Sideband(SSB) conversion loss is better than −17.58dB operating at IF frequency 40GHz with the LO power of 4.5dBm. Compared with a traditional mixer, this mixer requires low LO power with low conversion loss and has wider IF output bandwidth.

articleTitle: Observation of High Precision Frequency Tuning of Terahertz Quantum Cascade Lasers Employing a Laser Beating Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate a laser beating system to investigate the frequency tuning characteristics of terahertz quantum cascade lasers (QCLs) induced by temperature or drive current. The system is composed of two QCLs, one is operated as a frequency comb and the other is driven at lower current to emit a single frequency. Experimental results show that the frequency tuning coefficients of the terahertz QCL are 6.1 MHz/0.1 K (temperature tuning) and 2.7 MHz/mA (current tuning) that have not been revealed by traditional terahertz spectrometers.

articleTitle: Vortex Smith-Purcell Radiation based on Archimedean Spiral Grating
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A free-electron-driven terahertz (THz) vortex generator based on Smith-Purcell radiation and Archimedean spiral grating (ASG) is proposed in this paper. The structural parameters are optimized to operate in the THz band. When the electron beam rotates around the singularity of the ASG constrained by the magnetic field, the vortex beam with the value of the topological charge of 1 can be generated above the grating. The vorticity of the vortex beam is determined by the rotation direction of the structure. For instance, if the vorticity of the ASG is anticlockwise, the topological charge of the vortex beam should be +1. The proposed scheme indicates its promising applications in developing compact on-chip THz vortex generators and the next-generation communication technology based on orbital angular momentum multiplexing.

articleTitle: Measurement of dielectric properties of human sweat in terahertz frequency region
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Human sweat is an important biofluid which contains various physiological biomarkers and these biomarkers indicate the human health conditions such as the presence of some diseases and illness. Information of such biomarkers can be obtained by measuring optical characteristics of biofluids using various photonics-based measurement technologies. In this study, we used terahertz time domain spectroscopy to obtain dielectric properties of sweat in the frequency range of 200 GHz to 2 THz. This information may help design novel biosensors working in the terahertz frequency region.

articleTitle: Terahertz Generation in Nonlinear Crystals Pumped from UV to IR
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We perform THz generation by optical rectification in ZnTe, KTP and RKTP with femtosecond laser pulses whose wavelength ranges from UV to IR. We observe a strong THz emission when the pump photon energy reaches the crystal bandgap. This phenomenon is explained by the resonance of material nonlinear susceptibility around its bandgap. Additionally, for the first time, we report of a two-photon enhanced nonlinearity in KTP/RKTP, which leads to an enhanced THz emission near half the bandgap.

articleTitle: Independently Controlled HEMT-embedded Metasurface for Terahertz Amplitude and Phase Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An independently controlled programmable metasurface for terahertz (THz) wavefront modulation is proposed here. Based on ultrafast electrically controlled HEMT-embedded resonant structure arranged in a supercell manner, the reflective amplitude and phase can be dynamically manipulated with the variation of carrier concentrations within the two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG). Corroborated through the simulation and measurement, a 88% max modulation depth and a 111° max phase shift have been attained, which suggests the presented metasurface may motivate developments on smart surfaces for the next generation of high-speed wireless communications.

articleTitle: Relativistic plasma excitations in two-dimensional electron systems
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Microwave absorption of a two-dimensional electron system (2DES) with a disk-shaped metallic gate, electrically connected to the 2DES perimeter, has been investigated. In addition to the dipole proximity plasma excitation, special "charged" relativistic plasmon has been observed. It has demonstrated very unusual behaviour, including dependency of its properties on the external connecting wire parameters. The observed properties are supposed to be connected with the hybridization of this plasmon and the photon mode in the external connection wire.

articleTitle: Terahertz dielectric properties of guanylurea hydrogen phosphite crystal
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The monoclinic crystal of guanylurea(1+) hydrogen phosphite (GUHP) is a novel efficient nonlinear-optical medium having high χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> and χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> values. We used THz-TDS with high polarization contrast to study the absorption coefficient and the refractive index of the crystal in the range of 0.2—1.5 THz. We found that the dielectric frame xyz at 1 THz is rotated 16 degrees from the visible range. Absorption spectra show peaks at 0.93, 1.02, and 1.45 THz representing high-Q resonances. The last two modes show very high Raman activity that can be associated with the interlayer collective movement of the crystal. We assume that GUHP has the potential to be a basis for active and passive terahertz devices manufacturing.

articleTitle: THz frequency, Goniometric scanning system for human cornea using off-axis parabolic mirrors
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An efficient method for rapid, non-contact scanning of human cornea is presented. The optics utilize two, 101.6-mm diameter off-axis parabolic mirrors fed by a goniometrically scanned, planar mirror. An evaluation system at 650 GHz was built and demonstrated ~ 1.5 mm beam radius on target and ~ 30° x 30° field of view. The system was inspired by confocal laser scanning principles and represents a system design where image acquisition time is limited by SNR, not mechanical translation.

articleTitle: Computer tomography defect diagnosis with carbon nanotube terahertz photo-scanner toward multi-view and multi-frequency image reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: To relax the harmful X-ray invasiveness for testing targets caused in conventional computed tomography (CT) measurements, developing system configurations with lower frequency irradiation is essential. Here, this paper demonstrates a simple terahertz CT measurement scheme with a carbon nanotube (CNT) film-based flexible uncooled broadband photo-detector. The physical properties of the CNT film device would govern omni-directional and multi-frequency CT sensing towards highly-functional target material analysis.

articleTitle: Terahertz Absorption Characteristics of Ammonium Salt Solution Based on Self-Sampling Microfluidic Chip
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this study, a sandwich terahertz microfluidic chip with high transmission to terahertz wave was designed. The terahertz transmission spectra of distilled water, 0.9 mol/L NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>Cl, (NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, (NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>COONH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> were measured by combining the chip with terahertz technology. The experimental results show that at the same concentration, the THz spectra of different ammonium salt solutions are obviously different, which indicates that the hydration process of ions has an effect on the hydrogen bond between water molecules, and is reflected in the terahertz transmission spectrum.

articleTitle: A VALIDATION STUDY of the BWIC Code, a 1-D Large Signal Code
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A steady-state 1-D code called BWIC is developed. The validation of the code is performed and comprehensive results for a 1-THz staggered double vane TWT are presented in this paper. Results from the BWIC code show good agreement with output power, gain, and drive curve of the CST.

articleTitle: Acoustic Plasmons and Cherenkov Radiation Excited by Low-Energy Electrons in Nonlocal Graphene Hyperbolic Metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Cherenkov radiation (CR) is no doubt that one of the most important kinds of radiation which is generated in different frequencies, by not only electronic but photonic ways. In this work, we use low-energy electrons to excite CR in graphene hyperbolic metamaterials (GMM). In this situation, the velocity of the electrons can be less than the speed of light in the dielectric. In addition, when we consider the effect of the nonlocal properties of the graphene itself, the electron velocity should within a special range. Specifically, the low-limit is just the Fermi velocity of the graphene, and the high-limit is the original low-limit for conventional CR. Our results show the possibility of novel compact free-electron based terahertz radiation source, which are of great value to the research to not only the physics of CR itself, but the further understanding of light-matter interactions in graphene-based devices.

articleTitle: Multifunctional Spatial Mode Multiplexers Based on All-Dielectric Metasurfaces Working at Terahertz Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Mode division multiplexing (MDM) is a promising technique for improving data transmission rates in the booming terahertz communication realm. Mode converter and multiplexer play an important role in MDM systems. Here, the silicon based spatial mode multiplexer is proposed to convert the fundamental Gaussian modes to HG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> mode and HG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> mode according to the incident polarizations, respectively. By superposing the phase distribution of a meta-lens and a deflector, the converted modes realize designable focusing function as well. The results may inspire multiplexer R&D and promote terahertz communication.

articleTitle: Magneto-electric control of polarization in spintronic terahertz emitters
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Magnetoelectric control of the emitted polarization of THz waves was demonstrated for the first time in spintronic emitters thanks to the use of a magnetostrictive ferromagnetic layer in an emitter deposited on top of a ferroelectric relaxor substrate.

articleTitle: Detecting terahertz waves with glow discharge detectors by electrical and optical methods
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A glow discharge detector (GDD) was found to be an effective room temperature terahertz (THz) radiation detector. Based on the phenomenon that the incident THz radiation can increases the discharge current and the luminescent intensity of the GDD, two operation modes were investigated. The electrical method is to detect the change of discharge current, and the optical method is to detect the change of GDD luminescence caused by incident THz wave.

articleTitle: H2S photoacoustic detection with an integrated THz gas sensor for food quality control
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: THz photoacoustic (PA) detection of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S gas concentrations on the order of 200 ppm using a Poly-Si membrane as a PA microphone is reported. This result is a first step towards the demonstration of a fully integrated THz PA gas sensor with an expected sensitivity of 10’s of ppb.

articleTitle: Terahertz Shielding Enabled by the Micro-Porous Structure of Melamine Resin Sponge
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Melamine resin sponges have a porous cell structure on the micrometer scale, comparable to the terahertz wavelength. Hydrating the sponge with water introduces a micro-scale rough surface which greatly attenuates the terahertz reflection. When combined with the high absorption of water, the hydrated sponge shows a perfect shielding characteristic by reflecting less than 1% of the light intensity in 0.75-3.5 THz.

articleTitle: High-order Overmoded Based Multiple Sheet Electron Beam Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The methodology of using the comibination of high-order overmoded slow-wave structure (SWS) and multiple sheet electron beams to increase the output power of traveling-wave tubes or backward-wave oscillators operating in the terahertz-band is presented in this paper. In this paper, recent studies regarding high-order overmoded (HOOM) SWS based multiple sheet electron beam devices at the Shenzhen University have been presented. To realize such an idea, we have so far proposed several kinds of novel HOOM SWS and HOOM power coupling structures. Simulation and measurement results demonstrated that they have achieved good performace.

articleTitle: Virus Detection using Metagrating in Terahertz Regime
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Due to the pandemic situation worldwide, there’s a need to develop rapid and sensitive diagnosis method for detecting different viruses. In this paper using simulation, we present a metamaterial which could be useful for a sensitive and non-contact detection of the virus in the terahertz (THz) regime. We studied angular scanning of THz wave on polymer-based metagrating, to achieve strong and broadband coupling with the analyte layer due to Guided-Mode Resonance (GMR). We observed the resonance shift of the structure following the deposition of varying concentrations and thickness of the virus layer on the surface of the structure. The proposed THz detection method suggests a rapid and low-cost diagnosis, especially useful for dangerous viruses and biomaterials.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of a High Order Mode Multi-Sheet Beam R-Band Extended Interaction Oscillator Based on Carbon-Nanotube Cold Cathode
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An Extended Interaction Oscillator (EIO) with five electron beams, which operates at a higher order mode, is simulated. The operation of multiple electron beams in a high¬order cavity means that a higher total electron beam current interacts with a large cavity field energy to obtain a higher output power. Particle-in-cell (PIC) simulation shows that the EIO operating at TM51 mode has an output power of about 13 W at 301 GHz when the electron beam voltage and current density are 19.85 kV and 60 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> respectively.

articleTitle: Quantifying water absorption of hygrothermally aged epoxies with terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate how terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) can be used to quantify water absorption in hygrothermally aged simple and commercial epoxy systems supported by conventional gravimetric analysis.

articleTitle: Optimized multilayer structure for sensitive THz characterization of thin-film aqueous solutions
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Here we present an optimized multilayer structure for sensitive characterization of thin-film aqueous solutions with reflection terahertz time-domain spectroscopy. The theoretical sensitivity is compared with a recently published sensitive structure and other ordinary geometries. Glucose solutions with a 5% concentration gradient are measured for accuracy verification.

articleTitle: Spectrum-to-space mapping with 0.36 – 0.4 THz on-chip transceiver for one-shot localization
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this article, we demonstrated the single-shot 1D and 2D localization of wireless nodes using spectrum to space mapping principle by utilizing dual-port frequency dispersive antennas. The system is realized on an industry-standard 65-nm CMOS platform. The integrated chip operates within the frequency range of 360-400 GHz consisting of on-chip transceiver back-end. Using this implemented system, the angular localization accuracy of less than 2 degrees in 1D and 2D space is achieved. This approach significantly reduces the link discovery complexity in comparison with other existing iterative methods that involve time-consuming beam-scanning techniques.

articleTitle: An Electrically Controlled Metasurface for Electromagnetically Induced Transparency
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A new type of electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) structures composed of meanderline and U-shaped resonators were theoretically and experimentally proposed in the terahertz regime, which could exhibit strong EIT phenomenon. The meanderline structure provides an effective manner for realizing electric controlled EIT devices due to its continuous connection feature which is convenient to serve as integrated electrode, which is verified by simulations where vanadium dioxide (VO2) structures are further integrated. An EIT modulation behavior is observed and the group delay at the transmission window frequency are changed accordingly.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Airborne Microwave Atmospheric Temperature and Humidity Sounder
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The Microwave Atmospheric Temperature and Humidity Sounder (MATHS) is a 20-channel cross-track scanning microwave radiometer that can be utilized for sounding the atmospheric temperature and humidity profiles from an airplane with a maximum fight altitude of 5km. The design scheme of MATHS is demonstrated, including the system configuration, operational bands, multi-band antenna, receiver types, and calibration methods. In addition, some inflight sounding results are also presented to verify the instrument’s significance.

articleTitle: Observation of Negative THz Photoconductivity Induced by the Formation of Polaron in Low Temperature Phase of Weyl Semimetal MoTe2
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: By using optical pump THz probe spectroscopy, the transient photoconductivity (Δσ) of semimetallic MoTe2 thin film was investigated in the temperature range from 5K to 290 K. For 1T’-MoTe2, at room temperature, photoexcitation induces positive THz Δσ that decays within a few picoseconds. In contrast, the negative THz Δσ of MoTe2 appears at low temperature following the initial positive Δσ. The negative Δσ relaxes to the equilibrium within time scale of nanoseconds. The negative Δσ in MoTe2 at low temperature is ascribed to the formation of small polaron in Weyl semimetal phase.

articleTitle: Infrared spectrum tailoring based on refractory transition-metal silicides disordered metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Broadband and spectrally selective absorbers/emitters are realized based on refractory transition-metal silicides disordered metamaterials, which give a simple way to tailor infrared spectrum. The proposed disordered metamaterials provide a promising and low cost absorber/emitter for thermophotovoltaics and many other applications.

articleTitle: Sample size-dependence of thermal evanescent fields in electrically biased graphene devices
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We study a sample size-dependence of current-induced thermal evanescent fields occurring on graphene constriction devices with a passive scanning near-field microscope. We find that the excess current manifesting itself as fluctuating electromagnetic evanescent fields generated on the graphene surface. The near-field signals largely increased with increasing current in the constricted region. With the same current, the near-field signal on graphene is sensitive to various widths but insensitive to various lengths. This result agrees with the simulation results calculated by finite-element method.

articleTitle: Intense-Terahertz-Wave-Induced Crystallization in Poly(lactic) Acid with Terahertz Free Electron Laser
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Modification of structure and morphology of polymers has attracted great interest, because their physical properties such as mechanical strength and thermal property strongly depend on their structure and morphology. In particular, the structural change associated with crystallization drastically modifies their physical properties. In this work, we report on the intense-terahertz-wave-induced crystallization of poly(lactic) acid with the terahertz free electron laser (THz-FEL). The moderate THz-FEL irradiation causes the α-phase crystallization in the PLA thin film. This result indicates that the THz-FEL is one of the promising methods to control the morphology and structure of polymeric materials.

articleTitle: Wide dynamic range imaging system using three-stage terahertz parametric detector
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A wide dynamic range terahertz imaging system was developed using an injection-seeded terahertz parametric generator (is-TPG) and three-stage terahertz parametric detector. We achieved single-frequency imaging of samples with -93 dB attenuation, as well as spectroscopic imaging of reagents through thick shielding.

articleTitle: On the Power Radiated by Photo Conductive Sources
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The time evolution of voltages and currents in a pulsed photo conductive antenna (PCA) source is evaluated resorting to a rigorous procedure that stems from semiconductor physics first, to define the phenomena involved in the generation of the photocurrent, and then relies on an equivalent circuit in time domain, providing a direct estimation of the power generated by the PCA as well as its spectral distribution. The circuit model is validated via a campaign of measurements of standard PC antenna sources. The saturation phenomena in the THz radiated power occurring at large optical excitation levels, previously observed by the scientific community and associated to different phenomena, are accurately predicted by the present method, which ascribe their main cause to the feedback from the antenna: indeed, the electromagnetic field generated by the device tend to reduce the strength of the forcing field used to accelerate the photo-carriers.

articleTitle: Terahertz Biosensing All-Dielectric Metasurface for Bacillus Thuringiensis Cry1Ac Protein Sensing
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A biosensor based on all-dielectric terahertz metasurface for bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) Cry1Ac protein sensing was proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The resonance frequency and resonance amplitude of the devices treated with different concentrations of Bt protein solution satified a linear relationship with the concentration, which is promised to have wide application prospect in biosensing and thereby, has attracted increasing attention.

articleTitle: Researches on G-band High-Power and Broadband Extended Interaction Klystron
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a narrow coupling resonator structure with shorter cavity width has been designed to enhance the high frequency field and improve the beam-wave interaction performance. Under the condition of voltage 16.5 kV and current 0.3 A, the stable peak output power of 400 W and the 3dB bandwidth of 500MHz have been obtained. Besides, a novel high-order mode sheet-beam EIK structure operating in TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">31</inf> 2π mode is proposed. Under the condition of voltage 16.5 kV, current 0.5 A and input power 0.2W, the peak output power of 650W and 3dB bandwidth of 700 MHz have been obtained without any self-oscillation. These EIKs could improve the output power and bandwidth at millimeter-wave and terahertz band.

articleTitle: Finding the accurate permittivity model for liquid water and heavy water at different temperatures in the Terahertz range
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a study of liquid water and heavy water in the terahertz range at temperatures between 283K and 348K. We will fit our data with the fit@TDS software that provides a criterion to discriminate good models from others. We will present a comparison between the models proposed in the literature for liquid water and use this criterion to find the most accurate one.

articleTitle: Substrate Effect on Terahertz Emission in Fe/Pt Spintronic Emitters
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The choice of the substrate plays an important role for spintronic terahertz (THz) emitters (STEs). We have grown epitaxial Pt/Fe bilayer thin films on MgO and MgAl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> substrates. The THz electric field amplitude is found to be larger when Pt/Fe is grown on MgO even though the crystal quality of the Fe film is better when grown on MgAl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>. This study indicates that the Fe crystal quality affects the THz emission in Pt/Fe STEs and points to the importance of a careful choice of the substrate to enhance the THz amplitude in STEs.

articleTitle: Low-frequency Vibrational Modes of DMPG Lipid Bilayer Studied by Terahertz Spectroscopy and Solid-state Density Functional Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report a study of the low-frequency vibrational modes of the crystalline lipid bilayer of sodium 1,2-dimyristoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoryl-3′-rac-glycerol (DMPG) through an interplay between the low-temperature THz spectroscopy and solid-state density functional theory. The normal mode analysis shows the optimized structure is stable (but it may be one of the minima), and a consistent assignment of all the calculated THz bands to the observed ones has been achieved. This result represents the successful calculation of the largest molecule crystalline system, having ever been successfully calculated against the THz spectroscopic evidence to the best of our knowledge.

articleTitle: Flexible terahertz metasurface lens fabricated by ink-jet printing
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a flexible metasurface lens is proposed and demonstrated to realize beam focusing in the terahertz (THz) region. The designed metasurface lens consists of a series of silver paste rods on the film. Based on Pancharatnam-Berry phase, the modulation of phase of the scattered THz wave from 0 to 2π is realized by changing the azimuth angle of the silver paste rods. The metasurface lens is fabricated by ink-jet printing, and it has the advantages of high optical transparency and deformation. Meanwhile, due to the advantages of one-time forming and rapid processing, ink-jet printing is a very potential approach for processing of THz metasurface. Compared with the traditional lithography technology, it helps to reduce the processing flow and greatly reduce the processing cost.

articleTitle: THz characterizeation of low-conductive sheet-charges with metallic gratings
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We study the application of metallic gratings with subwavelength apertures to characterize sheet charges of very low conductivity (~μSie) in a transmission geometry. The gratings provide increased E-field enhancement and interaction length in the vicinity of the aperture which allows for enhanced absorption by the two-dimensional sheet charges, which would otherwise be undetectable in a transmission measurement. We explore the design space to obtain both broadband and resonant behavior by altering the pitch of the gratings (w.r.t. λ) in order to be applicable for both characterization and device applications.

articleTitle: Terahertz Oscilloscope for Temporal Characterization of Picosecond Relativistic Electron Beam#
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz (THz) streaking is a novel method to measure the temporal profile of a relativistic electron beam with a few femtosecond (fs) duration. Recently, a THz oscilloscope was proposed for hundred-fs metrology with a significantly increased dynamic range, which used a circular polarized THz pulse instead of a linearly polarized one. In this paper, we propose a THz oscilloscope for temporal characterization of relativistic electron beam with few picosecond (ps) duration, which is crucial for THz free-electron lasers and Thomson scattering X-ray sources, etc.

articleTitle: Hydrostatic pressure effect of photocarrier dynamics in GaAs probed by time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Hydrostatic pressure effects on photocarrier dynamics containing interband relaxations and intraband cooling in GaAs have been investigated using in situ time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy with a diamond anvil cell. The interband photocarrier lifetime significantly decreases by nearly two orders of magnitude under 10 GPa. Considerable pressure tuning for the intervalley scattering processes has also been observed, and the time constants under different pressures are extracted based on the three-state rate equation. This work provides new perspectives on tailoring nonequilibrium carrier dynamics in semiconductors using hydrostatic pressure and may serve as the impetus for the development of high-pressure THz spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Review of methods for performance evaluation of antenna-coupled THz detectors
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This contribution presents an overview of main methods what are currently used for the sensitivity, i.e., responsivity and noise equivalent power determination of state-of-the-art antenna-coupled field-effect-transistor-based THz detectors/sensors. We show that, the reported results strongly depend on the sensor effective area determination method, especially if it is not unambiguously determined leading to up to orders of magnitude discrepancy. Furthermore we illustrate our statements by presenting results of characterisation of detectors which are coupled with different antennas and presenting state-of-the-art sensitivity values.

articleTitle: A fringe suppression terahertz imaging method based on reconstruction from multiple complex-valued images
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Undesired interference fringes are one of the challenges in terahertz amplitude imaging. The paper presents a new fringe suppression complex-field imaging method based on multiple space measurements under the strong clutter environments. A Circle Approximation Method in complex field is proposed here to estimate both the sample signal intensity and the complex clutter component based on the superposition model of the received signal. The advantage of the imaging method is that only a limited number of measurements are needed to achieve high quality restored image. The method is performed on the real metallic sample measurement data taken from continuous THz imaging systems based on the vector network analyzer(VNA) . The results show that the method can effectively restore high contrast images with no obvious fringes under subjective visual evaluation.

articleTitle: Thermionic Emission of a Novel Y2Hf2O7 Ceramic Cathode Applied in High-Power Magnetron Tubes
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In order to enhance output power and prolong lifetime of the high-power magnetron tubes, a novel Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Hf<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf> ceramic cathode had been developed. The thermionic emission and lifetime characteristics of the Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Hf<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf> cathode had been measured. The results show that the cathode can provide 0.15A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 3.5A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> current density for the space charge limitation at 1300°Cbr, 1600°C br respectively under 300V anode voltage. The lifetime of the cathode is more than 4100 h with an initial load of 0.5A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at 1400°C br.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable terahertz beam steering via an independently controlled microstructure embedded with diodes
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper designs reconfigurable terahertz beam steering via an independently controlled microstructure embedded with diodes. It can be independently electrically tuned for three-dimensional (3D) beam control. The change in the reactance characteristics of the varactor diode affects the reflection characteristics of the microstructure. The independently controlled microstructure based on the varactor diode obtains a phase shift about 180° at 360-372 GHz, and efficiency> 90%. This work promotes the implementation of 3D terahertz beam control.

articleTitle: Resonant Amplification Enhanced Terahertz Quantum Cascade Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The photon-driven nature of the transport in terahertz quantum cascade laser can be exploited to detect light. Fast tunable detectors are demonstrated with responsivities higher than 17 V/W. Preliminary measurements shows that, thanks to the sub-ps intersubband lifetime, electrical bandwidths larger than 5 GHz can be obtained.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a frequency-selective filter for restraining high frequency oscillation in Ka-band sheet beam TWTs
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The problem of oscillation suppression is the key to ensuring the normal operation of the traveling wave tubes (TWTs). In this paper, design of a frequency-selective filter for restraining high frequency oscillation in Ka-band sheet beam traveling-wave tubes is presented. Two design methods are used to extract and radiate the microwave on oscillation frequency, while avoiding the influence on the operating frequency. One is combination of multi-section gradual matching and pyramidal horn antenna, and the other is combination of multi-section gradual matching and Ka standard matched load. The simulation results of both methods show return loss (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>) is more than 20 dB over 26 GHz -– 40 GHz, and insertion loss (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf>) is less than 10 dB over 35 GHz -– 38 GHz.

articleTitle: THz Emission in a Dual-Grating-Gate HEMT Promoted by the Plasmonic Boom Instability
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We experimentally observed photomixed THz emission from a dual-grating-gate high-electron-mobility transistor under different bias conditions at 120 K with irradiating photomixed dual-CW-IR laser beams. The observed emission spectral peak frequencies meet well to the theoretical calculations for plasmon mode frequencies, suggesting the photomixed THz emission is amplified by the DC-current-driven plasmonic boom type instability when the electron drift velocity exceeds the plasmon velocity at the plasmon cavity boundary.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Control of Magnetic Anisotropy by Resonant 4f Electronic and Phonon Excitations in Sm0.7Er0.3FeO3
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report on the ultrafast dynamics of spin reorientation using different excitation mechanisms in the orthoferrite Sm<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.7</inf>Er<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.3</inf>FeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. First, intense few-cycle mid-infrared pulses tuned to optical phonon resonance are exploited to excite the lattice system. A finite time delay of the spin reorientation is observed at its initial dynamics, displaying the energy transfer between lattice and 4f system. In contrast, an instantaneous response is found when the f-f electronic transition of Sm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> is resonantly excited. Our results indicate that 4f electronic pumping can alter the magnetic anisotropy due to the modification of 4f-3d exchange at femtosecond time scales, without involving lattice thermalization.

articleTitle: Boson Peak Investigation of LiCl-H2O System Using Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The complex dielectric constant of 17.3 mol% lithium chloride aqueous solution, which is a typical hydrogen-bonded glass system, was determined from 291 K to 14 K using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy. The boson peak appeared at 1.3 THz at 14 K, suggesting that the determinant of boson peak frequency is hydrogen bonds between water molecules.

articleTitle: A THz Time-Domain Polarimetry System based on Plasma Filaments
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report on bandwidth extension and polarization control of our terahertz time-domain polarimetry (THz-TDP) system based on the spinning the electro-optic sampling technique. We have extended the bandwidth of this system by using two-color laser plasma as the source and GaP crystal as the detector. We characterize the precision of this system to be approximately 2.0 degrees. The polarization of the THz emission can be controlled by varying the phase delay between the two-color pump pulses.

articleTitle: Fast image deconvolution for enhancement of the resolution in the video rate terahertz imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A fast image deconvolution algorithm is used to demonstrate the resolution enhancement of video rate camera acquired Terahertz images. Our algorithm is based on variable splitting technique with the use of a family of sparsity inducing regularizers for the first time in an image deconvolution application, it is also suitable for practical applications in industry with computationally constrained conditions. The results of the proposed process provide substantial enhancement on the quality and resolution of THz images.

articleTitle: Terahertz metamaterials wave separator
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A miniaturized terahertz (THz) metamaterials wave separator with the structure of four uniform units in z direction is proposed. The unit has three layers of gold (Au)-silicon dioxide (SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>)-polymethacrylimide (PMA) from up to down. Perfect steep cut-off has been achieved, and the transmittance of the device is reduced from 80% to 5% within 0.06THz. It inherits the advantages of optical filter to realize THz frequency separation with low energy loss. The excellent property can be applied in THz wavelength division multiplexing filter banks.

articleTitle: Dielectric properties of BiB3O6 crystal in the sub-THz range
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present the thorough studies of dielectric properties of BiB<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> (BIBO) crystal in the sub-THz range. We observe a large birefringence Δn = nZ −nX = 1.5 and the values of absorption coefficients of all three axes to be less than 0.5 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>. The difference from visible range in angle ϕ between the axes z and X is found to be more than 6°. The simulated phase-matching curves show the optimal value of the angle θ to be around 25.5°±1° for an efficient millimeter-wave generation under the pump of 1064 nm laser radiation.

articleTitle: Design of an Electron-Optical System for Sheet Electron Beam Traveling Wave Tubes
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An electron-optical system for sheet electron beam traveling wave tubes was designed. The electron gun was designed to produce a 30 kV, 0.2 A sheet electron beam with a cross-section of 0.56 × 0.08 mm. The offset-pole PCM structure was adopted to focus the sheet electron beam. Computer simulation technology particle studio (CST-PS) was used to simulate the whole system. The simulation results showed that the transmission rate of the electron beam attained 98.3 % over a transmission length of 61.8 mm.

articleTitle: Resonant Raman scattering in the infrared: the case of MoSe2
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We investigate Raman scattering of MoSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> crystals with excitation energies in the visible and in the infrared (from 1.16 eV to 2.33 eV). We show that, despite the lower scattering efficiency at longer wavelengths, it is possible to measure also MoSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> monolayers with photon energy of 1.16 eV, by placing the flakes on hexagonal BN slabs on Au substrates.The lineshape of the Raman modes is shown to be highly dependent on the excitation energy due to resonant processes. In particular, we observe effects of resonant Raman scattering with the indirect band gap (1.14 eV) of MoSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> yielding information on the electronic and phonon density of states. By the calculation of the two-phonon density of states in different position of the Brillouin zone, we are able to reproduce some experimental features of the second order Raman spectra.

articleTitle: Quantification of water content in contact lenses combining terahertz imaging and optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Hydration of contact lenses is an important parameter as it governs the oxygen transport to the cornea. Dehydration of contact lenses during lens wear causes discomfort due to dry eye and alterations in lens fitting characteristics. Terahertz (THz) imaging and optical coherence tomography (OCT) together can provide unique information about the hydration profile of the contact lens and its structure. Here, we present results that combine the information measured from OCT and THz systems on contact lenses which aid in determining the change in water content and thickness over time. Overlaid THz and OCT images that align well are shown, making it possible to automatically scale and co-register the two data sets. Hence, we show that a combined OCT/THz system can deliver distinctive knowledge about the capacity of contact lenses to maintain their comfort and optical characteristics over time.

articleTitle: A Study of Microwave Properties of Water – Polarization Charge Shielding and Field Resonances
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Heating non-uniformity has been a major hurdle to numerous applications in microwave heating. The exposure to a non-uniform field is a well-known cause for this difficulty. There are, however, some much less-understood causes, which are inherent in nature in that they persist even in a perfectly uniform field. The current study addresses two such causes in water heating. The first one concerns the effects of field shielding by microwave-induced polarization charges, and the second one on the effects of microwave resonances in water.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a 140GHz Gyro-TWT with Dielectric Loaded Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a 140GHz gyro-TWT uniform dielectric loaded waveguide operating in the low loss TE01 mode is presented. By adopting a low DC driver of 50kV, 1A to satisfy the power capacity of small dimension structure. The loaded dielectric is used to suppress the potential backward wave oscillation. This gyro-TWT is designed and simulated by a particle-in-cell (PIC) software. The optimized simulation results indicate the designed gyro-TWT can operate at the desired mode TE01 with the output power of 12.85kW. The corresponding saturated gain and -3dB bandwidth are 39.3dB and 7.5GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Measurement of the Azimuthal Angle Dependence of Third Harmonic Generation from Narrow-gap Semiconductor Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Reflection type measurements were performed on narrow-gap semiconductors such as InSb and InAs bulk samples for harmonic generation using intense terahertz pulses from free electron laser. We successfully measured the characteristic azimuthal angle dependence of the third harmonic generation (THG). The results show cos3θ and cos6θ dependence at different polarization layouts for InAs(111).

articleTitle: THz light-matter coupling in a hBN-encapsulated graphene quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Using transport spectroscopy under coherent THz illumination, we demonstrate THz light-matter coupling in a graphene quantum dot from 100 GHz to 380 GHz. The quantum absorption of THz photons results in a broadening of differential conductance peaks at low frequency and photo-induced satellite current peaks at high frequencies as a signature for photon-assisted tunneling. Our study shows the coherent interaction between the GQD and THz radiation.

articleTitle: Terahertz Radiation Detection with Bi-Sb Films at Room Temperature
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Due to the rapid development of THz photonics, it became necessary to create detectors of THz radiation, which would simultaneously be high-sensitive, high-speed and work at room temperature. We demonstrate that the use of thermoelectric thin Bi-Sb films with high sensitivity to THz radiation may solve this problem. The films synthesized by means of thermal evaporation in vacuum were affected by terahertz radiation at the frequency of 0.14 THz. The temporal dependencies of a voltage drop and temperature difference were measured. The experimental results prove the possibility for the use of Bi-Sb films in THz radiation detection at room temperature.

articleTitle: Cocrystal Formation between Isoniazid and Aromatic Carboxylic Acids Based on Terahertz Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Three cocrystals of isoniazid with the aromatic carboxylic acids including p-nitrobenzoic acid, p-cyanobenzoic acid and p-aminobenzoic acid under slow evaporation condition have been synthesized by solvent evaporation. The above three cocrystals were analyzed and characterized by THz spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Extraction of Terahertz Properties of Human Bone through Fabry-Pérot Modelling
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Despite its great potential, the realisation of terahertz dielectric imaging for biomedical application is limited by experimental challenges, such as reference displacements and Fabry-Pérot reflections in thin samples. In this work, an algorithm is developed to overcome such complications for time-domain spectroscopy measurements in reflection configuration. The algorithm is demonstrated on human bone slices without encapsulation, showing great promise for application in extracting biometric information from a broad range of structures.

articleTitle: Terahertz Response of L-Serine at Low Temperatures
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The temperature dependence of the terahertz spectrum of L-serine has been measured below liquid nitrogen temperatures for the first time. With a high purity sample and temperatures as low as 6 K, the five intrinsic absorptions of L-serine in the frequency range below 3 THz have been identified. Room temperature spectra of D-serine show identical features to the L-enantiomer. A new Raman-active mode has also been identified at 1.41 THz.

articleTitle: Actively manipulating coherent Smith-Purcell radiation with graphene metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A novel physical mechanism is proposed which can actively manipulate coherent Smith-Purcell radiation<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> with graphene metasurface. The coherent radiation is generated from the resonantly coupling between waveguide modes excited by a moving electron beam and the diffraction waves by the graphene metafurface. Owing to the controllability of the electron beam and some properties of graphene, the fundamental properties of the coherent Smith-Purcell radiation can be actively manipulated by adjusting the chemical potential of graphene metasurface and electron beam velocity. This mechanism opens a way for dynamically tuning the radiation states of Smith-Purcell radiation.

articleTitle: High-Switching Contrast Plasmonic Nanocavities for Terahertz Detection with Extremely High Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a photoconductive terahertz detector that uses a plasmonic nanocavity to provide very high detection sensitivities at record-low optical pump power levels. To achieve this high efficiency operation, the plasmonic nanocavity is designed to limit the transport time of the photogenerated carriers to a sub-picosecond time scale. By using this detector in a terahertz time-domain spectroscopy system, we demonstrate more than a 100 dB signal-to-noise over a 6 THz bandwidth at only 0.1 mW optical pump power level.

articleTitle: Photonic hook – a new structured sub-wavelength self-bending THz beam
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: During the last several years it was discovered that an electromagnetic field can be made to curve after propagation through a simple dielectric mesoscale structure with broken symmetry of the shape or material, and that the field can bend around corners. This effect was termed a ‘photonic hook’ – it is a unique electromagnetic beam configuration behind a mesoscale dielectric Janus particle and differs from the Airy-family beams. Photonic hooks feature a small radius of curvature, which is about 2 times smaller than the electromagnetic wavelength - this is the smallest radius of curvature ever reported for electromagnetic waves. Below a brief review of the photonic hook phenomenon observed by our group is discussed.

articleTitle: Determination of Intrinsic Dielectric Constants at Terahertz Frequencies for Crystalline Materials Diluted in Polymer Matrix
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: For crystalline material with strong terahertz (THz) absorbance, the characterization with terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) is typically performed on the mixture pellet where the analyte of interest is embedded within an inert polymer matrix. The polymer background significantly affects the phase delay of the propagating THz signal inside the sample, which makes the polymer matrix contribute to the overall dielectric response of the mixture sample to the probing THz waves. In this study, an analytical model was proposed to extract the target analyte’s intrinsic dielectric constants from the experimental dielectric spectra of the diluted mixture.

articleTitle: Impurity-modulated ultrafast carrier dynamics in 3D Dirac semimetal Cd3As2
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this work, we use optical pump-terahertz (THz) probe spectroscopy to investigated the impurity-induced topological phase transition and the photo-induced carrier behavior in cadmium arsenide (Cd3As2), a three-dimensional Dirac semimetal. By comparing the dynamics of different temperature and pump fluence, we discuss the carrier dynamics and physical mechanism caused by impurity.

articleTitle: Topological Dirac Semimetals for Ultra-Sensitive Terahertz Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
