A cooling the gyrotron cavity to cryogenic (nitrogen) temperatures as one of the promising methods for reducing ohmic losses in terahertz gyrotrons is considered.

articleTitle: Design And Measurement Of Undulator U58 For A Super-radiation Terahertz Source
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A super-radiation terahertz source working in the range of 0.1~0.7 THz was built at CTFEL. In the proceeding, the specifications and the detail of design and measurement of Undulator U58 for the super-radiation terahertz source was reported.

articleTitle: Resonant cavity assisted broadband CPW to rectangular waveguide transition on InP at 300 GHz
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An in-plane resonant cavity-assisted coplanar waveguide (CPW) to rectangular waveguide (WG) transition is realized over an Indium Phosphide (InP) substrate with a thickness of 205 µm using a monopole radiating element. The simulated back-to-back (B2B) structure provides a bandwidth 16 GHz (288 - 304 GHz) with a return loss of 10 dB and insertion loss of 0.6 dB.

articleTitle: Characterization of nanoporous alumina using terahertz reflectometry and scattering imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The structure and morphology of nanoporous alumina (NP Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) films on Al substrates are investigated by terahertz (THz) reflectometry and scattering imaging. One inhomogeneous area is identified in THz C-scan results off specular conditions at various angles. The thickness of NP Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> films calculated based on THz results is in excellent agreement with destructive cross-sectional field emission scanning electron microscopy (FE-SEM) measurements.

articleTitle: SDR for Metrology and Communications at Submillimeter Wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Software-Defined Radio (SDR) technology has been driven by advances in RF integrated circuits and is generally available up to 40 GHz. State-of-the-art SDRs used with open software frameworks and interfaced to commercially available up/down-converter hardware provide a means for accessing the submm-THz spectrum. This makes it possible to realize measurement systems and communications channels that exploit the flexibility and processing capabilities of SDR backends. This work demonstrates the first use of SDR to implement a 1 THz FM communications channel using commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) SDRs, general RF components, and submillimeter-wave frequency extenders.

articleTitle: Pt/Fe on Plano-convex Glass Substrate as a Terahertz Emitter with Built-in Focusing Lens for Spintronic Terahertz Radiation
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A spintronic heterostructure consisting of Pt and Fe thin films deposited by magnetron sputtering on a convex glass lens is demonstrated as a terahertz emitter. The experimental results show that the convex type spintronic terahertz emitter focuses its radiated terahertz beam without the need for any additional optics, thereby allowing opportunities for the simplification of terahertz setups.

articleTitle: Novel magnetron-injection gun forming ribbon helical electron beam for terahertz gyrotrons of megawatt power level
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Design of the planar magnetron-injection gun (MIG) forming ribbon helical electron beam (HEB) suitable for use in new generation of powerful planar gyrotrons is developed. The presented approach is based on three-dimensional numerical simulation of electron-optic system with taking into account the real three-dimensional configuration of the electrodes, beam space charge forces and such specific for MIGs factors as roughness of the emission surface and thermal velocities of electrons. Special attention was paid to the effect of particles drift in crossed electric and magnetic fields. Recommendations to diminish the velocity spread in the regimes with high enough (more than 1.3-1.4) pitch-factor are given. An analyzer of ribbon HEBs based on the retarding electric field method is proposed and optimized. The results of theoretical studies are in good agreement with the experimental data obtained at the IAP RAS by the mentioned above analyzer.

articleTitle: Verification of THz genetic algorithm using a VNA
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: THz antennas have been designed using a bespoke genetic algorithm. A patch antenna designed using this technique was found to have a mean improvement of 7.58 dB on a reference patch between 0.1 THz and 5.0 THz. This paper presents the testing of this antenna between 0.8 THz and 1.0 THz and subsequent verification of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Compact Terahertz Surface Plasmon Polaritons Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A compact terahertz (THz) surface plasmon polaritons (SPPs) device is designed and fabricated. This device can stimulate the THz SPPs and control the wave front of the SPPs simultaneously, which can reduce the size of the device. This method can be used to design the integrated SPPs devices.

articleTitle: Temperature-Dependent Properties of Terahertz Window Materials
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The dielectric properties of common terahertz window materials (quartz and Teflon) at different temperatures were measured by terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (TDS). The applicability of these materials at temperature up to 230 °C was discussed, and the changes of refractive index and absorption coefficient were analyzed combining with Raman spectroscopy. The optical properties of 6H-SiC crystal in the frequency range of 0.2-2 THz were characterized, indicating that it can be used for terahertz optical devices such as lenses. The temperature- dependent measurements show that all the three materials have good temperature stability.

articleTitle: Magnetic 2D ferromagnetic heterostructures for spintronic THz emission
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Recently emerged spintronic terahertz (THz) emission spectroscopy has been widely employed not only to investigate ultrafast spin dynamics, to understand the fundamental physics of femtosecond demagnetization, but also been treated as contactless ultrafast Ampere meter for femtosecond spin currents. Here we explored a new atomically thin 2D materials (Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>GeTe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) with topological assisted room-temperature ferromagnetism via THz emission spectroscopy, and observed THz radiation from Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>GeTe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>|(Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> heterostructures, verifying the existence of room-temperature magnetism in 2D van der Waals materials. These observations pave the way for further exploiting new phenomena and new physics in magnetic 2D materials.

articleTitle: THz excitation spectroscopy of the layered semiconductor crystals
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Surface THz emission from GaSe and three transition metal dichalcogenide layered bulk crystals were measured as a function of the photoexciting optical pulse wavelength. The nonequilibrium carrier dynamics was additionally characterized by the optical pump – THz probe experiments. The obtained results were discussed in terms of the electron energy band structures and the details of the THz emission mechanisms.

articleTitle: 3D Printed Horn Coupler for Hybrid Photonic Crystal THz Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a terahertz horn coupler to enhance the coupling efficiency from a free-space wave into and out of a hybrid photonic crystal waveguide. The optimized horn structure could ideally offer 84.5% coupling efficiency of free-space radiation into a tightly confined photonic crystal waveguide mode in the frequency range of 0.359-0.430 THz. The horn coupler enables adiabatic mode-matching and is fabricated using 3D printing and gold sputtering. The proposed horn coupler could be applied for terahertz chip integrations.

articleTitle: Two-Frequency Notch Filters for Sub-THz Plasma Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Modern Electron Cyclotron Resonance Heating (ECRH) systems in fusion plasma research take advantage of multi-frequency gyrotrons. This means that the frequency band of some millimeter-wave diagnostics contains more than one narrowband gyrotron-frequency line, which needs to be suppressed. Compact standard-waveguide notch filters, based on coupled waveguide resonators with rectangular cross section, are presented, which can provide very high suppression of several gyrotron frequencies providing low insertion loss in the pass band.

articleTitle: Far-infrared stimulated emission of Dirac fermions in CdHgTe heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report on stimulated emission at wavelengths up to 31 μm "closed" for quantum cascade lasers based on AIIIBV materials. For SE at 31 μm the optical confinement is achieved due to Reststrahlen band in GaAs substrate. The mitigation of Auger processes in structures under study is exemplified and the promising routes towards the 35–50 μm wavelength range, where HgCdTe lasers may be competitive to currently known emitters, are discussed.

articleTitle: THz time-domain spectroscopy of Nematic liquid crystal based on mode-locked Yb-doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate a THz time-domain spectroscopy (TDS) system based on a mode-locked Yb-doped fiber laser as a pump source. A THz emission bandwidth of over 2.2 THz or more is achieved for 220 mm in free spacing and the signal-to-noise ratio is achieved more than 30 dB. As an application, THz spectroscopy of a nematic liquid crystal is measured and analyzed. The THz absorption spectrum of the cell was measured by applying an electric field to the E7 NLC cell. As a result, it was experimentally confirmed that as the electric field applied to the NLC cell increases, the absorption of the specific THz frequency of the cell decreases.

articleTitle: Terahertz Investigation of Ternary Drug-bridge-drug Cocrystal Formed between Pyrazinamide, Fumaric Acid and Isoniazid
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The ternary drug-bridge-drug cocrystal between pyrazinamide (PZA), fumaric acid (FA) and isoniazid (INH) was prepared with the slow solvent evaporation method. The THz absorption spectra presented that there were significantly different peaks between the parent materials and the ternary cocrystal. In addition, density functional theory (DFT) calculations were used to simulate cocrystal structures and provide vibrational modes of the PZA-FA-INH ternary cocrystal.

articleTitle: G-band Broadband CPW-CPW-SIW-Rectangular Waveguide Transition for UTC-PD Application
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The configuration of the CPW-CPW-SIW transition.

articleTitle: Nanoscale THz imaging and spectroscopy at ambient and cryogenic sub 10 K temperatures
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Scattering near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM) is a powerful technique that can provide wavelength independent optical resolution (< 20 nm), by surmounting the diffraction limit in traditional THz imaging. In this presentation, we report on the implementation of near-field THz s-SNOM for the nanoscale characterization of frequency dependent free carrier response in semiconductors and 2D materials. The specifically designed near-field microscope enables measurements at room temperature and at cryogenic temperatures.

articleTitle: Antennas for a point to multi-point communication system operating in D-band
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Two different antennas were developed for a point to multi-point communication system operating in D-band (110- 170 GHz). The first is a horn antenna with a 20 dB gain and 30° horizontal radiation pattern. The second one is a horn antenna with a focusing dielectric lens that allows to reach a gain of about 32 dB. The two antennas were fabricated and the main characteristics were measured.

articleTitle: Broadband Tunable Terahertz Absorber Based on Graphene Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a broadband and electrically tunable terahertz absorber based on single-layer graphene metasurface was designed and simulated. The numerical simulation results show that the absorption bandwidth of more than 95% absorption is as broad as 2.046 THz, and the working frequency can be dynamically controlled by changing structural parameters and the chemical potential of graphene.

articleTitle: A 220 GHz High-Efficiency Active Frequency Tripler With InP HEMTs For Millimeter-Wave/Terahertz Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper presents a high RF efficiency active frequency tripler based on InP HEMT technology. A common-source transistor stage with input and output matching circuits is used to produce the third harmonic in this active tripler. The chip achieves a peak RF power efficiency of 81% with the input power of 9.4 dBm at 220.2GHz and achieves an RF conversion efficiency of 60% from 212.4 to 230.3 GHz.

articleTitle: Terahertz Absorption Characteristics of Liquid Water in the Range of 6 ~ -2 °C
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz transmission measurements of deionized water were carried out using terahertz microfluidic technology. It is found that in the range of 6 ~ -2 ℃, the terahertz absorption coefficient of water decreases with the decrease of temperature. In other words, the absorption capacity of water to terahertz wave decreases with the decrease of temperature. The results provide a precondition for the future study of terahertz absorption characteristics of liquid samples by using microfluidic technology at different ambient temperatures, and provide technical support for the application and development of terahertz.

articleTitle: Undulators in the form of Permanently Magnetized Helices
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A ferromagnetic heix magnetized axially or radially is apparently the simplest helical undulator. Four helices with alternating magnetization can provide a stronger helical field than the conventional planar Halbach arrays. Such undulators and micro undulators seem promising for various powerful HF sources. The method of direct integration of the fields of elementary magnets is used for analytical calculation of the fields of infinitely thin, longitudinally and radially uniformly magnetized helices of arbitrary length. Subsequent integration allows finding the field of a helix with finite transverse dimensions. The analytical magnitude of the field for an infinite helix is close to the numerically calculated one for a helix with a relatively small number of periods 5-10.

articleTitle: Optimized optical cavity for maximal enhancement of terahertz spintronic emission
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Spintronic terahertz emitters are recently developed broadband sources for THz applications based on the ultrafast spin-diffusion in ferromagnetic/nonmagnetic ultra-thin multilayers. We present the enhancement of the terahertz emission using the integration of an optimized SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> photonic crystal combined with our previously reported original architecture of a spintronic emitter with induced magnetic anisotropy. Layer thicknesses of the optical cavity are designed for maximal infrared pump absorption in the ferromagnetic layers to obtain intense terahertz emission. The improvement of the efficiency by factor four of terahertz emission is demonstrated compared to a spintronic emitter integrated with Bragg mirror and standard spintronic emitter.

articleTitle: Multiple-Tunnel Meander-Line Slow-Wave Structure for a High-Power Millimeter-Band Traveling-Wave Tube
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, we present the results of design and development of the multiple-tunnel meander-line slow-wave structure (SWS) for a high-power traveling-wave tube (TWT) with multiple sheet electron beam operating at millimeter band. Electromagnetic parameters of the SWS with different number of beam tunnels are simulated. The results of 3-D PIC modeling of small-signal and large-signal hot-test operation are presented. Technologies for fabrication of the multiple-tunnel SWS are discussed.

articleTitle: Mode-Selective Phonon Excitation of SrTiO3 by MIR-FEL with Anti-Stokes Hyper-Raman Scattering Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The selective excitation of LO3 phonon mode among seven optical phonon modes of strontium titanate (SrTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) by using a mid-infrared free electron laser (MIR-FEL) which will then be investigated and confirmed by anti-Stokes hyper-Raman scattering spectroscopy using pico-second laser is proposed to be done. The experiment on a single crystal of SrTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> has been measured in the room temperature, and the Stokes hyper-Raman spectrum of the LO3 phonon mode was clearly observed at 800 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. However, the intensities of the spectra of this target phonon is very small even for the Stokes side that it is nearly impossible to observe the anti-Stoke spectrum with this experimental setup. The peak observed around 500 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> is to be further investigated whether anti-Stokes hyper-Raman scattering or not and signal intensity increment measurements are to be done to perform mode selective phonon excitation by MIR-FEL.

articleTitle: Terahertz soft mode in Ba-Pb M-type hexaferrite ceramics
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An unusual ferroelectric-like soft mode is discovered in terahertz spectra of dielectric permittivity of lead-substituted barium hexaferrite. The dynamics of the mode cannot be described either by Cochran or by Curie-Weiss equations. The obtained dependence of the soft mode parameters on lead concentration x(Pb) allows to suggest quantum phase transition at x(Pb)≈0.2.

articleTitle: Research On Terahertz High Gain Slot Waveguide Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A 16×16 full-corporate-feed feed slot waveguide antenna array operating at 220GHz is designed. The simulation results show that the gain of the array is 32.7dBi and the side-lobe level is -13.4dB, which is lower than the ideal value of the side-lobe level of the array antenna and can meet the design requirements. The bandwidth of 2×2 subarray antenna is 4.5%. The impedance bandwidth of the 16×16 slot waveguide antenna array is similar to that of the cell array, which is also 4.5%.

articleTitle: TCAD Study of THz Rectification Process in JLFET
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The mechanisms of THz rectification performed by the JLFET detector are studied by TCAD simulations, in the light of the self-mixing model. Results show a new picture of the device functioning giving a new description of measured response. The achieved comprehension of the interaction of the radiation with the silicon structure, offers a new possible approach to detection through the gate capacitance charging, in addition to the standard drain voltage measurement.

articleTitle: Interferometric Time Synchronization of a Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy System Driven by a Mode-Locked Laser Diode
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) systems using a monolithic mode-locked laser diode (MLLD) as the light source have the potential to be extremely compact and fast. However, phase sensitive applications require the delay axes of related measurements to be accurately synchronized. In this work, we demonstrate an interferometric synchronization scheme with negligible hardware effort and yet high accuracy by exploiting the high repetition rate of the MLLD.

articleTitle: Spintronic Terahertz Emission and Magnetic Anisotropy of Epitaxial Platinum Heterostructures on MgO(110) Substrate
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Spintronic terahertz emitters are terahertz wave emitting elements that utilize spin currents. We have produced Pt/Co spintronic terahertz emitters by epitaxial growth of Pt and Co layers on MgO(110) substrate. The azimuthal angle dependence of Pt/Co spintronic terahertz emission shows characteristic dependences due to magnetic anisotropy. The terahertz emission is useful to evaluate the magnetic anisotropy in spintronic thin films.

articleTitle: The Performance of Superconducting NbN Hot Electron Bolometer with Nb5N6 Buffer Layer
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Superconducting hot electron bolometer (HEB) were fabricated with Nb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> buffered NbN on Si substrate. We present the result that the Nb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> buffer layer can significantly improve the superconductivity of NbN HEB. The 2.5–5 THz superconducting HEB device has been fabricated successfully. We also do some research on devices which work at varied temperature. It is shown that our buffered HEB device could work at relatively high temperature, which means more possibility of applications in the future.

articleTitle: High Gain Fabry-Pérot Antenna with Microstrip Patch Fed by GGW
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a Fabry-Pérot cavity antenna (FPCA) with microstrip patch fed by groove gap waveguide (GGW) is proposed based on a single-layer frequency selective surface (FSS). The simulation results show that the design has good stability, and the 10 dB return-loss bandwidth of this antenna is 58.6 GHz-60.8 GHz. On average, a 6 dB gain enhancement is obtained compare to the reference antenna. The maximum gain of the antenna reaches 17.1 dB at 60GHz. The dimension of the FSS is 11.4×11.4mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (5.2λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), and the thickness is 1mm (0.2λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>), where λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> is the free-space at 60GHz.

articleTitle: Y-coupled planarized waveguide THz quantum cascade laser frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a Y-coupled planarized double metal waveguide THz quantum cascade laser, featuring a low threshold current, broadband THz emission and operation as a frequency comb. Far-field measurements produce characteristic interference patterns, a signature of broadband phase locking and equal power splitting between the two Y-split waveguide arms.

articleTitle: Angular dependence of electric and magnetic mirrors of a single-layer terahertz metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We experimentally observed electromagnetic mirror in a single-layer THz metasurface and studied the effect of incident angle on the performance. The magnetic and electric mirror performance is still maintained for incident angle up to 10º. We also observe appearance of new resonances under oblique incident angles. These resonances can lead into high transmission or reflection windows. The mirror effect weakens for incident angle greater than 10º at 0.36 and 0.51 THz. This single-layer metasurface operates in both reflection and transmission modes opens new opportunities to develop single-layer devices for beam steering in THz wireless telecommunications.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband THz metamaterial absorber loaded with lumped elements and graphene
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An ultra-wideband THz metamaterial absorber (MMA) loaded with lumped elements and graphene is proposed. The MMA has achieved an ultra-wideband absorption from 6.1THz to 18.5THz with average absorptance over 90%, and the relative bandwidth reaches 112.7%. The excellent absorption properties superior to the ordinary MMAs are owing to the effect comes from lumped resistors and graphene surface plasmon (GSP).

articleTitle: Broadband THz amplitude modulator based on multiple metasurfaces embedded with VO2
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, we present a composite terahertz dynamic modulator that combines the metamaterial with vanadium dioxide (VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>). The dynamic conversion between different resonant states is realized by the phase change characteristic of VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. When a terahertz wave passes through a two-layer metal structure with different resonant frequencies, the two resonants are superimposed to achieve bandwidth expansion. The modulator can effectively modulate broadband amplitude in the range of 0.272 THz-0.345 THz, and the maximum modulation depth can reach 90%. It has a wide application prospect in terahertz wireless communication systems and high-speed imaging systems.

articleTitle: Time-domain spectroscopy of 3D-printing ABS/MWCNT composites at the THz frequency range
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In paper the results of research of the electrical properties of 3D-printed composites based on ABS and MWCNTs at the frequency range 0.1-1.6 THz are presented. The technology of manufacturing composites for 3D printing is described. The influence of the MWCNTs concentration in acrylonitrilebutadienestyrene on the transmission coefficient is shown.

articleTitle: High Q Asymmetrical Terahertz Metasurface For Frequency Selective Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Optical resonators are of significant interest due to their strong light confinement ability. However, the resonator performance is often limited by the out-of-plane scattering caused by fabrication defects. A physical mechanism known as bound states in the continuum can potentially suppress the scattering, leading to improved optical devices. Using the concept, here we propose a standard metasurface having two elliptical silicon (Si) blocks to create out-of-plane asymmetry. The device parameters are optimized by the Genetic Algorithm (GA). Fabrication of the device is carried out following standard fabrication methods. The experimental outcome shows that the metasurface can achieve a high Q factor of 236 which is in good agreement with the simulation. Owing to its strong light confinement ability the metasurface can be used as a frequency selective device, filter, and biochemical sensor.

articleTitle: Coherent Multidimensional Spectroscopy with Field Resolution and Noncollinear Geometry at Multi-THz Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Noncollinear two-dimensional spectroscopy in the 10-40 THz range enables background-free and phase-sensitive investigation of coherent low-energy dynamics in semiconductors and strongly correlated materials in a perturbative excitation regime. Measurements on bulk indium antimonide explore the capabilities of the setup and pave the way toward the investigation of functional thin film materials and few-layer samples.

articleTitle: Terahertz Power Visualization Based on Capsulized Cholesteric Liquid Crystals with Three-Dimensional Porous Graphene
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A high-efficiency visualized terahertz (THz) power meter based on the THz-photothermochromism of capsulized cholesteric liquid crystals (CCLCs) embedded in three- dimensional porous graphene (3DPG) is proposed. The graphene is a broadband perfect absorber for THz radiation and transfers heat efficiently, and its black background is beneficial for color measurement. We have achieved the relationship between THz power and the hue value of single and multi-microcapsule respectively. Quantitative visualization of THz intensity up to 2.8*10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> mW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is presented. The minimal detectable THz power is 0.009 mW. The device can convert THz radiation to visible light and is lightweight, cheap, and easy to use.

articleTitle: Design of the quasi-optical mode converter for the 140-GHz Gyrotron
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper the quasi-optical mode converter consisting a easily Vlasov launcher, one parabolic mirror and two phase correcting mirrors for the 140-GHz TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22,8</inf> Gyrotron has been presented. A computer code for vector analysis of the electromagnetic fields in mirror systems has been developed in terms of the vector diffraction theory. Based on Stratton-Chu formula and the Katsenelenbaum-Semenov Algorithm (KSA), the structure of the two adapted phase correcting mirrors have been obtained. Using commercial software, the simulation results show that the power transmission efficiency from the Vlasov launcher to the vacuum widow is 90.51% and the fundamental Gaussian mode content is 96.52%.

articleTitle: 28GHz-band Compact Uniplanar 180-degree Rat-race Hybrid with Broadband Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a 180-degree rat-race hybrid which consists of short transmission lines less than quarter wavelength with shunt capacitors at both ends and an ideal phase inverter is described. We show the possibility of realizing a compact and wideband 180-degree rat-race hybrid that is about 1/10 smaller than the conventional rat-race hybrid and has twice the operating band by an electromagnetic simulation with a uniplanar structure at 28 GHz band used for 5G applications.

articleTitle: THz Spectroscopy of BSA in a Surface-Tension Confined Flow-Cell
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A novel combination of oxygen plasma treatments and machining was used to modify the surface wetting of polytetrafluorethylene (PTFE) to develop a terahertz compatible microfluidic flow-cell that confines aqueous samples with surface tension forces. By increasing the wettability of the water channel and creating superhydrophobic nanostructures on the surrounding substrate, a stark contrast in contact angles was produced that leads to the principle confinement effect. Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) was performed on a range of bovine serum albumin (BSA) concentrations, demonstrating the potential for using this chemically inert, bio-compatible material for investigating protein hydration dynamics with THz spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Features of the plasma induced in water and ethanol jets under the action of strong subpicosecond IR pulses
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Single-pulse scheme and time-resolved experiments are implemented to explore the plasma formation in water and ethanol liquid jets. The measured dependences of the plasma reflection on the pump pulse energy and duration indicate the strong influence of intensity variation. Furthermore, ethanol demonstrates almost 2-fold higher reflectivity in comparison to water. Time-resolved experiments and corresponding analysis provide the insight into the electron density dynamics by measuring the reflection of laser pump and its third harmonic.

articleTitle: Lamb dip stabilization of a THz quantum-cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report on stabilizing a THz quantum-cascade laser to a molecular transition in a Doppler-free configuration. We locked the frequency to the Lamb dip of the transition, which is one order of magnitude narrower than the unsaturated absorption line.

articleTitle: Transverse mode control of high-power single plasmon terahertz frequency quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz (THz) frequency quantum cascade lasers (QCLs) have previously been demonstrated to emit peak powers of greater than 1 W from a single facet in a single plasmon geometry. However, this was achieved by drastically increasing the laser ridge width, resulting in higher order transverse modes. In this study, we control and fully suppress these modes through metallic side-absorbers. Fundamental transverse mode operation is achieved without sacrificing THz peak power, leading to enhanced power densities. This work will open up new perspectives for using these sources in nonlinear THz physics.

articleTitle: A 93GHz Slot Antenna Array for Millimeter-Wave Proximity Sensing
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A millimeter-wave slot antenna array operating at 93GHz is presented. The linear array antenna consists of 34 slots, and is feed by WR10 waveguide in the center. The measured bandwidth is 2.5GHz(S11<-10dB), and the 3dB beam width for E plane and H plane are 110° and 3.2° respectively. Meanwhile, a -19.2dB side-lobe level is achieved. The proposed compact antenna can be used in the field of millimeter-wave proximity sensing and other wireless applications.

articleTitle: Terahertz absorption characteristics of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose colloid based on microfluidic technology
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Sodium carboxymethyl cellulose is the most widely used and the largest amount of cellulose in the world. In this study, terahertz and microfluidic technologies were combined. The terahertz characteristics of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose colloid were studied at different concentrations and applied electric fields. The obtained results showed that different concentrations of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose have different time domain and frequency domain spectra; with an increase in concentration, the terahertz transmittance of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose decreased. Under the applied electric field treatment, the longer the electric field acting time is, the higher the terahertz transmission intensity is. This approach is a safe and reliable new method for the determination of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose concentration, which provides technical support for the in-depth study of sodium carboxymethyl cellulose.

articleTitle: Terahertz Biosensors with high sensitivity for the recognition of neurotransmitter
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The quantitative measurement of neurotransmitters with label-free detection methods provides vital clues in tracking neurological functions or disorders. However, there are many challenges for the terahertz biosensor due to the noise and other non-target components like water and so on. Here, we report a rapid quantification method of adrenaline with a specially designed hexagonal open resonant ring. This approach opens opportunities not only for investigating the early diagnostics of neurological disorders or highly sensitive terahertz biosensor applications but also for developing low-cost spectroscopic biosensing applications.

articleTitle: H-type Photoconductive Antennas Manipulated by Nano- And Micron-Scale Meta-Atoms
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Here we proposed and demonstrated two meta-atoms assisted H-type photoconductive antennas (PCAs) with novel features. The first one has all-dielectric nanopillars in the PCA gap which substantially enhance the absorption of the femtosecond laser pump, and thus realize a 1.94-fold increase on the emitted THz amplitude. The second PCA employs micron-scale metallic split-ring resonators (SRRs) to manipulate the terahertz wave propagating in the coplanar transmission lines, which can manipulate the spectrum of the far-field terahertz field. The reported results may extend and deepen the studies on metamaterial assisted PCAs.

articleTitle: Tilted-Pulse-Front Terahertz Generation in a Plane-Parallel LiNbO3 Plate
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A modified scheme of tilted-pulse-front terahertz generation in LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> has been proposed, theoretically studied, and experimentally tested. In this scheme, a plane-parallel LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> plate is sandwiched between two coupling dielectric prisms, in contrast to the conventional tilted-pulse-front scheme with a prism-shaped LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> crystal. This allows improving the lateral uniformity of the generated terahertz beam. In a proof-of-principle experiment, the optical-to-terahertz conversion efficiency of the new scheme as high as 0.03% has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Online terahertz thickness determination of sub-wavelength layers at kilohertz measurement rates
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present an online layer-thickness measurement system capable of assessing multiple sub-wavelength layers at a data rate of 1.6 kHz. Combining an ultrafast terahertz time-domain spectroscopy engine based on electronically controlled optical sampling (ECOPS) with a highly efficient CPU-based evaluation algorithm, an industry-ready measurement system is realized. To evaluate the performance, we quantify the thickness of multilayer paint samples on aluminum substrates.

articleTitle: Locking of Terahertz Semiconductor Dual-Comb Laser Sources
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report on an active stabilization of a terahertz quantum cascade laser (QCL) dual-comb source by phase locking one of the dual-comb lines. Although only one dual-comb line is locked, the phase noise of other dual-comb lines close to the phase locked line is significantly reduced. Furthermore, it is demonstrated that the QCL comb without a control of the repetition rate can produce pulsed-type waveforms.

articleTitle: Design of a Transceiver Integrated Multiple-Beam Cassegrain Antenna at 340GHz for Situational Awareness
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This letter proposes a transceiver integrated multiple-Beam Cassegrain Antenna at 340GHz. The proposed receiving antenna uses a sixteen-channel receiving feed array. Sixteen receiving feeds are misaligned to produce offset beams, and each of them is received individually, which simplifies the structure and provides flexibility for signal processing. The proposed transmitting antenna and receiving antenna are coaxial. The main reflector of the parabolic transmitting antenna is connected with the receiving antenna’s sub reflector, thereby improving the space utilization and the robustness. Sixteen-beam Antenna ensures a large-angle scanning, and works stably within a bandwidth of 25GHz. The main lobe gain is greater than 55dB, 3dB beam-width varies around 0.16° and the sidelobe levels are lower than -24dB for all the beams. The proposed antenna shows an excellent radiation performance which can meet the needs of RF front-end of the situational awareness system.

articleTitle: Source and Localization of the PT-Symmetric Terahertz Photoconductivity in Topological Hg1-x Cdx Te – Based Heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We have shown that in heterostructures based on the topological phase Hg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>Cd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Te, the properties of two-dimensional topological states formed at the trivial buffer - topological film heterointerface differ from the states at the topological film - vacuum interface, and it is the former that are responsible for the appearance of PT-symmetric photoconductivity. It has been shown that the source of nonequilibrium electrons is the film bulk, while the place of manifestation of the effect is the trivial buffer - topological film heterointerface.

articleTitle: Cells density-sensitive terahertz biosensor based on ITO metasurface array
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Considerable attention has been paid on cellular detection by using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) over the recent decades. In this study, indium tin oxide (ITO) based complementary split-ring resonator (CSRR) metasurface was designed as a biosensor to distinguish the density of the tumor cells. Structural parameters of the ITO metasurface was optimized by COMSOL. Enhanced THz signal on the ITO metasurface made the identification for the tiny changes of cell to be possible. It could be also observed that a red-shift of the resonance peaks with the number of cells increasing, which may indicate that the proposed ITO-based CSRR metasurface may play a significant role in terahertz biosensing applications.

articleTitle: Fifth-harmonic generation in Si:B pumped with intense terahertz pulses
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We observe third-harmonic generation (THG) and fifth-harmonic generation (FHG) of terahertz free-electron laser (FEL) pulses in Si:B at cryogenic temperatures. The intensities of the harmonics increase as a function of pulse energy following power laws with exponents of 4.2 and 6.2, respectively. We attribute the generation of the fifth harmonic mainly to the valence band non-parabolicity. The values of χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> and χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(5)</sup> increase with the density of mobile carriers, which are excited via impact ionization of the boron dopants under irradiation by the intense FEL pulses.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Experimental Investigations on the Frequency-Tunable Terahertz Gyrotron
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Theoretical and experimental investigations on a frequency-tunable terahertz gyrotron have been presented in this paper. The effects of the slightly up-tapered sections in an improved multi-section gyrotron cavity on the resonant frequency and the quality factor are investigated in detail. In an optimized multi-section gyrotron cavity, the quality factor for all axial modes can maintain an order of magnitude in the cold cavity approximation, it means that the operating current for all axial modes can keep an order of magnitude. A resonator-based gyrotron oscillator can play dual functions: gyromonotron and reflected-type gyro-BWO corresponding to forward-wave and backward-wave operation. the field profile of the axial mode and beam-wave interaction efficiency of the gyromonotron and the reflected-type gyro-BWO are dramatically different from each other. And the gyromonotron state can switch to the reflected-type gyro-BWO state by means of increasing the operating magnetic field. A 263GHz frequency-tunable gyrotron at the fundamental cyclotron harmonic for the 400MHz DNP/NMR spectroscopy and a 527GHz frequency-tunable gyrotron at the second cyclotron harmonic for the 800MHz DNP/NMR spectroscopy are experimentally investigated.

articleTitle: Studies on Planar Pencil Beam Staggered Double Vane Slow Wave Structures
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, three staggered double vane slow-wave structures with pencil beam tunnels have been designed and studied at W band, G band and 260-400GHz band, respectively. The results show that pencil beam staggered double vane slow-wave structures could be easily fabricated with Computer-numerical-control machine and could get a good transmission performance, amplified characteristics. The 3 dB band could reach 29GHz, 70GHz and 40GHz with peak power of 2120W, 310W and 18.9W at 95 GHz, 220 GHz, and 330 GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Chirality- and Wavelength-Multiplexed Focusing of Surface Plasmons
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Surface plasmons (SPs) is a vital form of electromagnetic wave confined to the metal-dielectric interface. Since the capability of guiding light within subwavelength scale, a great deal of plasmonic devices emerged successively. Over the past few years, in-plane SPs controlled by artificially structured surfaces are of great promise for information transmission in ultracompact integrated optical circuit, especially in terahertz (THz) near-field photonics. Owing to the exploitation of holographic principles in two-dimensional surface, we theoretically and experimentally demonstrate a generic design strategy to steer the SP waves to several focus spots depending on the wavelength and chirality.

articleTitle: THz microscopy on a single WS2 microcrystal
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy enables the contact-free determination of charge carrier properties in metals and semiconductors. However, the applicability of THz spectroscopy is severely reduced by the low spatial resolution imposed by the diffraction limit. We have developed a time-resolved THz near-field microscope to circumvent this limitation, allowing the determination of the carrier dynamics with a resolution of a few microns. We use this microscope to measure a single exfoliated flake of WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> with domains of different thickness. The THz spectra reveal phonon modes in the sheet conductance. We also observe a biexponential carrier recombination associated to surface-assisted Auger scattering.

articleTitle: Photoinduced Charge Transport in Conductive Metal Organic Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Conductive metal organic frameworks (MOFs) are a promising class of porous crystalline materials for photocatalytic applications. We report direct evidence of a charge transport (CT) mechanism in 2D Cu-THQ MOFs using a combination of terahertz (THz) and transient absorption spectroscopies. Zn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> ions were added to this MOF in order to understand their impact on CT, ultimately causing a decrease in conductivity. This work provides insight into the rational design of 2D MOFs for photoelectronic and photocatalytic applications.

articleTitle: Design of Two-Stage Depressed Collector for 170GHz Mega-watts Gyrotrons
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: To satisfy the requirement of the RF output in mega-watts level of the 170GHz gyrotrons. A design of a two-stage depressed collector with the radial magnetic field for 1MW, 170GHz gyrotrons for increasing the efficiency and the power capacity of the tube has been presented. The simulation results indicate that the total efficiency of the tube with the design could increase from 31% to 89% significantly.

articleTitle: Highly efficient multicycle terahertz generation in PPLN
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We experimentally measure percent-level optical-to-multi-cycle terahertz conversion efficiencies by injecting a home-made wavelength- and duration-tunable two-line laser into periodically poled lithium niobate. We study the efficiency vs. the input laser peak fluence, pulse duration, crystal length and poling period at cryogenic temperature. Our work is a significant step towards high energy terahertz pulses for linear electron acceleration.

articleTitle: Possibility of MW-Level Second-Harmonic Generation in a Gyrotron Locked by an External Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We theoretically study the possibility of high-power (MW-level) generation in second-harmonic gyrotrons based on the frequency-locking by a weak (several percent of the power) external monochromatic signal. Such a signal can suppress the generation of the parasitic fundamental harmonic during the start-up process. Within the frame of multimode self-consistent non-stationary model, we demonstrate the applicability of the described approach to provide 0.65 MW output radiation in a 230 GHz 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-harmonic gyrotron with TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">31,8</inf> operating mode.

articleTitle: Experimental research of W-band TE10 to HE11 Mode Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a mode converter from a rectangular waveguide TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> mode to a circular waveguide HE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> mode for W-band is proposed. The power experiment has confirmed the designed mode converter. The converter consists of two parts: one is to convert the TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> mode in the rectangular waveguide into the TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> mode in the circular waveguide by using a square-circle transition; the second is based on the coupled wave theory, the TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> mode is converted into a Gaussian distributed HE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> mode by using the waveguide wall smooth radius structure. The mode converter has a simple structure, easy to machine, and avoids the disadvantage of the corrugated mode converter which is prone to breakdown. Through the power experiment, the designed mode converter coincide with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Multifunctional dielectric terahertz metasurfaces via spin-decoupled phase control
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Integrating multiple functionalities into a single device is a striking field in metasurfaces. Here, we experimentally demonstrate several efficiently multifunctional dielectric metasurfaces in the terahertz regime using a spin-decoupled phase control method allowed by simultaneous control of dynamic phase and geometric phase. The designing strategy shows an impressive robustness and a great flexibility in designing metasurface-based multifunctional devices, and opens new avenues toward the applications in beam steering and polarization multiplexing.

articleTitle: Photoconductive THz detectors based on iron doped InGaAs with 4.5 THz bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present continuous-wave terahertz (cw THz) detectors employing iron doped InGaAs as photoconductive material. The iron doped photoconductor shows improved properties compared to low-temperature grown InGaAs used in many state-of-the-art cw THz detectors. We fabricated photoconductive antennas on Fe-doped InGaAs, which allow for a bandwidth of 4.5 THz with 112 dB peak dynamic range in a coherent setup for the first time.

articleTitle: Terahertz optoacoustics of water, tissues and aqueous solutions
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Radiation at terahertz frequencies can be used to analyze the structural dynamics of water and biomolecules, but applying the technique to aqueous solutions and tissues remains challenging because such radiation is strongly absorbed by water. Here we develop terahertz optoacoustics as a method for analyzing water, tissues and aqueous solutions even in thick samples. We demonstrate that adjusting the temperature to alter the terahertz optoacoustic signal of water improves the sensitivity with which it can be analyzed and, conversely, can reduce or even "silence" its signal, allowing detection of solutes such as glucose and ions, potentially with greater sensitivity than terahertz time-domain spectroscopy. Terahertz optoacoustics may be a powerful tool for spectroscopy and potentially imaging of aqueous solutions and tissues to study molecular interactions and biochemical processes.

articleTitle: Generation of high-power THz radiation in plasma by colliding laser wakefields
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Collision of two laser-induced plasma wakes inside a supersonic helium jet is considered as a method for generating narrowband radiation pulses tunable in IR and THz frequency bands. First experimental results are compared with theoretical predictions and particle-in-cell simulations of the process.

articleTitle: Novel 2×2 travelling wave tube amplifier array for millimeter wave phase array radar
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A novel travelling wave tube (TWT) amplifier array for phased array radar (PAR) with 2×2 output ports is proposed. The double parallel connecting microstrip meander-lines (MML) are employed as the slow-wave structure (SWS) operated in Ka-band. For each output port, the simulation results reveal that the output power, saturated gain and 3-dB bandwidth can reach 566W, 27.5dB and 7GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Structure Dependence of Resonant Tunneling Diode Oscillator without Metal-Insulator-Metal Capacitors
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Structure-simplified resonant tunneling diode (RTD) oscillator without metal-insulator-metal (MIM) capacitors has a big advantage for short fabrication process. In this work, we investigated the dependence of oscillation frequency on slot antenna length for structure-simplified RTD oscillators. We experimentally achieved a high oscillation frequency of ~0.96 THz with antenna length and RTD mesa of 15 μm and 0.7 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, respectively. We also experimentally validated that oscillation frequency decreases with increasing stabilization resistors, which was agreed well with the theory.

articleTitle: Injection of Dense Electron Bunches into Undulator Radiation Sources Based on the Negative Mass Regime
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Various regimes of injection of dense electron bunches formed by photoinjector guns into the strong guide and undulator magnetic fields necessary for efficient radiation in the regime of the negative mass stabilization are simulated, and possible ways to prevent the drop in radiation efficiency arising due to the degradation of the bunches are proposed and discussed.

articleTitle: THz frequency reference for precision metrology
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate a terahertz (THz) frequency reference for precision metrology, by utilising the inherently well- defined resonance frequencies of ultra-high quality (Q) THz microresonators. In a proof-of-concept experiment, we demonstrate the accurate and repeated detection of minute resonance frequency shifts of less than 5 MHz at 0.6 THz of a THz microresonator sensor.

articleTitle: THz and IR spectroscopy of H2O@C60 endofullerene
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Time-domain terahertz and Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy techniques are employed for investigating of the low-frequency dynamics of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O@C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</inf> endofullerene at temperatures 6–300 K. A number of absorption lines associated with rotational transitions of water molecules entrapped inside C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</inf> cage are observed and assigned. Fitting absorption lines with Lorentzians allowed us to obtain the temperature dependences of the lines’ parameters – frequency position, strength and damping.

articleTitle: Electric Control of Electromagnetically Induced Transparency-like at Terahertz Frequency
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We propose an electrically controlled electromagnetically-induced -transparency-like (EIT-like) metasurface combined with high electron mobility transistor (HEMT). The metasurface can be switched between two states by modulating voltage loaded on the gate of HEMT. Modulation depth of 95.9% and the maximum group index of 213.2 are achieved. This kind of electrical control of slow-wave resulting from EIT-like effect has potential applications in terahertz communications.

articleTitle: Milliwatt level room temperature 2.38 THz quantum cascade laser sources
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate milli-watt level output power from THz nonlinear quantum-cascade lasers based on a lens coupled Cherenkov radiation scheme, in which obliquely polished semi-insulating InP substrate facet of the device is closely appressed to a high-resistivity silicon lens. This enables much more efficient THz radiation extraction compared with the conventional Cherenkov phase matching scheme by which THz radiation emits to air from obliquely polished substrate facet. The waveguide simulations revealed ~4 times higher output power. Adopting the lens coupled Cherenkov radiation scheme, the device produces ~1 milli-watt peak power at a frequency of 2.38 THz at room temperature, which provided ~0.22 milli-watt with the conventional Cherenkov phase matching approach.

articleTitle: Occlusion Removal in Terahertz Imaging by In-painting
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We introduce an in-painting method to deal with the problem of image occlusion which seriously limits the application of terahertz imaging. To demonstrate, the image obtained from the frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) system was repaired after being corrupted by different masks. The quantitative comparison with the original image (SSIM) shows that the method is valid.

articleTitle: Thermal Cavity Calculation of 38GHz Extended Interaction Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this article, an EIO cavity with a frequency of 38GHz is designed and the particle simulation is shown. Through numerical calculation and computer simulation, the results of particle simulation is also shown in this article. When the voltage is 20.4kV, the current is 1.35A, and the longitudinal magnetic field is 0.3t, the average output power is 9.3kW, and the energy conversion efficiency is 33.8%。This research is of great significance for the development of millimeter wave vacuum devices.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of the correlation function of optical-terahertz biphotons
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: For the first time the normalized second-order correlation function of optical-terahertz biphotons generated under spontaneous parametric down-conversion has been measured directly. The proposed experimental scheme and the measuring procedure are discussed.

articleTitle: Broadband electrodynamics of single-crystalline lead-substituted barium hexaferrite
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Broadband electrodynamic response of single-crystalline lead-substituted barium hexaferrite Ba<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>Pb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</inf> is studied at temperatures from 5 to 300 K in the range of frequencies from 1 Hz to 240 THz. Discovered phenomena include relaxational radio-frequency dynamics of domains and domain walls, temperature-unstable terahertz excitations connected with electric dipoles induced by off-center displacements in the ab-plane of the lead ions, narrow terahertz excitations associated with electronic transitions between the fine-structure components of the Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>ground state, dielectric gigahertz resonances presumably of magneto-electric origin and polar lattice phonons.

articleTitle: Terahertz tight focusing based on low-index metagratings with free phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Metagrating-based high-NA metalenses are studied, which can be made of any transparent dielectric due to the nonlocal phase modulation mechanism. Besides of spatial modulation of the diffraction angle, the diffraction phase of metagratings are tailored for the first time to achieve coherent superposition of the diffracted fields. Metalenses made of low-index polymer metagratings with NA of 0.94 at 0.14 THz are demonstrated in theory and experiment. The proposed lightweight and planar high-NA metalenses with straightforward design principles may find wide applications in terahertz imaging and communications.

articleTitle: Silkworm Egg Development Intelligent Recognition by THz Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Multidisciplinary cross-integrated researches and interdisciplinary cooperation can help inspire new ideas and accelerate development of disruptive application. Here we combine terahertz (THz) imaging technology and artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms to realize the dynamic monitoring of silkworm egg development. We not only demonstrate, for the first time, rapid recognition of silkworm egg development stage with a recognition accuracy of ~98.5% by intelligent THz imaging technique, but also push the accuracy up to 99.2% through fusing THz imaging and optical imaging. Such AI enabled THz technology can be expanded to other application circumstances.

articleTitle: Ultrafast photocarrier dynamics in Dirac semimetal PtTe2 thin film
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The ultrafast photoexcited carrier and coherent phonon dynamics of 20 nm PtTe2 film on fused silica substrate were investigated systematically at room temperature using degenerate and non-degenerate femtosecond (fs) pump-probe spectroscopy. After 780 nm optical pump, photo-induced bleaching (PB) signal was observed, which originated from the band filling effect. The incoherent relaxation processes can be reproduced well with a double-exponential decay function, which have been assigned as the cooling of the thermal carriers and the recombination of electron-hole pairs mediated by phonon, respectively. Two distinct oscillation modes were identified, the low-frequency mode corresponds to the excitation of coherent acoustic phonon by photolaunched stress wave, and the high frequency mode is due to the coherent optical phonon stemming from out-of-plane (A1g) lattice motion. Our study provides an in-depth understanding to the relaxation mechanisms and phonons behavior of PtTe2 film in nonequilibrium states, and might pave the way for the design of electronic and optoelectronic devices.

articleTitle: THz Generation with Photoconductive Emitters with a Low-noise GHz Repetition Rate Laser
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate THz generation with state-of-the-art iron doped InGaAs photoconductive emitters using a low-noise GHz repetition rate amplified femtosecond laser operating at a central wavelength of 1560 nm. We measure a maximum dynamic range of 73 dB and a bandwidth of more than 3 THz. This unique laser source combining low-noise and high repetition rate is a promising alternative to the frequently used commercial fiber systems at 100 MHz.

articleTitle: High-Q Photonic Crystal Resonator with Large Hole for Microfluidic Integration for Biosensing
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this work, we demonstrate a photonic crystal (PC) resonator with a large hole in the center for biosensing in the terahertz (THz) regime. The design has the potential to be integrated with a microfluidic channel for automated pathogen detection. The strongly concentrated electric field around the hole and high Q factor lead to high sensitivity and high figure of merit (FOM) for a thin layer (in the µm range) of analyte. The resonator is fabricated by laser cutting of high resistance silicon (HRSi) and its sensing performance is experimentally characterized.

articleTitle: Molecular crystal (GUHP) for narrow-band pulsed THz generation with NIR femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report on the creation and investigation of a new class of crystals for nonlinear optical applications in the NIR-THz range, requiring non-critical phase matching. A narrowband two-frequency THz radiation source is demonstrated. The spectral properties of THz radiation emitted via optical nonlinear rectification in a semiorganic molecular crystal guanylurea hydrogen phosphite (GUHP) are described in relation to the crystal axis orientation.

articleTitle: Over 200 W Peak-Power Cascaded Backward Terahertz-Wave Parametric Oscillator at 0.3 THz
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We studied cascaded backward terahertz-wave parametric oscillation (BW-TPO) to enhance the output THz-wave power. The pump beam converted to the photon pair of counter-propagating THz-wave and co-propagating idler beam. The idler beams also acted as a pump beam for the cascaded THz-wave generation. The oscillation threshold of cascaded process was reduced 77% compared with the primary one thanks to the spectrum overlaps of counter-propagating THz waves. Furthermore, optical injection seeding to the first idler beam provided threshold reduction of the primary one. Output peak power of THz-wave reached 205 W with the pulse width of 0.78 ns at the frequency of 0.3 THz.

articleTitle: Experimental and theoretical THz spectroscopy of solid saccharides
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) is a powerful tool for probing collective molecular vibrational modes of biomolecules. In this study, we used THz-TDS to investigate the low-energy vibrational modes of a group of organic molecules belonging to saccharides (or carbohydrate) in their solid state. Ab-initio simulations based on density functional theory (DFT) were carried out by employing a state-of-the-art method for the calculation of the weak intermolecular forces driving the collective motion of organic molecules. This approach allowed us to identify and analyze the low-energy vibrations finding their percentage contributions of intermolecular and intramolecular motion of the optical phonons.

articleTitle: Experimental Test on a Broadband Sub-Terahertz Quasi-Optical Mode Converter for High-Order Confocal Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Motivated by transforming the high power output of confocal gyrotron into Gaussian beam, a broadband sub-terahertz quasi-optical mode converter for a high-order confocal waveguide mode is experimental tested and reported in this paper. Driven by a confocal mode generator with limited bandwidth, the measured scalar Gaussian contents are above 90% over a frequency range of 7.2 GHz. The low-power tested result is in good agreement with the simulation result.

articleTitle: Enhanced light-matter coupling and optical pumping of THz intersubband polaritons
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We investigate the engineering of the strong light-matter coupling between a THz cavity and intersubband transitions for novel THz polaritonic devices. By varying the duty cycle of the cavity grating, we show how the light-matter interaction can be engineered over a large k-space range, measured using THz time domain spectroscopy (TDS) and fitted using a RCWA model. Secondly, we show how the reflectivity response of such cavities under optical pumping.

articleTitle: Optically Induced Train of Coherent THz Transients in [Co/Pt]3 Multilayers
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We explored the transient reflectivity of [Co/Pt] magnetic multilayer systems on the picosecond time scale. We observed that the transient Kerr ellipticity depends on the helicity of the pump pulse. In the first 100 ps after excitation, the superposition of discrete oscillation modes with frequencies up to 4 THz results in a beating response in the time domain.

articleTitle: 2D Optical- and THz-Kerr Effect in Lead Halide Perovskites
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Ultrafast optical- or magneto-optical Kerr responses exhibiting THz frequency oscillations are commonly assumed to trace coherent low-energy quasi-particles, such as phonons or magnons. Here, we decode the complex nonlinear polarization response of lead halide perovskites (LHPs) by developing two-dimensional optical Kerr spectroscopy (2D-OKE). In contrast to the quasi-particle interpretation, we unveil a unified origin for fully inorganic and hybrid LHPs, governed by anisotropic and highly-dispersive light propagation in the vicinity of the optical bandgap. Finally, to directly trace the ultrafast lattice or molecular polarization, we extend this investigation to the THz Kerr effect.

articleTitle: Investigation of a short-period microwave undulator
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A cavity-type microwave undulator (MU) based on a corrugated cavity operating at 36 GHz was designed. A short-corrugated section prototype was manufactured and measured to validate the resonance frequency and quality factor. The electron beam trajectory in the MU with a full length of 1-meter was simulated to exam the electron drift distance in the radial direction. The radiation spectrum from the MU shows soft X-ray radiation can be produced with 250 MeV electron bunches.

articleTitle: Thickness determination and prediction of wet paint using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present an approach to determine the thickness of wet paint using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (TDS). For calibration, an additional distance sensor is used to measure the layer thickness indirectly. This allows to calculate the material properties (index of refraction and extinction coefficient) during the entire drying process, which are described in this work with the Lorentz dispersion model. From this calibration data set, the layer thickness can be determined at any time during the drying process and, if the material properties change significantly, also the current drying condition. For the tested paint, this also allows to predict the coating thickness in dry state.

articleTitle: Terahertz sensor for highly sensitive detection and distinction of food additives based on TDS technology
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
