abstract: In this paper, a highly sensitive metamaterial sensor for the detection and distinction of Inositol, Leucine and Taurine which are common additives in the food industry has been proposed and verified in the terahertz range. The metamaterial sensor has been verified by solution samples with the concentration of 0.2 mg/ml, 0.4 mg/ml, 2 mg/ml and 4mg/ml. The results illustrate that the proposed metamaterial sensor can detect the concentration of the sample, as small as 0.2mg/ml. Meanwhile, different solutions with same concentration can also be clearly distinguished. This study provides a reference for the application of metamaterial sensor in the field of food safety.

articleTitle: Gas Breakdown in the Focused Beam of NovoFEL THz Radiation
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Results of the experimental investigation on gas breakdown (argon) by the THz radiation (2.3 THz) of Novosibirsk free-electron laser are presented. Breakdown thresholds in the wide pressure range (0.4 – 1.5 atm) are measured. Comparison with the results of calculations using simplified model is made.

articleTitle: Parametric Mode Interaction in Second Harmonic Gyrotrons
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the analysis of parametric mode interaction in second harmonic gyrotrons. We present the equations describing this instability, derived in the fixed field structure approximation, and the calculation of the region of instability in the plane of the frequency mismatches between the operating and parasitic modes. Numerical self-consistent simulations complement the treatment performed in the framework of the general theory.

articleTitle: Design of a W-band rising-sun anode magnetron
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A This paper presents our investigation into a W-band magnetron that consists of 12 pairs of rising-sun anode cavities and an axial funnel-to-waveguide output structure for improving mode separation and obtaining an efficient output power extraction. The EM simulation shows that the separation between π-mode and adjacent modes is more than 2GHz and the external Q value of π-mode is sufficient high for a stable operation in the optimized design. The ‘hot-test’ simulation shows that the magnetron is capable of delivering a maximum output power of 180 kW with an operation efficiency of 56.6% at 94.1GHz, under a moderate anode voltage of 31.9kV and magnetic field of 1.18Tesla.

articleTitle: BWO based imaging for control of MWCNTs polymer composites homogeneity
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz imaging system based on backward wave oscillator for the defectoscopy of composites in the industry is presented. At a frequency of 874 GHz images of multiwall carbon nanotube agglomerates in a composite are obtained. The possibility of detecting inhomogeneities using level filtering is shown.

articleTitle: Gyromultipliers with Asymmetric Electron Beams
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Using non-axisymmetric electron beams in single-cavity self-exciting gyromultipliers with simple axisymmetric cavities allows the realization of an arbitrary multiplication factor. The most efficient is using a pencil-like electron beam displaced from the cavity axis as it allows, according to simulations, achieving a power of up to several watts in the THz frequency range when operating at the fourth cyclotron harmonic.

articleTitle: Propagation of THz Wave Inside Multilayered Skin
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz wave has been emerging as the most promising operational band for intra-body nano-communication. This paper presents the propagation and interaction of THz wave in the three-dimensional four-layer skin. Results show that the absorption loss is the dominant factor in signal attenuation comparing with the spreading loss, while the refraction at the rough boundaries can be neglected.

articleTitle: Design of a Compact Millimeter Wave Gyrotron
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Compact gyrotron was supposed to be a promising continuous millimeter source for industrial applications. Bitter solenoid with transverse and axial cooling channels was designed in this paper. Through optimizing, uniformity length of this Bitter solenoid reaches 80mm with homogeneity 0.5% at magnetic field 1.1 tesla when inner warm bore 20mm and consumes 10.2kW power. And then, beam-wave simulation with designed magnet was adopted by CST Studio which predicts 400W output power at 30GHz when operating voltage and current 5kV and 0.5A.

articleTitle: Large-area Superconducting Micro-wire Single-photon Detectors Prepared by Laser Direct Writing Lithography
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We have fabricated MoSi thin films by magnetron sputtering. The zero resistance superconducting transition temperature of 5 nm thin films reaches 4.1 K. Then, by optimizing lithography conditions, micron lines were prepared by laser direct writing lithography. The line width is from1.0 μm to 2.0 μm of the detection region, which the micro-wires have high uniformity in a large area, and the largest photosensitive area is up to 1000×1000 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. we preliminarily characterize the performance of the detectors, including I-V characteristics, dark counts, and photon counts rate.

articleTitle: A Novel W-Band Frequency Measurement Method Based on Fabry-Pérot Resonator
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: With the continuous development of terahertz technology, the current terahertz related research has a higher demand for terahertz measurement technology, but the current frequency measurement technology mainly used in terahertz band basically has the disadvantages of complex structure and high cost. In this paper, a novel structure is further optimized on the basis of the Fabry-Pérot resonator, which is applied in the wavelength calibration of THz frequency band. Through the analysis of the simulation results, we successfully verify the feasibility of this terahertz frequency measurement scheme. Finally, a novel measurement method of W-band frequency based on Fabry-Pérot resonator is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on imaging technology for terahertz nondestructive testing of rubber inclusions
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz nondestructive testing is carried out for the inclusion defects of rubber materials, and the waveform features of the inclusion defects are extracted. Different wave features are used to image the inclusion defects of rubber materials, and the imaging quality is compared. The best imaging method of different inclusion defects is analyzed from the perspective of defect recognition rate.

articleTitle: Flat-Top Magnetic Field Facility for Pulse Terahertz Gyrotrons
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Pulse gyrotrons have lingered at the short-pulse operation below 1 ms because of the rapid changes in magnetic field strength. This article is aiming to incorporate the Flat-Top Pulse Magnetic Field (FTPMF) into the pulse-magnet gyrotron, which means there will be the first chance to make a pulse-magnet gyrotron available to generate radiation up to 10 ms or above. In such a long pulse width, many scientific experiments, Namely, ESR or DNP-NMR, can be carried out. This article will propose a suitable FTPMF facility for pulse gyrotrons. The topology, principle, and simulation result will be given.

articleTitle: Fabrication of low-loss polycarbonate tube waveguide for broadband terahertz transmission by controlled polymer solution-coating method
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A controllable polymer solution-coating method was used to fabricate polycarbonate (PC) tube waveguide with broadband terahertz (THz) transmission capability. Highly uniform 3-mm-bore PC tube waveguides with three different wall thicknesses of 30.0μm, 57.0μm and 80.0μm were prepared. The measured transmission bandwidths are 1.4 THz, 1.7 THz and 1.9 THz, respectively. The lowest transmission loss of the waveguide sample with 80μm wall thickness is 0.15 dB/cm at 1.0 THz. A metal/dielectric hollow THz waveguide based on PC dielectric tube was also fabricated in this study. The transmission loss of the silver/PC hollow waveguide is 0.13 dB/cm at 300 GHz. It is expected to be decreased to 0.007 dB/cm by further optimization of the PC tube wall thickness.

articleTitle: Enhanced Terahertz Transmission in MoS2/Silicon Heterostructure
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Silicon heterostructure is experimentally demonstrated to have terahertz (THz) transmission enhancement capability. THz spectrum measurements unveil 5% expansion compared with the Si substrate under heat excitations while photon injection induced enhancement originates from THz absorption reduction. The images of THz spots can extend those spectroscopic evolution processes. These findings not only lay a fundamental understanding of properties within transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) at THz frequency range, but also envision a novel class of compact, tunable THz modulation and gain devices.

articleTitle: THz Frequency Counter based on a Semiconductor-Superlattice Harmonic Mixer with 4-Octave Measurable Bandwidth and 16-Digit Precision
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We have developed a broadband and high-precision THz frequency counter based on a semiconductor-superlattice harmonic mixer. Its comprehensive characterization showed a measurement uncertainty of less than 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−16</sup> over a four-octave range from 120GHz to 2.8THz. This compact and easy-to-handle THz counter operating at room temperature is suitable for many THz applications requiring a wide measurement range without a bulky cryogenic apparatus.

articleTitle: New laser lines from a terahertz ammonia laser pumped by a quantum cascade laser and their application to high-resolution spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present an experimental investigation into new continuous-wave laser lines from a terahertz ammonia laser pumped by a quantum cascade laser. These lines were investigated with the help of a molecular figure of merit calculated from spectroscopic parameters available in molecular databases. We also demonstrate the use of this laser as a local oscillator in a heterodyne high-resolution spectrometer between 1 and 3.4 THz.

articleTitle: Interferometric spectral-shaping for multicycle THz generation using the Chirp & Delay technique
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Intense multicycle THz pulse generation has become possible using the chirp & delay technique with high-energy, broadband laser systems, but has so far been limited to few-Hertz repetition rates. Emerging applications are increasingly calling for extension to higher (kHz) repetition rates, but the traditional form of the technique is not well suited for use with available high-energy, high average-power laser systems due to the loss of temporal overlap between the two chirped pulses associated with their narrow optical bandwidths. Here we propose and demonstrate use of interferometric spectral shaping to overcome limitations in the conversion efficiency when generating THz frequencies limited by the optical bandwidth.

articleTitle: Study on the stone relics disease based on terahertz and infrared technology
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Hollowing disease is one of the most common diseases of open stone relics. It is very important to timely evaluate and monitor the hollowing disease to prevent further deterioration. The hollowing disease of Yungang Grottoes were detected and studied using terahertz and infrared technology, combined with spectral processing methods in this paper. The results showed that the method can not only effectively detect and locate the hollowing disease, but also quantitative evaluate the degree of the hollowing disease with high precision. This technology can provide effective data support for the restoration and protection of stone relics.

articleTitle: Penalized Maximum-Likelihood Depth Image Reconstruction Based on Peak-Picking for Gm-APD LiDAR
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Depth image reconstruction for Geiger-mode avalanche photodiode (Gm-APD) lidar system is one of the key techniques to obtain the accurate depth information of a scene. Here, we proposed a depth reconstruction method using penalized maximum-likelihood (ML) image reconstruction based on peak-picking algorithm for Gm-APD lidar. Compared with the traditional pixelwise maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE), the mean absolute error (MAE) of our method was decreased more than 94% without a physically precise imaging model.

articleTitle: Terahertz Magneto-optical Properties of Hexaferrite Ceramics
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this work, we performed an investigation of the terahertz magneto-optical effect in barium and strontium hexaferrite ceramics with various compositions. The Faraday rotation of the samples taking into account the insertion losses were evaluated. As a result, the most perspective sample (BaAl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.4</inf>Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10.6</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</inf>) in terms of maximum polarization rotation and minimum insertion losses has revealed.

articleTitle: Easily adaptable and scalable semiconductor THz pulse source
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A new type of scalable semiconductor THz source is proposed. It contains only two optical elements: a volume phase holographic grating, used at normal incidence to introduce the necessary pulse-front-tilt for phase matching, and a plane-parallel semiconductor crystal, such as GaP. Optical coupling between them is established by refractive index matching liquid. The setup is easily adaptable to different pump wavelengths (up to ~2.5 µm) and THz frequencies by changing the grating.

articleTitle: Terahertz Pulse Shaping using Microwave-Photonic Delay Line Filters
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We propose an all-optical multi-band raised-cosine filter with tunable bandwidth for multi-channel IEEE 802.15.3d Standard-compliant terahertz communications using only a single-tap microwave photonic filter.

articleTitle: Design of a 340 GHz Subharmonic Image Rejection Mixer based on Planar Schottky Diodes
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A 340 GHz subharmonic image rejection mixer with high image rejection performance is presented. In the previous terahertz SIR mixers, E-plane branch waveguide directional couplers or T-junctions are usually used for power distribution. However, because the isolation of the T-junction is not enough, so it is necessary to improve the isolation of the T-junction. By using a new power splitter with isolated ports, the isolation of the output port is improved. It is found that compared with the traditional T-junction, the image rejection of the image rejection mixer can reach 24.5dB at 310GHz-367GHz, which improves 2.7dB for image rejection ratio compared to the T-junction.

articleTitle: Electrically tunable detector for millimeter frequency band
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An electrically tunable detector for sub-THz-frequency radiation based on Si CMOS technology is proposed. The tunability range of the implemented detector covers frequencies from 150 GHz up to 270 GHz with optical responsivity close to 1 kV/W and noise equivalent power below 20 ${\text{pW}}/\sqrt {{\text{Hz}}} $. Potential applications include microwave bio and medical sensing, spectroscopy, amateur radio use and nondestructive imaging.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared nano-imaging of current patterns in patch antenna resonators
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Surface current patterns in single patch antennas are imaged by means of photoexpansion nanospectroscopy performed with an atomic force microscopy probe and a broadly tunable quantum cascade laser system. The local ohmic losses lead to temperature increase of a thin polymer layer positioned in the cavity, which then expands.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of injection-molded weld line in thermoplastic polymer by terahertz reflective imaging and scanning acoustic microscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz (THz) reflective imaging and scanning acoustic microscopy (SAM) were utilized for material characterization as well as quality control of an injection-molded thermoplastic electrical receptacle plate. V-notched weld lines that degrade the mechanical strength of injection-molded products significantly, are observed in both SAM and THz results. The dimension of V-shaped morphological feature of the weld line is ~ 400 μm in width and ~ 10 μm in depth. Position resolved THz birefringence also locates the weld line.

articleTitle: Biomolecule sensing in THz range with n-Ge/Si antennas
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present n-doped germanium-on-silicon (Ge-on- Si) antennas fabricated with CMOS mainstream methods, showing resonances between 0.1 and 0.7 THz for sensing applications. After surface functionalization with α-lipoic acid, a red-shift of the antenna resonance is observed, as demonstrated by THz time domain spectroscopy. Similar results are obtained with silicon nitride (Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>)-coated antennas, enabling microfluidic integration. Finally, we compare antennas of bow-tie slots to antennas fabricated via maskless photolithography.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave terahertz diffraction tomography
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We implement diffraction tomography using a continuous-wave terahertz (CW-THz) source. An off-axis digital holographic interferometry system was built to measure the complex amplitude distributions of a sample for various rotation angles. Based on the Rytov approximation, the three-dimensional (3D) refractive index (RI) distributions of the polystyrene foam spheres was reconstructed by the filtered backpropagation algorithm.

articleTitle: Population inversion between the quantum confinement levels in quantum wells under resonant interband photoexcitation
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A possibility to achieve population inversion and the associated generation of stimulated terahertz radiation employing transitions between energy levels of electrons in GaAs/AlGaAs quantum wells under resonant interband photoexcitation is discussed. The proposed population inversion occurs between two bottom levels in the conduction band according to a four-level scheme under nonstationary conditions during excitation of electrons from the valence band to the top electron state in QW and rapid population of the lower energy level due to processes with the emission of LO-phonons.

articleTitle: Ultra-Sensitive Bio-sensor Based on Part Shape Asymmetric Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A series of four split ring and cross combine structures that can exit Fano resonance have been proposed, which can be used as a highly sensitive sensor in the Terahertz band. The original symmetric and one asymmetric structure have been fabricated. We experimented to make sure that the fabrications agree very well with simulation results. Besides, three types of germ have been detected by bio-sensor based on the asymmetric structure. The measurement results show that there are significant frequency and amplitude offset (~147GHz) among these transmission curves. The measurement results demonstrate that our Fano resonance structure can be used as the potential biosensor in the future.

articleTitle: Nonlinear conductivity response of graphene on thin polymeric film detected by reflection-mode air-plasma THz-TDS
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate that conductivity of graphene on thin polymer film can be accurately measured by reflection-mode air-plasma based THz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS). Instantaneous and strong nonlinear conductivity depletion was observed under high THz electrical field.

articleTitle: 3D object detection in active millimeter wave holographic images
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Active millimeter wave (AMMW) holographic image is converted into projected 2D image views to detect and localize concealed objects under clothes, which changes the original shape information of physical objects, resulting in false detections. In this paper, we discuss a deep learning detection method based on 3D point clouds obtained by thresholding AMMW holographic images. The point clouds provide reliable depth information and retain the shape of the objects, which can be used to precisely discriminate objects. Experimental results show that our method outperforms the view-based methods by a large margin in detection accuracy while maintaining a fast inference speed.

articleTitle: Current status and application progress of CTFEL high average power THz source
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The tunability, high power, high repetition rate and picoseconds-pulse time structure of terahertz (THz) radiation make the THz free-electron laser (FEL) a very attractive THz source of coherent radiation. China Academy of Engineering Physics terahertz free electron laser (CTFEL) is the first THz FEL user facility in China, which consists of a GaAs photocathode high-voltage DC gun, a superconducting RF linac, a planar undulator and a quasi-concentric optical resonator. The terahertz laser’s frequency is continuous adjustable from 0.7 THz to 4.2 THz. The average power is more than 10 W and the micro-pulse power is more than 0.3 MW. In addition, a super-radiation THz source based on CTFEL has also been built, with a frequency range of 0.1~0.7 THz. In the near future, by upgrading the electron energy, the frequency of facility will be extended to 0.1~125 THz, which will achieve full coverage of the THz band. The current status and future prospects of CTFEL THz radiation source are emphasized in this paper, and some important user experiments are introduced briefly.

articleTitle: Average-Power Scaling of Gas-Plasma Generated THz Radiation
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present the generation of broadband terahertz radiation. Driven by a multipass cell compressed high-power fiber laser system at a repetition rate of 200 kHz an average power of 94 mW is generated with the two color gas-plasma scheme. The full bandwidth of the pulses are characterized by a measurement based on the air-biased coherent detection. By using the full potential of the driving laser further power scaling of the generated THz power towards watt-level average power can be expected in the near future.

articleTitle: Metamaterial-free 2D Materials Enabled Terahertz Flexible Sensors for Molecular Detection and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz (THz) spectroscopy for highly sensitive and selective detection has attracted an increasing recognition. To improve the sensing performance, THz metamaterials were served as signal enhancing devices. However, the interaction between molecules and bulk materials (such as metal and silicon, frequently used in fabricating metamaterials) is simple, which limits the sensing performance. Here we introduce 2D materials into THz sensors, respectively. Through π-π stacking and Van der Waal's force, such 2D materials integrated absorbers show high molecule detection and recognition ability. Also the flexible sensor present strong robustness over bending. The results show that our 2D materials based sensors are flexible, stable, and versatile, suited for a broad range of sensing applications.

articleTitle: Leaky Lens Photo-Conductive Antennas on LT GaAs membranes
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Photo-conductive lens antennas (PCAs) exploit the ultra-short photoconductivity phenomenon of specific semiconductors in order to generate pulsed radiation in the THz regime. State of the art PCAs suffer from high dispersion and low radiation efficiency over the large generated bandwidth due to the poor coupling between the antenna and the dielectric lens. In this work, a leaky lens PCA is proposed to overcome these issues. The presented structure, indeed, aims at a 1:15 bandwidth (0.1 THz – 1.5 THz). The design, assembly and manufacture of a LT-GaAs membrane-based leaky lens PCA are shown and discussed together with the measurement of the radiated power.

articleTitle: A terahertz 180° continuous phase shifter based on GaAs diode
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper presents a single-segment phase shifter based on GaAs diode at 220 GHz. In this structure, a phase-shifting unit is inserted into the center of the rectangular waveguide surface. The state of the GaAs diode on the phase shifting unit is controlled by an external voltage. Then the equivalent impedance of the load branch is changed, resulting in phase shift. Finally, within 217.5GHz-225.5GHz, a continuous phase shift of 180° can be achieved, the insertion loss is less than 8.2dB and the phase shift difference between each state is about 22.5°.

articleTitle: Pencil Beams from Leaky-Wave Antenna for Terahertz Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Leaky-waveguides have been shown to be practical devices in terahertz communication systems. In this work, we study the radiation properties of conventional rectangular slots for leaky-wave antennas at terahertz frequencies and demonstrate that our novel trapezoidal aperture design has an increased efficiency and directionality of the generated beams.

articleTitle: Room temperature near-infrared quantum emitter in AlGaN micropyramids
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Room temperature near-infrared single-photon emission from point defects in AlGaN micropyramids are reported. Narrow-band emission peaks ranging from 750 to 960 nm are observed in different point defects. The short-wave NIR quantum emitters are compatible with both mature Si based single photon avalanche diode and multimode fiber, opening up a practical prospect for various quantum information applications.

articleTitle: A 200 GHz Switchable Beam-Steering Phased Array Using Lens-Coupled Annular-Slot Antennas
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report the design and simulation of a THz switchable beam-steering phased array using lens-coupled annular-slot antennas (ASA). For a prototype demonstration, the antenna employed was designed on a high resistivity Si substrate with a radius of 106 um, and a gap width of 6 um (with return loss of 31.8 dB, and 10 dB bandwidth of 13%) for operation at 200 GHz. To achieve a reasonably low side lobe level, a 1×5 array with an element spacing of 0.56λ is utilized. The array is then attached to an extended hemi-spherical Si lens with a radius of 5 mm for high antenna efficiency in the THz region and the succeeding antenna elements are fed by a Nolen matrix and a high performance optically controlled switch network. By switching the input ports of the Nolen matrix, equal magnitude and unique progressive phase difference can be generated for feeding the antennas and steering the antenna beam. The simulation results show that five different beam angles (i.e., -33°, -15°, 0°, 15°, 33°) with the gain of around 15 dB can be achieved. The lens-coupled phased array has great potentials for advanced THz imaging and communication applications.

articleTitle: An Efficient Bi-functional Metagrating via Asymmetric Diffraction of Terahertz Beams
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Growing attention has been paid to multifunctional metasurfaces due to the compactness and the flexibility in beam manipulation. A bi-functional metagrating capable of anomalous refraction and beam splitting via asymmetric diffraction is designed, 3D-printed and experimentally verified at 0.14 THz. The asymmetric diffraction behavior is well explained by the excitation-direction-dependent mode amplitude inside the metagrating based on a simplified modal method. The measured efficiency of anomalous refraction towards +70° is 80.7% under +z illumination, and the measured efficiency of beam splitting is 43.7%/39.5% towards -70°/+70° under –z illumination. Our work opens a new avenue in developing multifunctional and compact terahertz devices for wavefront shaping via excitation directions.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Calcium Ion Channel Regulation by Unipolar Terahertz Field
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a mathematical physics model is set up to study the effects of THz irradiation on Ca2+ transport in the calcium channel. By means of the proposed model, the energy distribution in the three dimensional channel, the trajectories of single ion and multiple ions under THz irradiation are analyzed. It is observed firstly that the Ca2+ transmembrane transport is in the time scale of picosecond, corresponding the spectrum concentrated in the THz range. By means of Brownian dynamics (BD) simulations, we demonstrate greatly enhanced permeation of the calcium channel in reaction to an external THz wave. With the amplitude and frequency increases, the rate of ion transport across the channel increases significantly.

articleTitle: Effect of compensation and near-infrared lasing on donor-related terahertz photoluminescence in GaAs/AlGaAs quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The terahertz radiation associated with optical electron transitions involving donor states in GaAs/AlGaAs quantum wells is investigated under conditions of interband optical excitation. It has been shown that the near-infrared stimulated emission arising at high optical pumping levels as well as impurity compensation can substantially influence on the intensity and spectra of terahertz photoluminescence related to the optical transitions of electrons from the first electron subband and excited donor states to the ground donor states in quantum wells.

articleTitle: Design of a 100-W 20-GHz Bandwith G-band TWT Based on Quasi Flat-roofed Sine Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A high-frequency structure that can be used for the G-band high-power traveling wave tube is proposed to analyz and the slow-wave characteristics of the quasi flat-roofed sine waveguide(QFRSWG). The PIC method is used to obtain the interaction characteristics of the sheet electron beam and the electromagnetic wave in this structure. The calculation results show that the traveling wave tube can produce over 110 W output power in the frequency range of 212 GHz-232 GHz, the gain is greater than 33.94 dB and the maximum electronic efficiency is 5.25 %.

articleTitle: Rapid Identification of Easily-confused Mineral Traditional Chinese Medicine Based on Low-wavenumber Raman Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Since its successful application in the clinical treatment, traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) plays an increasing important role. Thus, it is necessary to establish a rapid and accurate method for the identification and quality control of mineral TCM. In this work, vibrational modes of several easily-confused mineral TCM were characterized by using low-wavenumber Raman spectroscopy. The experiment results show that gypsum, ophicalcitum, natrii sulfas exsiccatus, alumen, corals keleton and borax have significantly different low-wavenumber Raman characteristic peaks in 0-300cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> region. Therefore, the low-wavenumber Raman spectroscopy could be used for rapidly identifying easily-confused mineral TCM.

articleTitle: Surface-Emitting THz Generation in Two-Dimensional Quasi-Phase-Matching Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Novel schemes to achieve surface-emitting multi-and nearly single-cycle THz generation by optical rectification in two-dimensional quasi-phase-matching (2-D QPM) structures are proposed. Placing 1-D phase mask in front of a conventional 1-D periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) crystal forms the periodic pattern that is directed perpendicular to the existing PPLN’s grating vector. It is shown that the scheme enables multi-cycle THz pulse generation with 0.37 MW power and 24 μJ energy at a pump pulse energy of 3.4 mJ.

articleTitle: Precision characterisation of thermal detectors of terahertz radiation
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Thermal detectors of terahertz radiation are now experiencing a renaissance as their advantages of simplicity, low cost and small size are increasingly recognised and valued. Better means to characterise their responsivity, spectral range, modulation frequency dependence, and noise floor are indicated.

articleTitle: Fast air humidity monitoring with THz signal stitching
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A method for THz signal stitching is developed to allow faster acquisition of long pulsed traces with the aim of improving spectral resolution in spectroscopic experiments. The humidity during the purging process of a THz spectrometer with dry air is monitored by looking at the absorption coefficient of water vapor at the first absorption peak. The proposed method is four times faster than lock-in amplifier acquisition when monitoring humidity levels.

articleTitle: In-vivo nano-scale infrared imaging and spectroscopy of cells in liquid environment
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report a breakthrough in observing living cells with infrared s-SNOM (scattering near-field microscope).(1, 2) To keep cells "happy" it is mandatory to avoid evaporation, oxygen attack, and mechanical distortion. We reported at IRMMW-THz 2019 that we successfully analyzed E. coli cells protected by graphene, but later had to realize that strong van der Waals forces squeeze cells and thus impair their metabolic functions.Here we demonstrate a new, satisfactory method of letting cells in nutrient broth adhere weakly to a biocompatible surface, SiN, where they can develop freely. We choose this material in form of an extremely thin (10 nm), free-standing membrane so that the s-SNOM tip can work on and probe through it from the other side at atmospheric conditions, while the tip-confined infrared near field reaches through this membrane largely unaffected.

articleTitle: Millimeter-Wave SAR for Concealed Item Holographic Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, an active millimeter-wave (mmWave) synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging system is utilized to achieve high-resolution holographic image of concealed objects at different distances. To realize a synthetic aperture over the target scene, the system consists of a two-dimensional fully controllable translational platform which can scan in horizontal and vertical directions respectively. For holography reconstruction of concealed objects, the frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar with 4GHz bandwidth is employed, meanwhile, the wavenumber-domain 3-D holographic imaging algorithm based on the system is investigated. The experimental results confirm that our system and algorithm are valid.

articleTitle: Broadband Terahertz Time-Domain Imaging via a 63-Pixel Focal-plane Array
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Images captured by terahertz time-domain imaging systems are information rich because of the wide imaging bandwidth. However, the speed of the state-of-the-art terahertz time-domain imaging systems is still limited by their single-pixel imaging modality. Here, we present terahertz time-domain imaging via a terahertz focal-plane array, which eliminated the need for mechanical raster scanning. We demonstrate resolving 63-pixel terahertz images up to 2.9 THz.

articleTitle: Cryogenic temperature-dependence of HRFZ Silicon refractive index from Mid- to Far-IR down to 5 K
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: High Resistivity Float-Zone (HRFZ) Silicon is a well-known material employed for optical components at far infrared wavelengths. For accurate design of those components its temperature-dependent refractive index is an important parameter. In this contribution we present the results of transmission measurements in a Fourier Transform Spectrometer of a HRFZ Silicon sample cooled down to 5K to estimate the refractive index at the passage from the mid to the far-IR down to 5K. From room-temperature to 5K the refractive index and absorption coefficient showed a decrease of about 0.83 % and of about 7-15 %, respectively.

articleTitle: Terahertz radiation from a spectrally shaped Super Luminescent Diode
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a Terahertz time domain spectroscopy system (THz TDS) in a frequency range up to 1.8 THz based on a Super Luminescent Diode (SLD). The spectrum of the SLD was spectrally manipulated with a wave shaper. This setup can create continuous, as well as discrete frequencies in the THz frequency regime and achieves a dynamic range up to 75 dB.

articleTitle: Fabrication and Its Characteristics of Ka-Band Electroplated 3D Printed Waffle Type Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report the fabrication results and its characteristics of Ka-band waffle type waveguide. The waffle type waveguide consists of electromagnetic wave transmission part and low pass filter parts. The incident electromagnetic waves having lower frequencies than a designed cut-off frequency travel into the low pass filters. Then, the electromagnetic waves having higher frequencies than a designed cut-off frequency only transmit through the waveguide. We verified the operation of the designed waffle type waveguide. In this study, in the fabrication of the waffle type waveguide, to obtain a low-cost and high-speed manufactured waveguide, we used a resin 3D printing technique by fused deposition modeling method. Moreover, to obtain a low insertion loss waveguide, the 3D printed waveguide was deposited with 10 <inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">µ</inf>m thick Ag electroplated layer after electroless plated seed layer. In S-parameter measurement, we obtained the insertion loss of -3.2 dB at 28 GHz. To improve the characteristics, the 3D printing method was changed to stereolithography method, and we sprayed Ag paste as seed layer for better adhesion of the Ag electroplated layer.

articleTitle: Detection of SARS-CoV-2 S1 protein using terahertz meta-biosensor
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The new type of coronavirus pneumonia (SARS-CoV-2) has caused the cumulative number of confirmed diagnoses worldwide to exceed 1.7 Billion, and it has led to heavy damage to all aspects of the world. Therefore, it is crucial to detect SARS-CoV-2 with high sensitivity, free-label, and rapid quantification. Here, a terahertz (THz) metamaterial (MM) biosensor was designed and has achieved a high-sensitivity and quantitative detection of trace SARS-CoV-2 S1 protein.

articleTitle: Waveguide Crossing Based on Air-Silicon Effective Medium
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: All-silicon effective-medium-clad waveguides are a candidate for an integrated terahertz platform with high efficiency and broadband functionality. In order to implement dense circuitry, low-loss, low-crosstalk waveguide crossings are necessary. In this work an all-silicon waveguide crossing utilizes Maxwell-Garnet effective medium theory to facilitate mode transformation in the crossing region, resulting in suppressed crosstalk. Results show average insertion loss below 1 dB and average crosstalk level of −40.9 dB across the broad 220–330 GHz band for both in-plane and out-of-plane fundamental modes. With simple, single-step fabrication using deep reactive ion etching, this structure is ideal for integration on mass fabricated terahertz, all-silicon integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Possibilities to Control the Diffraction Q-factor in Cavities of Subterahertz Gyrotrons
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An important problem in the gyrotron progress into the terahertz range is the increased requirements for the precision of fabrication of electrodynamic systems. It is shown that even minor inaccuracies in cavity manufacturing of a subterahertz gyrotron can significantly decrease the output power level. We propose a method for controlling the diffraction quality factor to reduce the influence of a weak taper of the cavity’s cylindrical part on the operation regime.

articleTitle: Influence of a gas flow on THz generation from optical air-breaking filament
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We perform THz generation by optical breaking in air, with a helium gas flow blown perpendicularly to optically induced filament. The gas flow modifies both the magnitude and polarization of the radiated THz field, due to 1) the different optical/THz properties of air and helium; 2) the weaker optical/THz generation efficiency of helium; 3) the different nonlinear optical properties of both gases. We develop a model that fits the experimental data and permits us to estimate the second order nonlinear dispersion of He relatively to the one of air.

articleTitle: Photothermoelectric Terahertz Detectors based on 3D Graphene
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz, located between microwave and infrared, is in the intersection of electronics and photonics. It has the advantages of safety, fingerprint spectrum, broadband and penetrability. It can be widely used in biomedical, non-destructive testing, radar, communication, military, aerospace and other fields. Terahertz detectors are an integral part of terahertz applications, but due to limitations in material properties, terahertz detectors are slow to develop. As a new two-dimensional material, 3D graphene has an ultra-high absorption in terahertz, which is very suitable as a terahertz detector. Here we design and fabricated 3D grapheme THz detectors with low NEP, high responsivities and fast response speed. The results show that these kind of photothermoelectric detectors are expected to be a new generation of high performance detectors in terahertz region.

articleTitle: Saturation of Terahertz Generation by Multicolor Ionizing Pulses
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The optimal waveform of an ionizing pulse and the corresponding maximum values of the density of residual terahertz currents are found analytically. The solutions obtained can be realized using multicolor femtosecond pulses containing a field at the fundamental frequency and several of its initial harmonics. The amplitudes of odd harmonics in the optimal field are larger than those of neighboring even harmonics. The maximum residual current density increases with the number of harmonics, the fundamental wavelength, and the ionization potential of gas particles and decreases with the duration of the ionizing pulse, approaching the ceiling values when few-cycle pulses are used.

articleTitle: A CMOS Terahertz Pulse Radiator with Zero DC Power Consumption Based on Nonlinear Transmission Line Sharpening Effect
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This article presents a fully integrated terahertz (THz) pulse radiator that is based on the sharpening effect of nonlinear transmission lines (NLTL). As the sinusoidal input travels along the line, its width shrinks, and high frequency harmonics are generated. Implemented in 65-nm CMOS technology and consuming no DC power, this chip generates and radiates a broadband frequency comb through its on-chip antenna that covers 20-700 GHz band with adjustable frequency space between the tones. The EIRP at 400 GHz, 550 GHz, and 700 GHz are -48, -63, and -70 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Terahertz Polarization and Space Charge Dynamics in Semiconductor Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: To identify a length scale to characterize space-charge interactions in semiconductor nanoparticles (SNPs), numerical solutions to a system of equations based on charge transport and electromagnetic field coupling were studied, leading to the notion of a frequency dependent Debye length, which can be seen to evolve from the static case where the space charge satisfies the Poisson-Boltzmann equation. An effective field formulation was developed to enable the computation of the total induced dipole moment of simple clusters of SNPs. The dipole moment facilitates construction of equivalent circuits for the SNPs as well as the representation of the polarization in terms of point dipoles. Computational results obtained for a semiconductor nanodimer are employed to delineate the application of the formulation.

articleTitle: Sidelobe Level Analysis for Mirrored Aperture Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Mirrored aperture synthesis (MAS) is a new method for passive microwave remote sensing after aperture synthesis (AS). In this paper, the relationship among the array factor (AF) for the two-dimensional (2-D) MAS, one-dimensional (1-D) MAS, and 1-D AS is established. Based on the relationship, the sidelobe level (SLL) of MAS is analyzed. The SLL of MAS is spatially variant compared to that of AS. Despite this, a set of directions can still be selected, in which the maximum SLLs of MAS are almost equal to those of AS. This is verified by the simulations and experiments based on a system working at 51.6GHz.

articleTitle: Transmittance Properties of Metallic Double-Coil Array as Terahertz Absorber
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An array of tungsten double coils embedded in polyester resin was investigated as an electromagnetic wave absorber. The finite element method was used to numerically find the best structure of the coils. Then, the transmittance response of the sample was evaluated experimentally using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy. Results show that such double-coil array is an effective electromagnetic wave absorber in the sub-terahertz region, and it has two controllable electromagnetic absorption frequency bands.

articleTitle: Is there a terahertz absorption peak in frozen aqueous solutions of DNA nucleosides?
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In an attempt to reproduce a previously-reported absorption peak in the spectrum of a frozen aqueous solution of 5-methylcytidine (5-mc), we observed a resonant feature around 1.6 THz in all samples containing ice, including pure ice itself. Thus, simply fitting the left-hand side of a Gaussian function to the spectrum of ice does not fully describe it. The previously reported peak feature depends on the subtraction of the Gaussian fit from the 5-mc sample spectrum. Through direct subtraction of the ice spectrum from that of 5-mc, our data did not reveal any statistically distinct spectral features that would allow differentiation between 5-mc and ice, however, we observed a variation in the overall absorption over the entire frequency range measured. X-ray diffraction confirmed the formation of complex hydrates, the structure of which may have a strong influence on the overall absorption based on the theory of hydration shells. The difference in the overall absorption may allow for the detection of methylated cytidine at high concentrations.

articleTitle: THz 3-D Imaging Based on Cylindrical Synthetic Aperture with sub-mm Resolution
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a high-resolution 3-D imaging approach for terahertz imaging is proposed. The imaging method is designed for non-focused terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) systems with a large bandwidth using a cylindrical synthetic aperture. For the evaluation of the method, a complex test object with sub-mm features is considered.

articleTitle: Investigation of Si(111) by Terahertz-Field-Induced Optical Second Harmonic Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz-field-induced optical second harmonic generation from high-resistivity Si (111) was investigated both experimentally and theoretically. The azimuthal dependences of the second-harmonic (SH) signal for different polarizations of terahertz, fundamental and SH optical fields were analytically derived and experimentally verified. The dominance of build-in electric field induced source over surface/bulk-quadruple sources of SH generation was shown for the sample. The build-in electric field was estimated as 130 kV/cm. The relations between components of third-order nonlinear tensor were obtained.

articleTitle: Towards Operando Electron Transfer Dynamics Measured Using Time-Resolved Terahertz Spectroelectrochemistry
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Time-resolved terahertz spectroelectrochemistry measurements were employed to study electron transfer dynamics under an applied bias in dye-sensitized anatase TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. These measurements showed that electron trapping was suppressed with a negative applied bias, suggesting that trap states below the band edge were potentiostatically filled. In addition, electron injection dynamics were slowed, consistent with a decrease in density of available acceptor states in the metal oxide conduction band. We also show that care must be taken in selecting appropriately low pump fluences when trying to measure trapping processes in semiconductor materials.

articleTitle: Rapid Low-Cost Prototyping of Terahertz Metallic Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a very simple, rapid and low-cost prototyping technique to fabricate metallic 2D patterns for the terahertz range. We demonstrate arrays of split-ring resonators and wire-grid polarizers.

articleTitle: A 0.34THz Schottky Varactor Frequency Doubler with 50% PAE
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper describes a 0.34THz Schottky varactor frequency doubler with 50% PAE. We focus on the design of frequency doubler input matching, using the single side heightening waveguide to reduce reflection and expand bandwidth The simulation results show that when the input power is 100 mW, the frequency doubler efficiency is more than 40% from 0.33 THz to 0.36 THz, the output power is more than 40 mW and the maximum efficiency is up to 50%.

articleTitle: Development of High Efficiency 40W Q-Band Space Traveling Wave Tube at Sanle
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A Q-band high efficiency 40W space traveling wave tube (TWT) is being developed for low earth orbit (LEO) satellite communication system. The dimension of the Q-band space TWT is 210mm × 40mm × 44mm with the weight less than 500g. The saturated output power and efficiency is higher than 40W and 55% respectively.

articleTitle: Broadband Terahertz Achromatic Metasurface with Linear Spatial Phase Gradients
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrated three kinds of broadband terahertz achromatic metasurfaces with linear phase gradients including a deflector, a beam splitter and an axicon, whose phase and dispersion were simultaneously engineered by changing the geometric parameters of the unit cells. The devices presented here may inspire novel achromatic metasurfaces and promote the development of broadband terahertz devices.

articleTitle: Detection of strong light-matter interaction at the nano-scale in concealed optical cavities via a thermal transducer
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A thin layer of a mid-IR transparent polymer is inserted inside a metallic optical nano-resonator, where a photonic mode and an intersubband transition are strongly coupled together. Acting as a non-perturbative transducer, and without modifying the optical response, the polymer allows the detection of absorbed optical power in the form of thermal expansion due to heat dissipation. This innovative approach permits to identify - even at the single nano-resonator level - the typical anti crossing characteristic of the polaritonic system, and to perform direct imaging of the electromagnetic fields buried within the inside of an otherwise inaccessible optical nanocavity.

articleTitle: Non-labeling Detection of Specific Intermolecular Bonding Using THz-SPR of Topological Insulator Bi2Se3
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz (THz) wave length, corresponding to intermolecular binding energy, is the key to realize a non-labeling bio-medical sensor. We aim to enhance the sensitivity by a selective resonant excitation effect of the specific chemical binding and surface plasmon at the THz band. Here, we report the non-labeling detection of biomolecular binding by topological insulator THz-SPR. Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> was processed in a microribbon array to enhance SPR in THz range. The sugar chain-lectin specific binding, which has weaker interactions than antigen-antibody binding, was observed due to the enhancement of Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> THz-SPR.

articleTitle: Parallel-plate-waveguide-based devices for the terahertz region
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this work we present three devices based on parallel-plate-waveguides (PPWGs): a demultiplexer; a beam splitter; and an axicon. The PPWGs used in the construction of such devices are made out of stainless steel sheets and vary in longitudinal length (along the beam propagation direction) in a linear fashion. All the proposed quasi-optical elements can be easily tuned to work within different frequency ranges only by changing the spacing between the plates forming the PPWG’s, making this approach attractive for the fabrication of active devices for communication applications.

articleTitle: Interaction of Microwave Radiation by Very Thin Fibers
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The effect of strong interaction of microwave radiation with very thin conductive fibers has been investigated. The formulas for the absorption and scattering efficiency coefficients are obtained on the basis of the Mie theory. Conditions are found when absorption and scattering are very strong. The fiber diameter should be comparable to the thickness of the skin layer in the fiber. This is about 10 times less than the radiation wavelength in matter. The heat conduction equation, which describes the heating of the fiber by a microwave beam, was solved. The experiment by radiation (λ = 8 mm) was confirmed the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Design of a 120GHz Doubler based on AlGaN/GaN Schottky diode
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Compared with Gallium Arsenide material, GaN device has better power endurance characteristics, and hence has great potential in the development of high power source. This paper proposes a heterojunction structure of GaN Schottky diode to improve the electron mobility of the device, and the cut-off frequency is over 250 GHz. Furthermore, a 120 GHz doubler is designed based on the proposed device. The simulated result shows that the conversion efficiency reaches 15% when the input power is 1 W.

articleTitle: Improved Terahertz Phase Imaging with Single-beam Multiple-plane Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate a lensless terahertz phase retrieval imaging technique with a point radiation source. In contrast to the conventional applied multiple-plane iterative phase retrieval method, an algorithmic method to accelerate the phase retrieval process is proposed by using a randomly ordered sequence of propagations. The experimental results demonstrate that the method can improve the convergence speed by 2 to 3 times and reduce the number of needed intensity measurements for the iterative retrieval.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Self-Mixing Transistors at 0.56 and 1.06 THz in 65nm CMOS
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The frequency scalability of self-mixing transistors with zero drain bias for THz power detection is demonstrated. Measurements of individual patch-coupled detectors tuned at 0.56 and 1.06 THz indicate no sensitivity degradation when moving towards higher frequencies.

articleTitle: Terahertz Nanoantenna Sensors for Detection of 2-Hydroxyglutarate Isomers in Biological Samples
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz plasmonic sensors based on arrays of linear and H-shaped gold nanoantennas nanolithographically patterned on Si substrates with & without SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> sublayers are numerically and experimentally studied. The sensors are optimized for the plasmonic frequencies of 1.337 and 1.695 THz corresponding to the absorption bands of L-2HG and D-2HG isomers, respectively, which act as molecular biomarkers of glioma.

articleTitle: Efficiency of THz spintronic emitters: from spin-Hall effect in 3d/5d transition metals to surface states of topological insulators
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: THz spintronics emitters represent today novel sources for broadband emission using nanometer-scaled materials. We experimentally investigate and model THz spintronic emission based on the spin Hall effect in 3d/5d transition metals and on the inverse Rashba-Edelstein effect in the optimized topological insulator Bi1-xSbx.

articleTitle: Dynamic Terahertz Modulator Based on Tunable Dispersion of Spoof Surface Plasmon Polaritons
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a terahertz dynamic modulator based on Spoof Surface Plasmon Polaritons (SSPPs) is proposed. The dispersion of the grooves can be adjusted by changing the phase state of the embedded vanadium dioxide, which induces a variation of the SSPPs cut-off frequency. Then dynamic modulation is achieved through the coupling between the 2D grooves with different cut-off frequencies. Theoretical results show that isolation of up to 21.27 dB can be achieved in the 65 GHz band with a center frequency of 0.34 THz.

articleTitle: Development of W Band frequency synthesizer for coherent frequency agile Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A W Band coherent frequency synthesizer with frequency-agile, phase-regulated, low-spur and multiple-output is developed for FMCW radar. Measured results show that it has low-spur and low phase-noise performance.

articleTitle: Breakdown of Polaritons in Nanophotonic Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report a physical limit for reducing the modal volume of a cavity and ultimately increasing the light-matter coupling strength. Extremely confined photonic mode below a critical length-scale can introduce a large in-plane wave vector and excite a continuum of high momentum matter resonances. This excitations act as loss channels and reduce the field confinement by smearing the distribution of surface charges, thus consequently limiting the achievable field enhancement.

articleTitle: Research On Room Temperature Terahertz Focal Plane Detector Testing And Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The terahertz(THz) wave is a type of electromagnetic wave with the frequency of 0.1~10 THz and the wavelength of 30µm~3mm. Compared with other electromagnetic waves, THz wave has many unique properties, such as high penetration, wide broadband, lower energy and spectral identification capability. THz detection technology has been widely used, not only in the field of military communication and aerospace vehicle nondestructive testing, but also in civilian are such as security inspection, biomedical science, explosive detection, spectrum analysis, etc. THz technology has been paid more and more attention to currently in the world as a promising technology. With the rapid development of THz technology, there is higher requirement for the THz detection and the detector's performance. In order to meet this requirement, it is essential to carry out the research on the room temperature THz detector and its test verification imaging.

articleTitle: Polarization-independent Reflectionless Metasurface with an Extremely High Refractive Index
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz flat optics based on high refractive index reflectionless metasurfaces make it possible to replace massive optical components with planar structures suitable for integration with terahertz continuous-wave sources. We demonstrate a polarization-independent metasurface with the extremely high refractive index of 12.8, reflectance of 1.06%, and transmittance of 90.4 % at 0.31 THz for terahertz emerging applications such as 6G (beyond 5G) wireless communications in the 0.3-THz band.

articleTitle: The limits of applicability of the z-scan method for THz pulses from a small number of oscillations
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A detailed analysis of the applicability limits the z-scan method exhibit when employed for THz radiation is conducted. THz pulses feature critically wide spectrum and ultrashort duration, which leads to a significant decrease in the accuracy of the results obtained by z-scan method. The work presents the estimations of the z-scan method accuracy obtained through the comparison of the results of the numerical simulations of the method and analytically calculated values. The focus of the analysis was laid on dispersion, diffraction, and nonlinearity effects contributions.

articleTitle: Study of Airborne THz ViSAR
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Airborne THz ViSAR has an imaging frame rate of more than 5Hz with no aperture overlap, which gives the airborne THz ViSAR both advantages of high imaging speed of optical sensor and superior environmental adaptability of microwave radar. This paper introduced the study progress of airborne THz ViSAR, which adopts architectures with one transmitter and four receivers, which endowed the radar with multiple functions, including video synthetic aperture radar (ViSAR), ground motive target indicator (GMTI) and interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR). The experiments showed that taking advantages of high imaging frame rate, moving targets can still create clear shadows on the ground. So, the airborne THz ViSAR could detect and track targets by exploiting their shadows, which is effective for all moving targets regardless of their RCS.

articleTitle: Suppressing Parasitic Oscillation by Using Delayed Reflections in a Multimode Gyrotron
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Reflections may have a strong effect on mode-competition scenario in a multimode gyrotron. In this work, we study self-injection locking by delayed reflection of the multimode gyrotron with fixed Gaussian profile of the RF field. We demonstrate a possibility of expanding the domain of stable single-mode generation of the fundamental mode by suppressing the spurious modes.

articleTitle: Laser-induced anisotropy of electron momentum distribution in metals and semimetals
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this talk we summarize our latest theoretical and experimental results on the asymmetry of the electronic distribution function induced by femtosecond laser pulses and its manifestation in the sub-terahertz electromagnetic response. Non-reciprocal generation of THz pulses in monocrystalline bismuth and a new mechanism of magnetic field generation inside metals are discussed. We show that the processes of electron momentum relaxation are critical for electrodynamical properties of the discussed media at sub-picosecond timescale.

articleTitle: Switchable ultrafast spintronic THz emitters
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: T HE recent discovery of ultrafast spintronic THz emitters has attracted a lot of attention due to their high power, broadband emission as well as easy fabrication [1] , [2] . They are based on nanometer-thin bilayers of a magnetic (M) and a nonmagnetic (NM) metal layer and rely on the inverse spin Hall effect. The THz emission properties can be tuned by using different M or NM materials, tailoring the magnetic properties [3] , or building functional layer stacks [4] , [5] . Here, we present a spin valve THz emitter, which allows for switching of the THz emission amplitude by a low magnetic field of a few mT.

articleTitle: Terahertz-Range Superradiant Generation in the Process of Laser Pulses Scattering with Frequency Down-Conversion
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The possibility of generation of THz-range superradiant (SR) pulses by the scattering of a laser pulse on a high-current relativistic electron bunch has been studied. We assume that the laser pulse propagates in the forward direction while scattered radiation has the opposite (backward) direction with respect to an electron bunch. Due to frequency down-conversion, at the optical pumping frequency and moderate electrons energy the frequency of the scattered radiation lies in the THz range. Simulations show that for the electron energy of 2 MeV, SR pulses with the central frequency of 3 THz can be generated. With 3 kJ laser pulses and the intense electron bunches provided by thermo- or photo-cathodes, the peak power of SR pulses can achieve 200 kW with pulse energy exceeding 4 μJ.

articleTitle: A Sub-Terahertz Near-Field Subwavelength Sensor Element with Micrometer Spatial Resolution Fed by A Goubau Line
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper presents a Sub-terahertz (Sub-THz) super-resolution near-field imaging sensor with micrometer spatial resolution. The sensor consists of two split-ring resonators (SRRs) to achieve a subwavelength spatial resonance, a metal slot as a near-filed sensing area fed by the two SRRs resonators, and two metal supporting arms connecting the SRR and the metal slot. The metal slot with width of 2 um forms a near-field ultra-resolution radiation and sensing structure. In order to achieve low transmission loss, the Goubau metal line is employed to feed the near-field sensor. Numerical simulation shows that the subwavelength near-filed sensor owns a spatial resolution of about 10 um at the operating frequency 0.3 THz, which is 1/100 wavelength spatial. The effective operating range between the sensor and the object under test is about 2 um. Besides, the proposed near-field sensor also shows low insertion loss and high dynamic range that are 1.6 dB and 10 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Broadband Enhanced Sensing for Terahertz Molecular Fingerprint of Trace-amount Samples
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: With the aim of enhancing wideband fingerprint sensing signals for various trace-amount samples, this study proposes two terahertz (THz) wave manipulation methods, which are based on the dielectric metasurface and all-dielectric microstructure devices, respectively. The local electric field surrounding the trace-amount analytes can be enhanced by adopting the multi-degrees-of-freedom (MDOF) and thicknessmultiplexed schemes. Our investigation establishes an important theoretical basis for the universal molecular fingerprint detection of THz trace sensing.

articleTitle: Highly sensitive photodetectors at 0.6 THz based on quantum dot single electron transistors
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz (THz) technology has recently attracted wide scientific and technological interests in quantum science, where the need of fast and sensitive photodetectors prospects fascinating impacts in quantum computing, quantum metrology and optical communications. In this work, we demonstrate that quantum dot single electron transistors (SETs) based on InAs/InAs0.3P0.7 axially heterostructured nanowires integrated with planar on-chip nano-antennas, behave as highly sensitive zero-bias photo-thermoelectric detectors at 0.6 THz. The detector photoresponse can be optimized by electrostatic gating, taking advantage of the SET transport characteristics that clearly reflects energy quantization and single-electron tunneling in the dot.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared Second Harmonic Generation in SiGe Quantum Wells
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Inversion-symmetry breaking for second-harmonic generation in centrosymmetric Si and Ge is artificially realized with a pair of asymmetric-coupled SiGe quantum wells. Laser spectroscopy experiments demonstrate a nonlinear susceptibility four orders of magnitude larger than that of natural nonlinear materials in the visible range.

articleTitle: Attenuated total reflection: from skin detection to fingerprint sensing
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We use the terahertz attenuated total reflection (ATR) technology to evaluate different types of handcream and establish the theoretical model to investigate the reflectivity after interacting with the skin. In addition, a novel reflection sensing platform for enhanced fingerprint detection of samples in an ATR configuration with metasurface is also proposed.

articleTitle: Magnetic modulation of terahertz waves via spin-polarized electron tunneling
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate that the tunneling magneto-resistance (TMR) can be used to modulate terahertz (THz) wave propagation through a magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJ). Operating at the THz frequency range, a maximal modulation depth of 60% is reached for the parallel state of the MTJ with the thickness of 77.45 nm, by using a small magnetic field of 30 mT. The THz conductivity spectrum of the MTJ is governed by the spin-dependent electron tunneling. This findings open that the MTJ device will have potential applications in THz magnetic modulators, filtering and sensing.

articleTitle: Pulse Train Generation Dependence on Initial Pulses’ Chirp in THz Frequency Range
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate the dependence of the substructure number in the pulse train and the corresponding frequency comb formed by the interference of two phase-modulated THz pulses on the time delay between pulses for linear and nonlinear chirp cases. The limiting time delay between pulses, at which the correlation of the signal temporal and frequency domains preserving, is shown. The results obtained are important for assessing the capabilities of communication networks based on pulsed THz radiation.

articleTitle: Terahertz MEMS bolometers with enhanced thermal sensitivity by phononic crystal structures
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We have fabricated nm-scale phononic crystals (PnCs) to improve the thermal sensitivities of terahertz(THz) MEMS bolometers. Homogenous hole arrays of square lattices were formed on the MEMS beams, which significantly reduced the thermal conductance of the MEMS beams by ~90%, giving an enhancement in the thermal sensitivity by ~10 times. Furthermore, since the heat capacitance of the MEMS beam is also reduced by introducing the PnCs, the thermal bandwidth is only slightly decreased, demonstrating the effectiveness of the PnC structures for enhancing the thermal sensitivities of THz bolometers without significantly deteriorating their operation bandwidths.

articleTitle: Investigation of radial top-hat electric field distributions for corneal reflectometry using modified Fourier optics method
publicationTitle: 2021 46th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
